jobs.description:
DescriptionAt Dario, Every Day is a New Opportunity to Make a Difference.

Description

 At Dario, Every Day is a New Opportunity to Make a Difference.

  We are on a mission to make better health easy. Every day our employees contribute to this mission and help hundreds of thousands of people around the globe improve their health. How cool is that? We are looking for passionate, smart, and collaborative people who have a desire to do something meaningful and impactful in their career.

Dario is seeking a hands-on Platform Engineer with at least three years of experience to join our team. The role combines cloud infrastructure and DevOps engineering with corporate IT operations, including Microsoft 365, Intune, Windows, and macOS device management.

Responsibilities

- Manage, monitor, and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Terragrunt.

- Support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Automate operational tasks using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.

- Monitor systems, troubleshoot incidents, and perform root-cause analysis.

- Administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, accounts, licenses, and permissions.

- Manage identities and access through Microsoft Entra ID, including MFA and Conditional Access.

- Manage Windows and macOS devices through Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, compliance policies, application deployment, updates, encryption, and remote actions.

- Support Apple Business Manager and automated Mac enrollment.

- Manage employee onboarding, offboarding, equipment, accounts, and application access.

- Provide remote technical support for hardware, software, networking, VPN, authentication, and connectivity issues.

- Maintain IT asset records, technical documentation, security standards, and operating procedures.

- Collaborate with engineering, security, operations, and external vendors.

Requirements

- Three or more years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations.

- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, and Route 53.

- Experience with Terraform or Terragrunt and CI/CD platforms.

- Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Git, and networking.

- Scripting experience with Bash, Python, or a similar language.

- Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.

- Experience managing Windows devices with Microsoft Intune.

- Experience providing technical support in a remote environment.

- Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

- Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred

- Experience managing macOS devices through Intune or another MDM platform.

- Familiarity with Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and FileVault.

- Experience with Jamf Pro, Kandji, or Mosyle.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Windows Autopilot.

- Experience working in healthcare or another regulated industry.

- Relevant AWS, Microsoft, Kubernetes, Terraform, or security certifications.

*** DarioHealth promotes diversity of thought, culture and background, which connects the entire Dario team. We believe that every member on our team enriches our diversity by exposing us to a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the world, identify challenges, and to discover, design and deliver solutions. We are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environments for all people, and do not discriminate against any employee or job candidate.​***

jobs.description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

The Modern Endpoint Engineer is a member of the End User Productivity (EUP)- Endpoint team. The EUP team is a global team responsible for the management and delivery of client solutions that address current and future business needs.

You are responsible for Modern Endpoint Management, including Windows, iOS, and macOS devices. In this role you will support the delivery and operation of modern endpoint services across Windows, iOS, and macOS devices. You will focus on build and run execution, including implementation of endpoint solutions, support of day-to-day operations, and participation in issue resolution and escalation handling.

You will work closely with Service Owners and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to deliver reliable endpoint services aligned to defined standards, while contributing to continuous improvement efforts through operational insights and execution feedback.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

- Lead continuous improvement initiatives for Modern Endpoint Management solutions and drive process, system, and product enhancements.

- Design and build modern endpoint solutions (Windows, iOS, macOS) for SCJ application and infrastructure owners, including device management.

- Stay current with industry trends and collaborate with Service Owners to maintain expertise across the endpoint ecosystem (hardware, OS, apps, security).

- Ensure MSP compliance with standards and SLAs/XLAs, act as escalation point, and monitor performance metrics.

- Partner with Service Owners to innovate solutions, define priorities, and ensure adherence to infrastructure management processes (change, work, problem management).

- Manage vendor and partner relationships, coordinate escalations, and lead or contribute to strategic and operational projects.

- Provide documentation, strategic planning support, and 3rd-level operational support, including off-hours coverage for global teams.

 Required Skills / Experience / Competencies:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science or related technical discipline

- Minimum 3 years of experience with a global enterprise-level service.

- Experience in Endpoint and Desktop Management space including but not limited to systems design, implementation and support.

- The ideal candidate will have a skill-set that includes a wide breadth of infrastructure related technologies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- User-centric design thinking.

- Assimilate new information quickly.

 Preferred Skills / Experience / Competencies:

- Working with Managed Service Providers

- Communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to troubleshoot complex problems

- Strong customer service skills, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and the ability to offer guidance and mentorship to junior team members

- Excellent interpersonal skills and a “can do” attitude in a team environment

- Self-motivated, self-directed person

- Ability to work with and support a globally dispersed team

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills – evaluates information/data to make decisions; anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve; creates actionable operational plans and involves others as needed

- Design Thinking

- Product Strategy

- User Experience modeling

- Microsoft and/or JAMF certifications are a plus

- Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice as assigned by the Manager.

 Job Requirements:

-
Full-time, direct employment

-
 Onsite work setup; once a week work-from-home after 3 months

-
Work Hours: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM or 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (Mondays to Fridays)

-
Flexibility to attend US AM meetings and to work in an EU shift for timebound projects.

-
Overtime might be required depending on the critical deliverables

 What’s in it for you:

We’ll invest in you, and you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, develop your skills, and work in an inclusive, family-like environment. You can also enjoy various benefits that include:

-
Competitive pay (up to 14th-month pay, profit sharing, retirement plan, etc.)

-
Health care benefits, a gym inside the office, paid leaves upon hire

-
Personalized career development plan.

-
Autonomy in your work

 Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion .

jobs.description:
OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer to support endpoint-security administration, policy enforcement, agent health, compliance reporting, and security-event investigation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer to support endpoint-security administration, policy enforcement, agent health, compliance reporting, and security-event investigation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer will serve as a McAfee endpoint-security specialist supporting the Department of Defense Endpoint Security Solutions environment. The engineer will investigate security events, unhealthy agents, policy failures, and endpoint-compliance issues; implement approved corrective actions; and validate that required endpoint protections remain operational and effective.

This role will coordinate agent deployment and endpoint remediation activities with Task 4 infrastructure personnel, support cybersecurity incident reporting, and maintain technical evidence for security-control and authorization activities.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area.

 Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer will:

- Serve as a technical specialist for the McAfee/Trellix endpoint-security technologies supporting the DoD Endpoint Security Solutions environment.

- Support administration, configuration, maintenance, and monitoring of approved endpoint-security tools and services.

- Implement and maintain approved endpoint-security policies, configurations, exclusions, rules, and enforcement settings.

- Monitor endpoint agents for connectivity, communication, deployment, update, and operational-health issues.

- Investigate unhealthy, inactive, noncommunicating, outdated, or improperly configured endpoint agents.

- Diagnose policy-enforcement failures, update failures, deployment errors, and endpoint-protection gaps.

- Implement Government-approved corrective actions and validate that endpoint protections have been successfully restored.

- Review ESS reports and dashboards to identify security events, compliance issues, policy failures, and remediation needs.

- Investigate endpoint-security alerts and events and coordinate response activities with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and Government teams.

- Coordinate McAfee/Trellix agent deployment, upgrade, repair, removal, and replacement activities with Task 4 infrastructure personnel.

- Support endpoint-remediation activities involving operating-system configurations, security policies, agents, signatures, content updates, and approved software.

- Confirm that endpoints receive required policies, signatures, content, and product updates.

- Validate endpoint compliance following remediation, configuration changes, maintenance, or agent deployment.

- Track endpoint-security findings, assigned owners, corrective actions, dependencies, deadlines, and closure evidence.

- Support vulnerability remediation associated with endpoint-security configurations, agent health, or protection status.

- Collect and maintain logs, screenshots, reports, configuration information, and other evidence supporting remediation and compliance.

- Create and update incident, problem, change, and remediation tickets in the designated workflow platform.

- Support cybersecurity incident reporting by gathering relevant endpoint data, event details, logs, timelines, and investigative evidence.

- Escalate significant events, persistent policy failures, widespread agent-health issues, and unresolved compliance deficiencies.

- Coordinate with system administrators and asset-management personnel to reconcile endpoint records, agent status, and authoritative inventories.

- Support security-control testing and provide endpoint-security evidence for RMF, ATO, ATC, audit, and inspection activities.

- Develop endpoint-security compliance reports, agent-health summaries, event metrics, trend analyses, and briefing materials.

- Maintain endpoint-security procedures, configuration documentation, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical knowledge articles.

- Recommend technical and process improvements that strengthen endpoint protection, agent health, monitoring, and compliance reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Active Secret clearance or higher.

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.

- Minimum of 7 years of relevant cybersecurity, endpoint-security, information-assurance, or information-security experience.

- Current CompTIA Security+ certification.

- Hands-on experience administering or supporting McAfee endpoint-security technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting DoD Endpoint Security Solutions in an enterprise environment.

- Experience with McAfee or Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator, Endpoint Security, McAfee Agent, threat-prevention modules, firewall policies, and web-control capabilities.

- Experience monitoring and remediating unhealthy, inactive, noncommunicating, or noncompliant endpoint agents.

- Experience troubleshooting agent deployment, policy enforcement, signature updates, content distribution, and endpoint-protection failures.

- Experience analyzing endpoint-security events, alerts, logs, dashboards, and compliance reports.

- Experience coordinating endpoint remediation with infrastructure, desktop-support, network, application, and cybersecurity teams.

- Familiarity with Host Based Security System technologies or legacy McAfee capabilities used within DoD environments.

- Experience supporting cybersecurity incident analysis, evidence collection, escalation, and reporting.

- Knowledge of the DoD Risk Management Framework, NIST SP 800-53 controls, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, and applicable DoD endpoint-security requirements.

- Experience providing technical evidence for ATO, ATC, security-control assessment, audit, or inspection activities.

- Familiarity with ACAS or Tenable, STIG Viewer, SCAP tools, eMASS, ServiceNow, or comparable cybersecurity and workflow platforms.

- Experience reconciling endpoint-agent status with configuration-management or asset-inventory records.

- Experience developing endpoint-compliance reports, agent-health metrics, event trends, and remediation dashboards.

- Additional certifications such as CySA+, CASP+, CISSP, Trellix product certifications, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials.

- Familiarity with current DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements.

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.

- Ability to manage multiple endpoint-security events, remediation activities, and technical dependencies in a structured enterprise environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

-
 EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

-
 Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

-
 Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation . or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.description:
Overview Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success.

 Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro , where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

 Kentro is hiring for a Endpoint Engineering Senior Systems Architect to support the VA ESOM contract . The Senior Systems Architect will help formalize Enterprise Engineering planning across five divisions by establishing a consistent, repeatable process for evaluating, prioritizing, and integrating emerging technologies. The architect will define target-state architecture, guide investment and modernization decisions, and translate complex technical considerations into secure, scalable, and actionable recommendations for executive and engineering stakeholders.

The Endpoint Engineering Senior Systems Architect provides enterprise-level architectural leadership to help VA sustain and enhance existing endpoint technologies while evaluating new products and services that address emerging agency needs and capability gaps across its five divisions. Working closely with the VA Endpoint Engineering Director and division stakeholders, the architect assesses current capabilities, identifies improvement and modernization opportunities, and recommends the priorities, standards, and sequencing needed to maintain a secure, resilient, and sustainable endpoint ecosystem. A central responsibility is formalizing and strengthening VA’s current Enterprise Engineering planning approach through a consistent, repeatable process for evaluating, prioritizing, and integrating technologies across all five divisions.

This position bridges executive decision-making and technical execution. The architect translates agency needs and capability gaps into architectural requirements, evaluates enhancements to existing technologies and proposed new capabilities, and identifies dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impacts. The architect establishes common evaluation criteria addressing mission value, security, interoperability, scalability, lifecycle supportability, resource requirements, and operational readiness. These assessments help the Director determine what to sustain, enhance, modernize, or introduce and how to sequence those efforts. The role provides an enterprise perspective across desktop and device engineering, endpoint management, mobile technology, macOS, endpoint security, application integration, virtual desktop, and enterprise printing services.

The Senior Systems Architect develops and maintains an Endpoint Modernization Roadmap and Emerging Technology Assessment grounded in stakeholder needs, current-state findings, and documented capability gaps. These deliverables guide coordinated planning across the five divisions, document recommendations and decision points, prioritize evaluations and pilots, and define the architectural and readiness considerations for transitioning approved capabilities into implementation and sustained operations. The architect works with engineering, security, and operational partners to ensure recommendations reduce operational and security risks, protect sensitive Veteran information, and support the Veteran digital experience. The ideal candidate combines deep endpoint architecture expertise with the judgment, communication skills, and credibility needed to advise senior government leaders.

 Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

 Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $145,000 –$185,000 annually and reflects Kentro ’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro ’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

 Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary technical and strategic advisor to the VA Endpoint Engineering Director on endpoint architecture, modernization priorities, emerging technologies, investment decisions, and enterprise risk.

- Develop and maintain the Endpoint Modernization Roadmap and Emerging Technology Assessment, including an initial baseline, quarterly updates, and a comprehensive annual refresh.

- Design, implement, and continuously improve a consistent, repeatable Enterprise Engineering planning process to assess, sustain, and enhance existing technologies, while evaluating, prioritizing, and integrating emerging technologies across the five divisions.

- Facilitate cross-division planning and prioritization sessions that surface changing demands, capability gaps, enterprise dependencies, and competing priorities for Director-level decision-making.

- Monitor and assess endpoint-industry trends, products, services, and architectural patterns, and translate their potential value, limitations, risks, dependencies, and implementation implications into actionable recommendations.

- Assess existing endpoint technologies for performance, security, lifecycle status, supportability, and alignment with agency needs; recommend sustainment, enhancement, modernization, or retirement actions.

- Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures for the enterprise endpoint ecosystem, with clear principles, standards, decision points, and sequencing guidance.

- Establish and govern a common evaluation framework for new capabilities, including technical feasibility, cybersecurity and privacy impacts, interoperability, scalability, accessibility, operational readiness, total cost considerations, Veteran digital experience impacts, and alignment with VA priorities.

- Advise on architecture and integration across Windows, macOS, mobile, virtual desktop, endpoint management, application packaging and delivery, enterprise printing, identity, security tooling, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure.

- Lead or facilitate architecture reviews for major initiatives, proposed solutions, pilots, and technology changes; document decisions, assumptions, risks, exceptions, and required follow-up actions.

- Recommend and shape proofs of concept and pilot efforts, including success criteria, evaluation measures, decision gates, transition-to-production requirements, and sustainment considerations.

- Assess dependencies across engineering workstreams and partner organizations, identifying conflicts, capability gaps, technical debt, and sequencing risks before they affect delivery.

- Assess endpoint architectures against applicable federal cybersecurity requirements, Zero Trust principles, NIST guidance, DISA STIGs, VA policies, enterprise architecture standards, and approved ports and protocols; identify gaps and coordinate required reviews with designated VA authorities.

- Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity, networking, cloud, application, operations, acquisition, and service-management stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are supportable and enterprise-ready.

- Develop executive briefings, decision papers, reference architectures, technology assessments, recommendation memoranda, and other materials that enable informed leadership decisions.

- Define measurable planning outcomes and maintain traceability from identified capability gaps and technology recommendations through prioritization, pilot decisions, integration planning, and operational adoption.

- Provide architectural guidance during complex technical escalations and high-impact initiatives while maintaining focus on systemic causes, long-term remediation, and architectural consistency.

- Coach engineering leads and technical staff on architecture practices, design quality, documentation expectations, and the translation of strategic direction into executable engineering plans.

- Represent Endpoint Engineering in enterprise planning and governance forums, clearly communicating architectural positions, operational impacts, and recommended courses of action.

 Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

- 12 or more years of progressive experience in systems architecture, endpoint engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related discipline, including at least five years in an enterprise architecture or senior technical advisory capacity.

- Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders and translating complex technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs into clear recommendations and decision-ready materials.

- Deep knowledge of enterprise endpoint architecture across Windows, macOS, mobile, virtual desktop, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, and modern management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and Jamf Pro.

- Experience developing current-state and target-state architectures, modernization roadmaps, reference architectures, technical standards, and technology assessments for large, complex environments.

- Experience evaluating emerging technologies and leading structured proofs of concept, pilots, architecture reviews, or product-selection efforts.

- Strong understanding of cloud and hybrid architectures, Zero Trust, automation, configuration management, lifecycle management, interoperability, resilience, and operational sustainment.

- Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance requirements, including NIST 800-series guidance, NIST 800-53, DISA STIGs, and enterprise system-hardening practices.

- Proven ability to collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, networking, identity, cloud, operations, acquisition, and service-management organizations.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief engineers, program leaders, and executive stakeholders.

- Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and provide objective recommendations in a complex, highly governed environment.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, or a related field.

- Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs or another large federal agency.

- A minimum of 10 years experience with federal enterprise architecture, technology governance, capital planning, acquisition support, or technical review boards.

- Familiarity with ServiceNow, configuration management databases, service catalogs, asset and configuration governance, and operational reporting.

- Experience applying architecture frameworks or structured methods such as TOGAF, Department of Defense Architecture Framework, or Federal Enterprise Architecture Framework.

- Experience with endpoint analytics, AI-enabled operations, digital employee experience, automation, cloud-native management, remote monitoring, or other emerging endpoint capabilities.

- Familiarity with ITIL practices and the transition of engineered capabilities into sustainable service operations.

  About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

  About this Position

The Associate Systems Engineer (ASE) is responsible for supporting client environments and end users while also assisting with implementation projects. The ASE configures the equipment and software to meet client business needs and documents the solution for ongoing support. This position will provide first level technical support and main level ticket tracking in an efficient and effective manner.

The primary role focus is to decrease time to resolution and increase revenue by acting as a project resource and the initial technical resource for service tickets.

- Troubleshoot hardware & accurately determine fixes.

- Adherence to SOPs

- Continue to learn new technologies and solutions.

- Ability to be on-call and work after-hours where necessary.

- Exceptional ability to adapt and learn new platforms and skills on the fly.

- Exceptional sense of urgency.

- Experience in remediation of AV related issues.

- ConnectWise Automate Familiarity or similar RMM solution.

- Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on rapport-building, listening and questioning skills.

- College degree from an accredited four-year institution or relevant technical experience.

- Previous customer support, sales or technology experience.

- Technical Certifications (Preferred): Microsoft, Cisco, VMWare, MDM, SonicWALL, Fortinet, CompTIA.

- A+/Network+ Certification or equivalent experience

  Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

-

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Solutions Engineer, US Enterprise (West)

 San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; San Diego, CA; Seattle, WA

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Solutions Engineering Team

We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.

The Solutions Engineer Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager Solutions Engineering, Okta the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant, with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

What you’ll be doing

- Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions

- Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs

- Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues

- Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed

- Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

- Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

- Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

- Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

- At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

What you’ll bring to the role

- 4+ years pre-sales engineering experience and solution selling.

- A passion to serve the Customer, demonstrated in a customer-facing role, such as presales or professional services, but ideally in a pre-sales capacity.

- An ability to quickly communicate complex ideas around a technical topic, ideally on the fly, using a whiteboard.

- Deployed apps in cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.

- Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (eg. OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP)

- Experience working with REST APIs and SDKs

- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python) development, scripting (Bash, Powershell, Perl)

- An understanding of core security concerns within a typical application. (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF)

- You're an exceptional communicator, adept at simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including highly skilled experts in large group settings.

- A confident and articulate presenter, you excel at sharing knowledge and insights with experienced technical professionals and large expert audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to highly skilled and experienced audiences, whether one-on-one or in large presentations.

- Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterparts to guide execution excellence

- Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.

- Typically 25% travel.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or equivalent experience

You ideally have

- Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions in enterprise environments.

- Deep understanding of the challenges and best practices associated with securing privileged accounts, including just-in-time (JIT) access, session recording, credential vaulting, and secrets management.

- Practical experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and Federation services.

- Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices preferred.

- Relevant experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions, particularly in the areas of Identity and Privileged Access

jobs.description:
Category: Technology Location: Jacksonville Florida United States Senior Tanium Architect / Engineer - RemoteAs a senior Tanium Architect / Engineer you are going to support the enterprise implementation and operationalization of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform on Tanium Cloud, including Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management.

Category: Technology

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States

 Senior Tanium Architect / Engineer - Remote
 As a senior Tanium Architect / Engineer you are going to support the enterprise implementation and operationalization of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform on Tanium Cloud, including Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management.

 This is a highly hands-on senior technical role requiring an individual who can provide architectural guidance while actively building, configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting the platform. The ideal candidate has successfully implemented Tanium at enterprise scale across tens of thousands of endpoints and can drive technical decisions, recommend best practices, identify risks, and translate architecture into a stable, scalable production environment.

 The engineer will work closely with Tanium professional services and customer security, infrastructure, network, ITSM, endpoint engineering, and automation teams. This individual will serve as a technical leader within the team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

 The goal is to maintain a native, standards-based Tanium environment with minimal unnecessary customization , establish strong automation and operational guardrails, and enable the customer's internal team to become self-sufficient.

  Responsibilities

  Tanium Architecture & Implementation

- Lead the hands-on implementation and build-out of Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management within Tanium Cloud.

- Translate vendor-provided architectural direction into a scalable enterprise implementation.

- Review architecture against network segmentation, endpoint populations, bandwidth requirements, security requirements, change processes, and existing tooling.

- Identify technical gaps, risks, dependencies, and potential conflicts and recommend appropriate solutions.

- Provide technical leadership and drive architecture and implementation discussions across participating teams.

- Apply Tanium architecture, agent communication, module dependency, content, and scaling knowledge to implementation decisions.

- Maintain a native and standardized Tanium architecture wherever possible, avoiding unnecessary customization.

  Endpoint Deployment & Management

- Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot Tanium agents across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.

- Support data center, cloud, server, workstation, and end-user endpoint populations.

- Drive pilot and production deployment waves.

- Monitor and remediate endpoint coverage, health, connectivity, and performance issues.

- Support post-deployment stabilization and hypercare activities.

- Establish automated and scalable agent lifecycle processes.

- Build dynamic endpoint groups rather than static groups to support scalable targeting and administration.

  Tanium Core

- Configure and maintain sensors, saved questions, packages, actions, computer groups, RBAC, and related platform components.

- Develop and test custom Tanium content using PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash .

- Build endpoint inventory, coverage, and operational reporting.

- Establish role-based access controls and technical guardrails designed to reduce the risk of unintended large-scale endpoint actions.

- Configure Tanium Connect and other required platform integrations.

  Endpoint Management

- Configure automated operating system and third-party application patching.

- Establish maintenance windows, deployment rings, endpoint targeting, and approval workflows.

- Build, package, test, and deploy enterprise software and update workflows.

- Troubleshoot patching, software deployment, and endpoint-management failures.

- Configure policy enforcement and endpoint performance functionality as applicable.

- Support initial inventory and software/license-management use cases, followed by expanded patch-management capabilities.

- Drive rapid platform adoption, including early agent deployment and patching proof-of-concept activities.

  Exposure Management

- Configure vulnerability and compliance scanning against applicable security benchmarks, including CIS, NIST, STIG, and internal standards .

- Connect vulnerability findings with remediation workflows.

- Build security, compliance, operational, and remediation dashboards and reporting.

- Develop workflows connecting findings to automated remediation where appropriate.

  ServiceNow Integration

- Design, implement, and validate robust Tanium and ServiceNow integrations .

- Integrate Tanium endpoint and asset information with the ServiceNow CMDB .

- Support CMDB-driven and two-way integration patterns between Tanium and ServiceNow.

- Enable CI and tag lifecycle changes to drive appropriate endpoint actions.

- Align business application, service, environment, ownership, and related endpoint tagging with ServiceNow data.

- Connect patching and software-deployment activities with ServiceNow change-management processes.

- Route vulnerability and incident information into appropriate ServiceNow workflows.

- Monitor and troubleshoot data synchronization and integration issues.

  Automation & API Integration

- Develop integrations using Tanium APIs and automation frameworks .

- Use Ansible for Tanium agent deployment and lifecycle management across Linux and server environments.

- Develop Ansible playbooks and automation that complement Tanium-driven remediation.

- Define appropriate functional boundaries between Tanium and existing configuration-management and automation platforms to minimize duplication and conflicts.

- Document integration architecture, data flows, automation logic, and troubleshooting procedures.

  Dashboards & Reporting

- Build actionable dashboards for endpoint operations, security, compliance, inventory, and management stakeholders.

- Support One Insights use cases and dashboard configuration.

- Develop appropriate dashboard segmentation for workstation and server populations and their respective ownership groups.

- Establish reporting for platform health, endpoint coverage, software inventory, vulnerabilities, compliance, and remediation.

  Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer

- Work directly with Tanium professional services and customer security, infrastructure, networking, ITSM, endpoint, and automation teams.

- Serve as a senior technical resource who can drive architecture and implementation discussions.

- Participate in change-management, rollout planning, testing, and production-readiness activities.

- Produce technical runbooks, test plans, architecture documentation, troubleshooting guides, and as-built documentation.

- Train customer administrators and operators on the implementation and ongoing platform management.

- Drive knowledge transfer with the objective of enabling the internal team to operate the Tanium environment independently.

  Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in endpoint management, infrastructure engineering, or security engineering.

- 2-5+ years of hands-on Tanium experience within large enterprise environments.

- Demonstrated experience implementing and operating Tanium across tens of thousands of endpoints .

- Strong hands-on experience with Tanium Core and multiple Tanium capabilities such as Patch, Deploy, Comply, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management .

- Strong working knowledge of Tanium Cloud and enterprise Tanium architecture.

- Demonstrated ability to function as both a Tanium architect and hands-on engineer .

- Strong experience integrating Tanium with ServiceNow , including CMDB-driven integrations and data synchronization.

- Hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and Change Management .

- Strong Ansible experience, including playbooks, roles, automation, and inventory management.

- Experience building API-based integrations and automated workflows.

- Strong scripting skills using PowerShell and Python and/or Bash .

- Experience building Tanium sensors, packages, actions, targeting, and custom content.

- Strong Windows and Linux systems administration experience.

- Working knowledge of Active Directory and enterprise networking concepts.

- Experience designing dynamic endpoint groups, RBAC, and operational guardrails .

- Experience with enterprise software inventory and software/license management.

- Knowledge of vulnerability management and security/compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, and STIG .

- Ability to independently troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and knowledge transfer.

  Preferred Qualifications

- Tanium certifications such as Tanium Certified Operator or Administrator .

- Extensive hands-on experience with Tanium Cloud .

- Experience with One Insights and enterprise Tanium dashboarding.

- Advanced Tanium and ServiceNow integration experience, including CMDB synchronization and vulnerability-management workflows.

- Experience with Ansible Automation Platform .

- ServiceNow or Red Hat certifications such as CSA or RHCE .

- Experience migrating from SCCM/MECM, BigFix, or similar endpoint-management platforms .

- Experience working within highly regulated enterprise environments.

- Previous experience working alongside vendor professional services teams.

  Tools and Technologies

- Tanium Cloud

- Tanium Core

- Tanium Endpoint Management

- Tanium Exposure Management

- Tanium Patch / Deploy / Comply

- Tanium Connect

- One Insights

- ServiceNow / CMDB / Change Management

- Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform

- PowerShell

- Python

- Bash

- REST APIs / Automation

- Windows

- Linux

- macOS

- Active Directory

- CIS / NIST / STIG frameworks

jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.

At LifeStance Health , we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

  LifeStance Health Values

-
Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

-
Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

-
Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

-
One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

 Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health , the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior MDM Data Steward serves as the authoritative steward for patient and provider domains for master data across the Enterprise Data Platform, providing leadership for the operational governance, quality, and integrity of enterprise identity data. This role owns the stewardship framework supporting patient and provider master records and is accountable for ensuring that Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) patient global identifiers and MDM provider global identifiers within the Silver (conformed canonical) layer remain accurate, complete, traceable, and trusted for analytics, reporting, regulatory compliance, operational decision-making, and AI-driven use cases.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior MDM Data Steward leads identity resolution activities, establishes and maintains stewardship standards, and exercises judgment in the review and disposition of complex match, merge, and identity exception scenarios. The steward proactively identifies data quality risks, drives remediation efforts across source systems, oversees survivorship rule execution, and serves as the primary escalation point for patient and provider identity-related issues. In partnership with Business Data Owners, Data Governance leaders, and source-system stakeholders, this role influences stewardship practices, promotes data quality accountability, and drives continuous improvement of master data management processes.

The Senior MDM Data Steward also owns the maintenance and ongoing governance of patient and provider business glossary terms, data quality rules and definitions, lineage context, stewardship procedures, issue records, and related governance artifacts within Snowflake Horizon Catalog. Through active monitoring, analysis, and stewardship leadership, the role ensures critical business and technical metadata remains current, actionable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards and strategic data management objectives.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

 COMPENSATIO N: $109,000 - $130,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

 KEY RESPONSIBILITES

 Identity Resolution, Match Stewardship, and Operational Leadership (approximately 40%)

- Lead enterprise MDM stewardship operations by directing work queue activities, adjudicating complex identity resolution scenarios, resolving potential matches and duplicates, correcting improperly merged identities, and establishing consistent record governance practices for manually reviewed records.

- Serve as the senior escalation point for patient identity management issues, investigating overlays, duplicates, and cross-system identity conflicts originating from athenaOne, AdvancedMD, and other source systems; determine root causes, drive corrective actions, and recommend process improvements to reduce recurrence.

- Own the governance and integrity of the provider master data domain, establishing and enforcing standards for the reconciliation of NPI, taxonomy, licensure, credentialing status, payer enrollment, practice location, employment status, and related attributes across enterprise source systems.

- Provide leadership for provider data quality and governance initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of provider practice, location, and organizational affiliation data supporting operational, analytical, credentialing, reimbursement, and regulatory reporting needs.

- Partner with Data Architecture to evaluate and tune Verato match thresholds, referential matching configuration, survivorship, and attribute precedence rules; measure the effect on auto-match, potential-match, unmatched, and false-positive rates before changes are promoted.

- Ownership over establishing and maintaining enterprise standards for data stewardship decisions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of exceptions, adjudication rationale, survivorship outcomes, merge and unmerge activities, and record-resolution actions to support auditability, compliance, and continuous improvement efforts.

 Data Quality, Issue Management & Silver Layer Validation (approximately 25%)

- Establish and own the business acceptance standards for patient and provider mastered records, source-to-global ID crosswalks, identity resolution outcomes, and golden-record quality within the Snowflake Silver layer, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and operational objectives.

- Provide oversight of EMPI patient and provider global ID integrity within the Snowflake Silver layer by proactively identifying data quality defects, validating adherence to business rules, and directing remediation efforts with Data Engineering and DataOps teams to ensure timely resolution.

- Define, govern, and continuously refine master data quality standards and performance thresholds, including metrics related to unmatched records, duplicate records, orphaned source IDs, stale provider attributes, missing NPI values, invalid affiliations, and incomplete required attributes; communicate performance trends and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.

- Lead the governance and lifecycle management of patient and provider master data issues, prioritizing remediation activities based on business impact, overseeing issue resolution progress, and providing transparent reporting on ownership, remediation status, risk exposure, and closure outcomes.

- Independently lead strategic trend analysis and root-cause investigations to identify systemic defects across registration, scheduling, provider onboarding, credentialing, human resources, interfaces, and source application workflows; recommend and influence corrective actions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.

- Own the maintenance and governance of master data lineage and identifier crosswalks, ensuring accurate traceability between source-system MRNs, provider identifiers, and enterprise global IDs while supporting audit, compliance, and operational reporting requirements.

- Serve as the primary business lead for identity-related incidents and data quality escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring corrective actions are effectively prioritized, tested, and promoted through established release and change-management processes.

Governance, Metadata & Policy (approximately 20%)

- Establish and govern enterprise patient and provider master data standards, defining business terminology, required attributes, permissible values, data ownership, attribute precedence, relationship hierarchies, and merge/unmerge policies to ensure consistent and compliant master data management practices across the organization.

- Own the stewardship framework and metadata management processes for Patient and Provider domains by maintaining business glossary terms, data quality standards, stewardship procedures, issue records, and lineage documentation within the Snowflake Horizon Catalog, ensuring transparency and accessibility for business and technical stakeholders.

- Serve independently as the primary stewardship leader for Patient and Provider domains within the Data Governance Steering Committee, influencing enterprise governance decisions and partnering with Business Data Owners to establish data definitions, quality expectations, usage standards, and remediation priorities.

- Provide governance leadership and strategic recommendations to Business Data Owners, enabling informed decision-making regarding business definitions, quality thresholds, and stewardship policy changes while ensuring alignment with enterprise data management objectives.

- Lead the evaluation and governance of changes impacting master data policies, including data definitions, identity matching criteria, survivorship logic, and quality thresholds; facilitate cross-functional review, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and decision-making through established governance processes.

- Independently ensure stewardship operations adhere to HIPAA minimum-necessary requirements, HITRUST controls, and organizational privacy and security policies, establishing robust auditability and oversight for manual merge, split, correction, and identity-resolution activities.

- Partner with Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to assess regulatory and policy impacts on identity management practices, providing stewardship leadership for consent restrictions, sensitive data handling requirements, healthcare regulatory obligations, golden-record usage, and downstream data access controls.

- Drive the development and continuous improvement of master data standards that support regulatory reporting, quality initiatives, reimbursement processes, payer requirements, and broader enterprise business objectives, ensuring data assets remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose across the organization.

 Source-System Improvement, Reporting & Enablement (approximately 15%)

- Provide leadership and oversight for enterprise master data remediation efforts, directing corrective actions to registration, provider credentialing, human resources, practice operations, and other source-system owners; ensure timely resolution, accountability, and sustainable process improvements that prevent recurring data quality issues within mastered records.

- Partner with operational and business leaders to strengthen upstream data governance and capture processes, identifying opportunities to enhance controls, workflows, and accountability measures that reduce the creation of duplicate, incomplete, and conflicting patient and provider records at the source.

- Develop, own, and present executive-level stewardship performance reporting, delivering monthly scorecards and actionable insights on duplicate rates, unmatched records, match accuracy, exception backlog and aging, source correction effectiveness, provider data completeness, global ID coverage, and recurring root-cause trends to support informed decision-making.

- Serve as the primary stewardship liaison with MDM vendors and implementation partners, providing leadership in troubleshooting match-quality issues, evaluating configuration recommendations, validating platform capabilities, assessing business impacts, and guiding release planning and implementation decisions.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Endpoint Engineer will play a critical role as a technology service owner within the Department of Digital Information Infrastructure and Engineering team. An Endpoint Engineer is a jack-of-all-trades in regard to endpoint management and utilizes their skills, experience, and talent to recommend, design, implement, and support next generation technologies across the enterprise. The position serves as the primary technology service owner responsible for enterprise endpoint management practices including software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, desktop virtualization, device provisioning, application testing, license management, and device configuration. These technologies support a dynamic learning environment that empowers 15,000 staff to deliver a world class education for 80,000+ students.

Roles And Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the overall nature and scope of the work being performed. This is not a comprehensive listing of all responsibilities or tasks; work may differ and other work may be assigned when deemed appropriate.

Principally owns several technology services within LCPS including software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, device imaging, application testing, desktop virtualization, cloud service management, and device configurationParticipates in a dynamic team with shared responsibilities to maintain critical IT servicesEscalates information to Endpoint SpecialistsDocuments processes and procedures as related to the mission of Endpoint ManagementDevelops strategies and collaborates with technical and non-technical staff on core infrastructure projectsDesigns and deploys new systems and enhancements to existing systemsMeasures effectiveness of existing core infrastructure systems and strategically designs and implements improvementsBuilds processes to ensure efficient support of all core infrastructure systemsMonitors and tests system performance to include delivering of statistics and reportsProvides guidance to other technical staffSolves complex engineering issues while working collaboratively with other departments in a team first approachResolves issues by applying outstanding communication, analytical, technical, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills to ensure all systems operate effectively and efficiently to maximize education opportunities for studentsProvides excellent customer service to both external and internal customers

Qualifications

Below are the minimum qualifications for this job. Equivalent combinations of education and experience are also acceptable.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field

Experience

Three (3) years of full-time work experience in information technology

Experience in at least two endpoint management or infrastructure services, including (but not limited to): Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Autopilot, Microsoft SCCM, Google Workspace, Amazon Web Services, Ivanti Endpoint Manager, JAMF, VMWare Workstation, Dizzion FRAME, Active Directory, BeyondTrust, Radix MDM

Strong knowledge and experience in at least one major operating system, including Windows, macOS, iPadOS, or ChromeOS

Scripting experience using PowerShell, VBScript, or Command Shell

Prior experience supporting a K-12 environment is highly desirable, with an understanding of the unique IT support needs and challenges in this environment

Experience in operating system configuration and deployment

Experience supporting large enterprise environments and large fleets of endpoints

Licenses and Certifications

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong knowledge in operating system configuration and deploymentStrong knowledge in supporting large enterprise environments and large fleets of endpointsExceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify, analyze, and resolve technical issuesA commitment to staying current with emerging technologies and best practices in information technology

Physical Requirements

The following provides a brief description of physical requirements for this job:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly talking, expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. The employee must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. The employee must possess normal cognitive abilities including the ability to learn, recall and apply certain practices and policies. Frequently sitting and/or remaining in a stationary position for long periods of time. Exerting up to 25 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

Reports to: Supervisor, Endpoint Management

FLSA Status: Exempt

Months/Days/Hours: 12 monsth, 254 days. 8 hours

Salary Level: Universal/Scale B.2 - Level 14

Salary Scale: https://www.lcps.org/compensation

Salary Range: $91,002 - $156,961

Remote Work Eligible:Partial

Union Designation: Non-Union

Remote Work Disclosure

The following guidelines apply to jobs and positions where employees have been identified as having the potential to work remotely. Remote work is defined as completing one's duties and responsibilities at a site other than one's assigned duty location. In order to be eligible for remote work privileges, an employee must have demonstrated consistent, positive performance and have the support and approval of their direct supervisor. In addition, these employees must have reliable high-speed internet and a designated workspace that allows them privacy while completing sensitive and confidential work. Employees who are non-exempt and are working remotely will work their regular scheduled hours and gain prior approval from their supervisor if they work more than 8 hours a day or more than 40 hours in a workweek. Remote work privileges can be amended, changed, or revoked based upon the performance of the employee, as well as the needs of Loudoun County Public Schools.

jobs.summary: Overview DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer to support endpoint-security administration, policy enforcement, agent health, compliance reporting, and security-event investigation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. The Endpoint...
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer to support endpoint-security administration, policy enforcement, agent health, compliance reporting, and security-event investigation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer will serve as a McAfee endpoint-security specialist supporting the Department of Defense Endpoint Security Solutions environment. The engineer will investigate security events, unhealthy agents, policy failures, and endpoint-compliance issues; implement approved corrective actions; and validate that required endpoint protections remain operational and effective.

This role will coordinate agent deployment and endpoint remediation activities with Task 4 infrastructure personnel, support cybersecurity incident reporting, and maintain technical evidence for security-control and authorization activities.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Security / ESS Engineer will:
Serve as a technical specialist for the McAfee/Trellix endpoint-security technologies supporting the DoD Endpoint Security Solutions environment. Support administration, configuration, maintenance, and monitoring of approved endpoint-security tools and services. Implement and maintain approved endpoint-security policies, configurations, exclusions, rules, and enforcement settings. Monitor endpoint agents for connectivity, communication, deployment, update, and operational-health issues. Investigate unhealthy, inactive, noncommunicating, outdated, or improperly configured endpoint agents. Diagnose policy-enforcement failures, update failures, deployment errors, and endpoint-protection gaps. Implement Government-approved corrective actions and validate that endpoint protections have been successfully restored. Review ESS reports and dashboards to identify security events, compliance issues, policy failures, and remediation needs. Investigate endpoint-security alerts and events and coordinate response activities with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and Government teams. Coordinate McAfee/Trellix agent deployment, upgrade, repair, removal, and replacement activities with Task 4 infrastructure personnel. Support endpoint-remediation activities involving operating-system configurations, security policies, agents, signatures, content updates, and approved software. Confirm that endpoints receive required policies, signatures, content, and product updates. Validate endpoint compliance following remediation, configuration changes, maintenance, or agent deployment. Track endpoint-security findings, assigned owners, corrective actions, dependencies, deadlines, and closure evidence. Support vulnerability remediation associated with endpoint-security configurations, agent health, or protection status. Collect and maintain logs, screenshots, reports, configuration information, and other evidence supporting remediation and compliance. Create and update incident, problem, change, and remediation tickets in the designated workflow platform. Support cybersecurity incident reporting by gathering relevant endpoint data, event details, logs, timelines, and investigative evidence. Escalate significant events, persistent policy failures, widespread agent-health issues, and unresolved compliance deficiencies. Coordinate with system administrators and asset-management personnel to reconcile endpoint records, agent status, and authoritative inventories. Support security-control testing and provide endpoint-security evidence for RMF, ATO, ATC, audit, and inspection activities. Develop endpoint-security compliance reports, agent-health summaries, event metrics, trend analyses, and briefing materials. Maintain endpoint-security procedures, configuration documentation, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical knowledge articles. Recommend technical and process improvements that strengthen endpoint protection, agent health, monitoring, and compliance reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications
Active Secret clearance or higher. Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum of 7 years of relevant cybersecurity, endpoint-security, information-assurance, or information-security experience. Current CompTIA Security+ certification. Hands-on experience administering or supporting McAfee endpoint-security technologies.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting DoD Endpoint Security Solutions in an enterprise environment. Experience with McAfee or Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator, Endpoint Security, McAfee Agent, threat-prevention modules, firewall policies, and web-control capabilities. Experience monitoring and remediating unhealthy, inactive, noncommunicating, or noncompliant endpoint agents. Experience troubleshooting agent deployment, policy enforcement, signature updates, content distribution, and endpoint-protection failures. Experience analyzing endpoint-security events, alerts, logs, dashboards, and compliance reports. Experience coordinating endpoint remediation with infrastructure, desktop-support, network, application, and cybersecurity teams. Familiarity with Host Based Security System technologies or legacy McAfee capabilities used within DoD environments. Experience supporting cybersecurity incident analysis, evidence collection, escalation, and reporting. Knowledge of the DoD Risk Management Framework, NIST SP 800-53 controls, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, and applicable DoD endpoint-security requirements. Experience providing technical evidence for ATO, ATC, security-control assessment, audit, or inspection activities. Familiarity with ACAS or Tenable, STIG Viewer, SCAP tools, eMASS, ServiceNow, or comparable cybersecurity and workflow platforms. Experience reconciling endpoint-agent status with configuration-management or asset-inventory records. Experience developing endpoint-compliance reports, agent-health metrics, event trends, and remediation dashboards. Additional certifications such as CySA+, CASP+, CISSP, Trellix product certifications, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials. Familiarity with current DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple endpoint-security events, remediation activities, and technical dependencies in a structured enterprise environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.description:
Asana for Client Management is a new product for Agencies to manage every client, every project, and every conversation in one place. We are looking for a collaborative Engineering Manager to lead one of the teams bringing this vision to life. In this role, you will build and empower a talented team of engineers, partner cross-functionally to shape the product roadmap, establish technical foundations, and deliver a superlative user experience.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 What you’ll achieve

- Hire and support a talented team of engineers to build a new product from the ground up.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Design, and Data Science to define roadmap priorities and deliver intuitive product capabilities.

- Guide architectural and technical decisions to ensure system reliability, performance, and long-term scalability.

- Drive operational excellence and continuous delivery processes, enabling the team to iterate quickly and ship value continuously.

- Champion accountability for key outcomes, linking your team's everyday work to Asana's broader strategic goals.

 About you

- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

- Experience guiding and developing software engineering teams in building scalable web applications, ideally with experience leading 0-1 product development.

- Solid technical background with a deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals and modern architecture.

- Proven track record of collaborating effectively with product managers and designers to balance technical health with user velocity.

- Clear communicator and empathetic leader who thrives in a collaborative environment.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

 What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 34,300 - 39,000 PLN gross.
