jobs.description:
About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on resolving complex technical escalations, strengthening security standards, driving technology modernisation, and improving operational efficiency. You will leverage your expertise across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively identify opportunities to optimise customer environments, enhance security, improve licensing efficiency, and reduce operational complexity. You will also play a key role in mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and driving continuous improvement across the wider technical team.

About the Client

You will be working with an established technology services provider that delivers managed IT services and Microsoft cloud solutions to commercial customers. The organisation prioritises security, operational excellence, and proactive technology management, empowering its technical teams to deliver reliable solutions while continuously improving customer environments.

Ideal Profile

Professional Experience

-

At least 7 years of experience in systems engineering, cloud engineering, or managed IT services, including significant experience in senior technical support or Level 3 engineering.

-

Proven experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP), supporting multiple commercial customer environments.

-

Strong understanding of managed services operations, incident management, problem management, and change management.

-

Demonstrated ability to own complex technical issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and deliver sustainable solutions.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management

-

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Manager.

-

Strong knowledge of Windows Autopilot, device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, and Windows 10/11 administration.

-

Experience with endpoint security, device lifecycle management, update management, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration.

Microsoft 365

-

Advanced administration and troubleshooting experience across Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft 365 licensing, including Business Premium, E3, and E5, and their associated security and compliance capabilities.

-

Understanding of Microsoft Purview, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and sensitivity labels.

Microsoft Entra ID & Identity Security

-

Deep expertise in identity and access management, authentication, identity protection, and access governance.

-

Advanced experience implementing and troubleshooting Conditional Access, multifactor authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO).

-

Knowledge of hybrid identity, Entra Connect, directory synchronisation, authentication protocols, role-based access control, and least-privilege security models.

-

Familiarity with Granular Delegated Admin Privileges (GDAP) and delegated administration across multiple customer tenants.

Microsoft Defender & Cybersecurity

-

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and the broader Microsoft Defender security ecosystem.

-

Experience implementing endpoint protection, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management, and security policies.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Defender XDR, Zero Trust principles, and Microsoft security best practices.

-

Ability to review Microsoft Secure Score and implement recommendations to strengthen security posture.

Microsoft Azure

-

Strong experience administering and troubleshooting Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking, storage, backup, monitoring, and resource management.

-

Knowledge of Azure role-based access control, Azure Policy, security configuration, governance, and cost management.

-

Familiarity with Azure Lighthouse and multi-tenant Azure administration.

Scripting & Automation

-

Advanced PowerShell scripting skills for automating Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure administration.

-

Strong experience with Microsoft Graph API for automation, reporting, and configuration management.

-

Ability to develop, troubleshoot, and maintain secure, reusable, and well-documented scripts and automated processes.

Security Frameworks & Additional Technical Knowledge

-

Familiarity with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) Essential Eight framework and its application to commercial environments.

-

Experience implementing Microsoft security controls to support Essential Eight maturity improvements.

-

Exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, advanced security monitoring, and broader Microsoft Purview compliance capabilities.

-

Familiarity with multi-tenant management platforms, including Microsoft 365 Lighthouse, Azure Lighthouse, and PSA/RMM tools such as ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Autotask, NinjaOne, or Datto RMM.

-

Experience contributing to customer technology roadmaps, security improvement plans, and Microsoft licensing reviews.

-

Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management practices.

Preferred Certifications

-

Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102).

-

Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102).

-

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).

Additional certifications in identity and access management, such as SC-300, and Azure security, such as SC-500, are advantageous. Equivalent practical experience and technical knowledge are also valued.

Key Competencies

-

Technical Expertise: Applies in-depth Microsoft technology knowledge to resolve complex engineering challenges independently.

-

Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for issues from investigation through resolution and addresses recurring problems at their source.

-

Proactive Thinking: Identifies opportunities to modernise environments, improve security, and prevent recurring incidents.

-

Analytical Problem-Solving: Uses structured troubleshooting and evidence-based analysis to develop sustainable solutions.

-

Security-Focused Mindset: Maintains secure, consistent, and well-governed Microsoft environments.

-

Communication & Collaboration: Communicates technical concepts, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

-

Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing: Supports the development of junior engineers and contributes to a collaborative technical culture.

-

Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintains high-quality documentation and continually improves technical standards, processes, and automation.

Responsibilities

1. Level 3 Technical Escalation & Problem Management

-

Serve as the primary escalation point for complex incidents across Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Azure.

-

Diagnose and resolve advanced issues involving endpoint management, identity, authentication, security, cloud infrastructure, and Microsoft services.

-

Lead root-cause analysis and problem management to identify recurring issues and implement permanent solutions.

-

Manage complex technical problems through to resolution, coordinating with Microsoft Support and third-party vendors when necessary.

-

Develop preventative measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve customer experience.

-

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Level 1 and Level 2 engineers.

2. Microsoft Security & Configuration Standards

-

-

Standardise configurations across Intune, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Azure.

-

Implement and optimise Conditional Access, MFA, endpoint protection, device compliance, and privileged access controls.

-

Monitor environments for configuration drift, security vulnerabilities, and deviations from approved standards.

-

-

Assess platform changes and recommend actions to maintain security, compatibility, and operational effectiveness.

-

Identify opportunities to modernise infrastructure, enhance endpoint management, strengthen security, and optimise Microsoft licensing.

-

Maximise the value of existing Microsoft licensing entitlements while reducing unnecessary expenditure.

-

Prepare structured technical recommendations outlining issues, proposed improvements, business benefits, risks, and implementation considerations.

-

Collaborate with account management teams to support proactive customer engagement and technology roadmap planning.

-

Promote standardisation across customer environments to reduce operational complexity.

4. Multi-Tenant Microsoft Environment Management

-

Administer and support multiple commercial customer environments using Microsoft multi-tenant management tools and processes.

-

Manage delegated administrative access through GDAP and maintain appropriate permissions and governance controls.

-

-

Conduct tenant security reviews, compliance assessments, and configuration improvements.

-

Identify opportunities to improve the scalability, consistency, and efficiency of multi-tenant operations.

5. Automation & Operational Efficiency

-

Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and Microsoft Graph API integrations to automate administrative and support activities.

-

Identify repetitive tasks across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure that can be streamlined through automation.

-

Build reusable automation for standardised configuration, reporting, monitoring, and remediation.

-

Improve the reliability and efficiency of customer environment management through automation and process standardisation.

-

Document automation solutions to ensure they are secure, maintainable, and accessible to the wider technical team.

6. Technical Leadership & Knowledge Development

-

Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 engineers, strengthening their troubleshooting capabilities and Microsoft platform knowledge.

-

Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.

-

Conduct peer reviews of technical changes, scripts, and configurations to ensure quality, consistency, and security.

-

Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives and contribute to the professional development of the Operations team.

-

Identify skills gaps and recommend opportunities to strengthen technical capabilities.

-

Promote technical ownership, proactive problem-solving, continuous improvement, and high-quality documentation.

7. Change Management & Technical Risk Assessment

-

Assess proposed technical changes across customer Microsoft environments, identifying security, availability, operational, and customer risks.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer to design, modernize, secure, and sustain systems and infrastructure supporting classified computing environments. This systems engineering focused role spans government cloud environments, including DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) and higher where appropriately authorized, classified cloud platforms, and on-premises classified systems. The engineer will develop secure hybrid connectivity, strengthen infrastructure automation, and support mission-critical operations in air-gapped, disconnected, and restricted-connectivity environments.

As a foundational member of the Cloud Networks team, you will assess inherited infrastructure, remediate architectural and operational deficiencies, and establish repeatable engineering and sustainment practices. You will partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, and Software Engineering to modernize systems while preserving mission availability and meeting applicable authorization requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assess, design, modernize, and sustain classified cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure; identify architectural deficiencies, technical debt, security gaps, and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

- Engineer government cloud infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments and appropriately authorized classified cloud platforms; implement secure connectivity, network segmentation, and integration with on-premises systems while respecting classification boundaries.

- Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools; maintain version-controlled infrastructure artifacts, standardized deployments, and repeatable operational workflows suitable for restricted environments.

- Design, deploy, and sustain Windows and Linux systems, virtualization, virtual desktop infrastructure, remote access services, and supporting platform components; integrate automation and internal tooling for provisioning, access management, and support.

- Establish hardened system images, configuration baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation processes, and compliance validation for endpoints, servers, and applicable containerized workloads, including controlled software delivery in air-gapped environments.

- Work directly with ISSMs, ISSOs, and Cybersecurity teams through JSIG or comparable authorization processes, including applicable RMF/DAAPM requirements; implement technical controls, document changes, support assessments, and maintain security evidence and approved baselines.

- Establish engineering and operational standards for change control, configuration management, monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, architectural documentation, and incident response to improve supportability and mission resilience.

- Partner with Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Program Management to deliver secure platform integrations, plan infrastructure migrations, remediate inherited deficiencies, and shape the modernization roadmap while minimizing mission disruption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI), including any required program-specific access approvals.

- Must possess or obtain and maintain a DoD 8140 compliant cybersecurity workforce qualification appropriate to the assigned role, including DOD 8570 IAT Level II equivalent certification requirements where applicable (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE or an approved equivalent.)

- Hands-on experience engineering or sustaining classified, air-gapped, disconnected, or similarly restricted government information systems.

- Experience working within JSIG or comparable classified system authorization processes, coordinating technical implementation and evidence with ISSMs/ISSOs; familiarity with applicable RMF and DAAPM requirements.

- Strong systems engineering and administration skills across Windows and Linux, enterprise virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure services.

- Hands-on experience engineering government cloud or hybrid infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments or appropriately authorized classified cloud services, and secure connectivity to on-premises systems.

- Experience modernizing existing infrastructure, diagnosing systemic technical issues, and delivering remediation with appropriate change control.

- Experience with system hardening, DISA STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, patch management, configuration baselines, and security control validation.

- Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management, including Terraform and Ansible, version-controlled IaC artifacts, and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools.

- Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, segmentation, and secure access.

- Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, and least-privilege principles.

- Ability to troubleshoot cross-domain infrastructure issues, document technical decisions, and collaborate with cybersecurity and engineering stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) and collateral classified environments, including working with ISSMs/ISSOs and government security stakeholders.

- Experience with AWS GovCloud, DoD IL5+ environments, appropriately authorized classified cloud services, or other government/private cloud platforms.

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure, remote application delivery, brokers, gateways, or related access services.

- Experience with endpoint/image management and automated compliance enforcement in environments without traditional Active Directory or Group Policy.

- Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, artifact management, and controlled deployment processes in restricted environments.

- Experience with infrastructure observability, centralized logging, resiliency, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.

- Experience creating scripts, APIs, or internal platform tools; familiarity with Go, Python, or comparable languages.

- Experience establishing technical standards and operating practices for a new or evolving engineering team.

US Salary Range

 $142,000 - $188,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

 - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

 - Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

 - Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

 - Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

 - Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

 - Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

 - Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

 - Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

 - Experience with OSquery and Santa

 - Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

 - Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote but if you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York or San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Summary

The DevOps Engineer supports and enhances SAU’s networking and server infrastructure, cloud solutions and software delivery through configuration management, device management, (CI/CD) pipelines, and cloud platform administration. This position ensures systems are robust, scalable, and secure while fostering collaboration between enterprise services and operations teams. The DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer also participates in optimizing IT delivery, supports security initiatives, cost optimization and high availability of services. Position is in-person on the campus of Spring Arbor University.

Key Duties:

Incident Management - Provide incident response support for cloud application issues and troubleshoot production issues. Escalate incidents as necessary. Identify, troubleshoot and correct applications issues to maintain high availability of services. Reinforces SLAs to manage end-user expectations.Security - Maintain effective security controls and analyze current security requirements to reduce SAU security posture. Analyze current security requirements and make suggestions for improvements toward the goal of a zero-trust model. Documentation- Develop and maintain design, configuration items, and troubleshooting documentation and develop and document procedures and best practices.CI/CD Pipeline Management Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Support build/test automation and continuous delivery practices.Cloud Platform Management Deploy, manage, and optimize cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP and Oracle), Monitor resource utilization and implement auto scaling and cost-control strategies.Monitoring & Incident Response - Implement system monitoring, alerting, and logging using various tools. Participate in incident resolution and post-incident reviews to improve system reliability.Security & Compliance Implement DevSecOps best practices including secrets management, access controls, and compliance monitoring. Ensure secure configuration of CI/CD pipelines, API Keys, containers, and infrastructure.

Project Management, Collaboration and Infrastructure Support

Assists in defining software development project plans, including scoping, scheduling, and implementation.Collaborates with other stakeholders in conceptualizing and developing and updating effective applications and applications.

Enterprise Solution Support

Support / Incident Management- Provide incident response support for break-fix issues and troubleshoot production issues. Escalate incidents as necessary. Identify, troubleshoot and correct applications issues to maintain high availability of services. Reinforces SLAs to manage end-user expectations and train SAU-IT Helpdesk to manage tier I and II service requests. Provide problem management reviews when necessary.Solution Maintenance - Be accountable for identification, implementation, testing and maintenance for cloud based solutions and on-prem applications and hosts.System Integrations - Manage data integrations between platforms and system; includes identity integration, data mapping between external systems, data flows, data quality and monitoring. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support system integration and connectivity needs.Security - Enforce security policies and procedures to protect application gateways (web, APIs) and data between systems.Documentation and Knowledge Management - Create and maintain documents that describe the processes, procedures, systems, and knowledge needed to support

Other Duties & Work Conditions

May be required to work some night and weekend hours to support upgrades or resolve an outage.On-call availability to support escalated incidents.Performs other duties as assigned to meet service objectives within IT.

Reporting Responsibilities

Reports to the Chief Information Officer.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

Desired: Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Experience with troubleshooting principles, methodologies, and issue resolution techniques.Solid working knowledge of current Internet technologies, including HTML, HTTP, REST.Web development experience.Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing protocols and VPN technologies.Hands-on experience developing test cases and test plans.SQL Relational database experience.

jobs.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.
HYBRID: Hybrid Work Arrangement: A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in-office time each month, beginning in late 2027.
HUB LOCATIONS: Bloomington, IL
SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

Responsibilities

The Infrastructure, Workplace, and Technology Services (IWTS) Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) Engineering team works across a large breadth of technologies allowing a unique learning opportunity amongst the team. IWTS Engineering teams have the freedom to focus on hands-on prototyping, research efforts, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) without day-to-day support obligations. IWTS Engineering teams are responsible for collaborating with ET product teams to understand and evaluate technical requirements that may result in infrastructure offering modifications. IWTS Engineering teams will work closely with the IWTS Service Delivery teams and a Managed Service Provider (MSP) to evaluate and validate proposed technical solutions and changes. IWTS Engineering teams will work closely with IWTS Area Level Architecture to identify areas of improvement, changes to architectural standards, and future state capability strategies. Additionally, IWTS Engineering teams work with the Project Support Office (PSO) as technical resources in validation of project estimates and requirements or as technical resources on defined projects.
The ideal candidate combines deep Windows Server expertise with a broad understanding of enterprise infrastructure and has demonstrated the ability to lead complex technical modernization initiatives, influence engineering direction, and collaborate across technology disciplines.
 As a member of the IWTS IaaS Engineering team, you will be challenged and empowered to grow professionally. We appreciate your interest in this role.

Qualifications

Required:

Advanced Windows Server engineering experience, including modernization, architecture, design, deployment, and troubleshooting of enterprise environments.Strong experience with Windows Server 2019, 2022, and/or 2025, including deployment, configuration, security, patching, upgrades, and performance.Experience with Active Directory modernization and Microsoft Entra ID integration, including hybrid identity, migration strategies, Group Policy, DNS, authentication, and enterprise directory architecture.Experience with Windows application packaging and enterprise software deployment modernization efforts.Strong scripting and automation skills for Windows Server provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.Knowledge of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and its potential impact on Windows Server, Active Directory, certificates, authentication, and encryption.Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across Windows Server and supporting infrastructure.Experience evaluating emerging technologies through hands-on engineering, prototyping, testing, and Proofs of Concept (POCs).Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and influence technical direction.Demonstrated commitment to mentoring and developing engineers, including sharing technical expertise, providing guidance on complex engineering challenges, and fostering continuous learning and growth across the team.Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including collaboration with technical teams, vendors, and external technology partners.Ability to professionally represent the company at industry conferences, technical events, vendor engagements, and other external forums.Preferred Skills:

Experience with enterprise virtualization platformsExperience with data center infrastructure and enterprise compute, including physical servers, hardware lifecycle, racks, power, cooling, cabling, and capacity planning.Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and GitOps, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and Git-based workflows.Experience with Microsoft Azure, hybrid cloud, and platform engineering concepts and practices.Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, and reporting to improve infrastructure performance, reliability, availability, and capacity management.Working knowledge of security, governance, risk management, and compliance principles and processes.Experience working across compute, virtualization, storage, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, and data center technologies.Experience collaborating with vendors, managed service providers, architecture, engineering, and operational teams.Demonstrated ability to foster innovation, encourage diverse perspectives, and incorporate new ideas into technical solutions and engineering practices.Relevant industry certifications in infrastructure, Microsoft technologies, cloud, virtualization, or related technical disciplines.Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week

Potential starting salary range: $110,000 - $160,000Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experienceHigh end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experiencePotential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salaryAt State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family

Get Paid On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.Stay Well Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much moreDevelop and Grow Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.Plan Ahead Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit UnionTake a Little “You” Time You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for youGive Back We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.Finish Strong Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and operational management of scalable, resilient, and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure, with secondary support for Azure environments.

Automation & IaC: Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to automate cloud provisioning, configuration management, patching, and deployments.

Migration & Modernization: Architect and execute enterprise cloud migration, application modernization, and continuous platform optimization strategies.

Platform & Reusability: Design and maintain standardized, reusable cloud platform templates and enterprise landing zones to accelerate secure team onboarding.

Operations & Governance: Establish enterprise cloud security standards, IAM best practices, compliance controls, governance policies, and operational workflows.

Disaster Recovery & Continuity: Design and implement comprehensive backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions across cloud workloads.

Troubleshooting & RCA: Resolve complex cloud networking, infrastructure, and application integration issues; perform root-cause analysis with a high sense of urgency and ownership.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Mentor junior cloud engineers, provide technical guidance across projects, and partner closely with DevOps, Security, Networking, and Application teams.

Qualifications

Overall IT Experience: 7+ years of broad IT background spanning systems architecture, infrastructure management, operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, and hybrid networking.

Hands-on Cloud Experience: 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing enterprise cloud infrastructure and applications.

AWS Expertise: Deep knowledge of core AWS services, including EC2, VPC, Route 53, ALB/NLB, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SSM, RDS, Lambda, and container services (ECS/EKS).

Multi-Cloud Familiarity: Practical working knowledge of Azure services, including Virtual Machines, VNETs, Azure Storage, IAM, and Azure Backup.

Scripting & CI/CD: Strong automation capabilities using PowerShell, Python, or Bash, along with experience managing Git-based source control and CI/CD pipelines.

Networking & Security: Solid understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, hybrid cloud connectivity, secrets management, and cloud security compliance controls.

Containers & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with containerization technologies and platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes.

Soft Skills: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, a self-motivated drive to work independently or in an integrated team environment, and strong problem-solving skills under tight SLAs.

jobs.description:
Classification Title:

End User Computing Spec III

Classification Minimum Requirements:

Associate's degree and four years of appropriate experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and 6 years of relevant experience. Appropriate college course work or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate of required experience.

Job Description:

**Nature of Work and Responsibility:**

The End User Support Specialist III is a hands-on technical support and systems-support position operating under the direct supervision of the IT Manager. The position does not supervise employees and does not have formal management responsibilities.

The position requires strong working knowledge of SCCM/Intune, JAMF, Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange and identity/access management, together with broad technical knowledge across end-user computing, endpoint management, hardware and software troubleshooting, networking, security, and enterprise technology services.

The employee is expected to independently resolve routine and moderately complex technical problems and provide a higher level of technical support for identity, access, endpoint, and user-computing issues. Unusual, highly complex, security-sensitive, or enterprise-level matters are coordinated with the IT Manager, other College IT personnel, or UFIT.

Success in this position requires strong customer service, technical problem-solving, adaptability, communication, documentation, and collaboration.

**Technology Automation and Deployment**

- Team Lead for endpoint management services, including operating system deployment, imaging, upgrades and migrations, software packaging and distribution, patch and update management, device provisioning and configuration, and endpoint security.
- Responsible for ensuring the reliable deployment, maintenance, security, and lifecycle management of College-managed computing devices while supporting a consistent and compliant user computing environment.
- Assists with development and maintenance of scripts, workflows, automation tools, and other processes that improve Active Directory administration, account management, endpoint management, software deployment, and IT support.
- Manages print infrastructure, including print servers, printer deployment, driver management, and print queue administration.
- Supports replacement, inventory, and retirement of College technology according to established University and College standards.
- Maintains expertise in workstation automation technologies by staying current with emerging industry trends, management platforms, hardware innovations, and software solutions. Evaluates new technologies and best practices to improve device deployment, management, security, and operational efficiency.

**Active Directory, Identity, Endpoint, and Security Support**

- Administers and supports the College’s Active Directory environment, including user and computer account management, organizational units, security groups, Group Policy, authentication services, permissions, and access controls. Ensures secure, reliable, and efficient access to College technology resources in accordance with University and College standards and best practices.
- Administers and supports user provisioning and access management for Active Directory-integrated services, including file services and shared mailboxes. Supports access administration for Exchange mailboxes and groups, Listservs, Lenel access controls, and other College resources. Ensures appropriate access is granted, modified, and removed in accordance with established security standards and business requirements.
- Troubleshoots authentication, authorization, permissions, Group Policy, directory synchronization, and other identity-related issues affecting College users and devices.

**Technical Support and Customer Service**

- Provides responsive technical support to College faculty, staff, researchers, students, and other stakeholders for computer hardware, software, operating systems, applications, peripherals, multimedia technologies, and University technology services.
- Troubleshoots and resolves hardware, software, configuration, authentication, connectivity, permissions, and other end-user technology issues. Identifies recurring problems and works with the IT Manager and other technical personnel to implement appropriate corrective or preventative solutions.
- Assists users with account access, authentication, permissions, software access, equipment configuration, and the effective use of College and University technology resources.
- Supports and administers College technology systems as assigned, including facility access technologies such as Lenel Access Control.
- Maintains accurate support records, technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge resources to support consistent and effective service delivery.

**Project Support, Documentation, and Collaboration**

- Supports IT projects and initiatives under the direction of the IT Manager, including technology requirements, implementation schedules, equipment deployment, testing, documentation, training, and communication.
- Develops and maintains technical documentation, procedures, work plans, training resources, status reports, and other materials associated with IT services and projects.
- Communicates project and service updates to the IT Manager and appropriate stakeholders and identifies issues requiring additional technical expertise, resources, or escalation.

Expected Salary:

$61,000 - $66,000

Required Qualifications:

Associate's degree and four years of appropriate experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and 6 years of relevant experience. Appropriate college course work or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate of required experience.

Preferred:

- Deep Familiarity with endpoint-management technologies including Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Jamf, and Group Policy.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, including user and computer objects, security groups, permissions, organizational structures, and Group Policy.
- Knowledge of identity and access management practices, including account provisioning, modification, offboarding, authentication, authorization, and access controls.
- Ability to assist with scripting, automation, and other tools that improve identity management, systems administration, endpoint management, and IT support.
- Knowledge of troubleshooting techniques for hardware, software, operating systems, applications, authentication, permissions, and network connectivity.
- Familiarity with Exchange-related services, file and print servers, listserv, Lenel access control, and other enterprise collaboration services.
- Familiarity with information-security practices, endpoint protection, encryption, software updates, access controls, backup, and recovery.
- Working knowledge of Windows and macOS environments, computer hardware, software, peripherals, and common enterprise technologies.
- Ability to support technology purchasing, equipment evaluation, technical specifications, and RFQ development.
- Ability to understand customer technology needs and assist in identifying and implementing appropriate solutions.
- Ability to manage multiple support needs and shift effectively among technical tasks and priorities.
- Strong customer-service and interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with the IT Manager, College IT personnel, faculty, staff, researchers, ETC, vendors, and University partners.
- Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation and recognize issues requiring escalation.

Special Instructions to Applicants:

In order to be considered, you must upload your cover letter and resume.

Application must be submitted by 11:55 p.m. (ET) of the posting end date.

This is a time-limited position.

Health Assessment Required:No

The Desktop Engineering System Administrator 1, with a team, assists to help support and maintain the Enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) environment for the LSU A&M campus. Responsibilities include managing existing application deployments, thin imaging, department on boarding and driver support for both on-premises and cloud based endpoints.

The position also assists with the operation, configuration, and maintenance of departmental servers, including Active Directory, Group Policy, certificate management, as well as file and print services. An intermediate understanding of Windows Server 2019 and higher is required.

Experience with VMware 8.x, Hyper-V, Veeam, and PowerShell without the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is preferred.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Utilize Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) to design, build, and maintain custom operating system images for deployment via PXE boot. Collaborate with campus departments to ensure images meet the needs of lab, department, and base system configurations across the university.

Develop and manage application deployments that support LSU academic departments, faculty, and staff, including software used in campus computer labs. (20%)

Responsible for the deployment, configuration, and management of Microsoft Intune and related Mobile Device Management (MDM) technologies such as Apple School Manager. Ensures secure, compliant, and efficient management of enterprise endpoints across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.

Routinely collaborates with ITS Security, Network and Server Infrastructure, and Desktop Support teams to implement and maintain endpoint standards, enforce security policies, and support overall IT operations to allow for end user productivity. (20%)

Collaborate with technical assets to support the student Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environment using Windows 365, ensuring 24/7 operational availability. Additionally, this would also include the management of VDI pools, imaging, application deployment, and licensing. (15%)

Responsible for the ongoing management of enterprise print services and related infrastructure with respect to student printing (Pharos). Assist in the maintenance and administration of the enterprise wide infrastructure, and escalate system anomalies to senior staff for analysis and resolution. Collaborate with the ITS Security team to deploy, manage, and maintain enterprise software and tools that support IT risk mitigation strategies. (10%)

Collaborate with staff and management to develop training materials, customer documentation, and deployment management standards. Create and maintain support articles and process documentation. (10%)

Provide Tier 3 support to desktop support analysts, ensuring consistent adoption and compliance with UECM standards across all departments. (10%)

Other duties as assigned. (5%)

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree with 1 year of experience. The ideal candidate will have at least one year of hands on experience with Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and/or Intune in an enterprise environment. Experience supporting macOS, iOS, and Android devices along with knowledge of Windows 365, Hyper-V and Linux (Debian and Red Hat Enterprise) operating systems.

jobs.description:
Carnegie Mellon University’s Information Security Office is seeking an **IT Security Engineer** to help investigate and respond to security incidents across a large, diverse, and technically complex university environment.

This is a hands-on security position with a strong focus on **incident response, digital forensics, security monitoring, and technical investigation**. You will use endpoint, network, application, identity, and other security data to determine what happened, understand the scope and impact of an incident, preserve and analyze evidence, contain threats, and help affected teams recover securely.

The environment is broad, and investigations frequently involve unfamiliar systems or technologies. One incident may require analyzing an endpoint compromise, another may involve reconstructing activity from network traffic and logs, while another may require learning enough about an application, operating system, or protocol to understand unexpected behavior.

**You do not need to be an expert in every technology or security discipline described in this posting.** We are looking for strong technical fundamentals, investigative ability, curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems when an investigation requires it.

If you enjoy understanding how systems work beneath the surface, following evidence until you can explain what happened, considering systems from both attacker and defender perspectives, or building tools to answer questions that existing products cannot, you may be a strong fit for this team.

**What You’ll Do:**

A significant portion of this position is dedicated to security incident response and digital forensics. Responsibilities include:

- Monitor and investigate alerts generated by network, endpoint, vulnerability, logging, and other security systems.

- Triage reported or suspected security events and determine whether they represent security incidents.

- Conduct technical investigations using endpoint artifacts, network traffic, system and application logs, identity information, and other available evidence.

- Determine the likely root cause, scope, timeline, and impact of security incidents.

- Perform or assist with host and network forensic analysis.

- Identify affected systems, accounts, data, and infrastructure and recommend appropriate containment, eradication, and recovery actions.

- Work directly with system administrators, network engineers, developers, application owners, researchers, and other members of the university community during investigations.

- Clearly communicate technical findings, risk, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Maintain accurate investigation records, evidence, timelines, findings, and incident documentation.

- Collect and preserve digital evidence in support of security investigations and authorized legal matters.

- Assist with E-Discovery, evidence preservation, chain-of-custody procedures, and other forensic requests when directed by university leadership or the Office of General Counsel.

- Participate in a shared 24x7 on-call rotation supporting security monitoring, incident response, and security infrastructure.

The position also contributes to the broader work of the Information Security Office. Depending on team needs, current priorities, and your areas of expertise, this may include:

- Supporting vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management services.

- Helping campus organizations understand and remediate security vulnerabilities.

- Supporting endpoint security, endpoint detection and response, certificate authority, public key infrastructure, and data protection services.

- Monitoring, configuring, evaluating, and improving systems used for security detection, investigation, assessment, and response.

- Evaluating emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security threats for relevance to Carnegie Mellon’s environment.

- Conducting or assisting with authorized security assessments and penetration testing of systems, networks, applications, and services.

- Providing security guidance and technical consulting to teams across the university.

- Researching, testing, and recommending new security tools and techniques.

- Developing scripts, utilities, integrations, or other automation that make investigations and security operations more effective.

- Creating documentation, technical guidance, and security communications.

- Participating in other Information Security Office projects as needed.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, technical training, professional certifications, and relevant experience.

- Three or more years of relevant technical experience in information security, information technology, systems administration, networking, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, digital forensics, or a related technical discipline.

- Hands-on experience with one or more major operating system environments such as Linux, Windows, or macOS.

- Understanding of fundamental networking, operating system, and application concepts.

- Ability to investigate technical problems methodically by gathering evidence, developing hypotheses, testing assumptions, and documenting conclusions.

- Ability to analyze logs, system information, network activity, or other technical telemetry.

- Ability to evaluate security threats and vulnerabilities in the context of a real environment.

- Strong technical problem-solving skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively with people representing a wide range of technical backgrounds.

- Sound judgment when handling sensitive information and security incidents.

- Ability to independently perform routine duties after appropriate onboarding and training and to recognize when additional expertise or escalation is required.

Direct professional experience in every area covered by this position is not required. Candidates with strong backgrounds in systems, networking, software, infrastructure, or other technical disciplines who can demonstrate security aptitude and investigative ability are encouraged to apply.

**Experience That Would Be Helpful**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:

- **Incident response and digital forensics**, including host or network forensics, endpoint investigation, security monitoring, log analysis, threat hunting, malware analysis, or related investigative work.

- **Systems and network engineering**, including Windows, Linux, macOS, TCP/IP networking, authentication systems, enterprise infrastructure, virtualization, cloud environments, or storage technologies.

- **Security operations**, including endpoint detection and response, SIEM, network security monitoring, vulnerability management, certificate management, or data protection technologies.

- **Security assessment**, including vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, application security, or evaluating systems from an adversarial perspective.

- **Automation and software development**, including using Python, PowerShell, shell scripting, Go, Ruby, Perl, Java, C, C++, or other languages to process data, automate workflows, or create technical tools.

- **Digital evidence and legal support**, including E-Discovery, evidence preservation, chain of custody, subpoena response, or interaction with law enforcement.

- Working in higher education, research, or another large and decentralized computing environment.

**Depth in one or more technical areas is more important than superficial experience with every technology listed above.**

Candidates who have developed relevant skills through professional work, independent research, home labs, open-source projects, capture-the-flag competitions, security research, academic work, or other substantive hands-on activities are encouraged to describe that experience.

Professional certifications such as CISSP, GSEC, GCFE, or other security and technology certifications are welcomed but are not required.

**How We Work**

**Curiosity matters here.** Strong candidates tend to want to understand why systems behave the way they do. They are comfortable starting with incomplete information, asking good questions, testing hypotheses, digging beneath product interfaces, and considering how a system might behave differently from what its designers intended.

We value people who can combine that curiosity with careful technical reasoning and sound judgment. Security investigations may involve production systems, sensitive data, legal matters, or significant service impact, so creativity must be balanced with appropriate caution and communication.

We also value engineers who look for ways to improve how work is performed. That may mean automating a repetitive task, creating a better investigative workflow, developing a small utility, integrating data from multiple systems, or identifying a more effective way to answer an investigative question.

No security engineer knows every technology they will encounter. The ability to recognize a gap in your knowledge, research the problem, experiment appropriately, and apply what you learn is an important part of this role.

**Accountability and Decision Making**

The IT Security Engineer plays an important role in the timely identification, containment, investigation, and prevention of computer and network security incidents.

After an appropriate period of onboarding and training, the engineer is expected to independently handle routine investigations and operational responsibilities. This includes evaluating the severity of security alerts, selecting appropriate investigative techniques, recommending containment or remediation actions, and determining when an issue should be escalated.

Significant incidents, sensitive data exposures, major service disruptions, legal matters, notification decisions, and other unusual or sensitive situations are handled collaboratively with senior staff, the Incident Response Coordinator, management, and other university stakeholders as appropriate.

**On-Call and Other Position Requirements**

This position participates in a shared **24x7 on-call rotation** for security monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure support. On-call responsibilities may occasionally require work outside normal business hours or travel to campus.

The position involves access to sensitive security, investigative, institutional, and potentially legally protected information. Appropriate judgment, discretion, and professionalism are essential.

The successful candidate must qualify as a **U.S. person** under the applicable requirements governing this position.

This position does not have formal supervisory responsibilities.

**Professional Development:**

Continued learning is an expected part of the position. Engineers are encouraged to remain current with security technologies, attack techniques, investigative methods, vulnerabilities, and changes in the broader security community through technical research, training, conferences, professional communities, internal knowledge sharing, and independent experimentation.

If you meet the core qualifications and believe your technical background, investigative ability, and curiosity would allow you to succeed in this role, **we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every preferred qualification listed above.**

Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

**Job Description** We are looking for a**Specialist IT Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
* Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

**Software Deployment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.

#### What You'll Do

- Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning
- Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path
- Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11
- Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not
- Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them
- Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access
- Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization
- Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout
- Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget
- Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service

#### Responsibilities

- Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows
- Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints
- Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle
- Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space
- Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management
- Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support
- Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service

#### Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
- 8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers
- Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones
- Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent
- A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery
- Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts
- A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path
- Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively
- Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows
- Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives
- Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
- Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
- There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel

#### Preferred Qualifications

- Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification
- Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swiftDialog, or osquery
- Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs
- Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design
- Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs
- Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale
- Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers

#### Success Measures

- In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight
- In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment
- In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed

#### Location & Travel:

- This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
- The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week
- This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives

#### About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our [Leadership Commitment,](https://www.mongodb.com/company) guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. [From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy](https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb), we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. [Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture), and help us make an impact on the world!
