jobs.title: Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer
jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer to design, modernize, secure, and sustain systems and infrastructure supporting classified computing environments. This systems engineering focused role spans government cloud environments, including DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) and higher where appropriately authorized, classified cloud platforms, and on-premises classified systems. The engineer will develop secure hybrid connectivity, strengthen infrastructure automation, and support mission-critical operations in air-gapped, disconnected, and restricted-connectivity environments.

As a foundational member of the Cloud Networks team, you will assess inherited infrastructure, remediate architectural and operational deficiencies, and establish repeatable engineering and sustainment practices. You will partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, and Software Engineering to modernize systems while preserving mission availability and meeting applicable authorization requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assess, design, modernize, and sustain classified cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure; identify architectural deficiencies, technical debt, security gaps, and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

- Engineer government cloud infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments and appropriately authorized classified cloud platforms; implement secure connectivity, network segmentation, and integration with on-premises systems while respecting classification boundaries.

- Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools; maintain version-controlled infrastructure artifacts, standardized deployments, and repeatable operational workflows suitable for restricted environments.

- Design, deploy, and sustain Windows and Linux systems, virtualization, virtual desktop infrastructure, remote access services, and supporting platform components; integrate automation and internal tooling for provisioning, access management, and support.

- Establish hardened system images, configuration baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation processes, and compliance validation for endpoints, servers, and applicable containerized workloads, including controlled software delivery in air-gapped environments.

- Work directly with ISSMs, ISSOs, and Cybersecurity teams through JSIG or comparable authorization processes, including applicable RMF/DAAPM requirements; implement technical controls, document changes, support assessments, and maintain security evidence and approved baselines.

- Establish engineering and operational standards for change control, configuration management, monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, architectural documentation, and incident response to improve supportability and mission resilience.

- Partner with Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Program Management to deliver secure platform integrations, plan infrastructure migrations, remediate inherited deficiencies, and shape the modernization roadmap while minimizing mission disruption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI), including any required program-specific access approvals.

- Must possess or obtain and maintain a DoD 8140 compliant cybersecurity workforce qualification appropriate to the assigned role, including DOD 8570 IAT Level II equivalent certification requirements where applicable (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE or an approved equivalent.)

- Hands-on experience engineering or sustaining classified, air-gapped, disconnected, or similarly restricted government information systems.

- Experience working within JSIG or comparable classified system authorization processes, coordinating technical implementation and evidence with ISSMs/ISSOs; familiarity with applicable RMF and DAAPM requirements.

- Strong systems engineering and administration skills across Windows and Linux, enterprise virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure services.

- Hands-on experience engineering government cloud or hybrid infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments or appropriately authorized classified cloud services, and secure connectivity to on-premises systems.

- Experience modernizing existing infrastructure, diagnosing systemic technical issues, and delivering remediation with appropriate change control.

- Experience with system hardening, DISA STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, patch management, configuration baselines, and security control validation.

- Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management, including Terraform and Ansible, version-controlled IaC artifacts, and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools.

- Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, segmentation, and secure access.

- Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, and least-privilege principles.

- Ability to troubleshoot cross-domain infrastructure issues, document technical decisions, and collaborate with cybersecurity and engineering stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) and collateral classified environments, including working with ISSMs/ISSOs and government security stakeholders.

- Experience with AWS GovCloud, DoD IL5+ environments, appropriately authorized classified cloud services, or other government/private cloud platforms.

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure, remote application delivery, brokers, gateways, or related access services.

- Experience with endpoint/image management and automated compliance enforcement in environments without traditional Active Directory or Group Policy.

- Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, artifact management, and controlled deployment processes in restricted environments.

- Experience with infrastructure observability, centralized logging, resiliency, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.

- Experience creating scripts, APIs, or internal platform tools; familiarity with Go, Python, or comparable languages.

- Experience establishing technical standards and operating practices for a new or evolving engineering team.

US Salary Range

 $142,000 - $188,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Job Description:Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.

Department OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Endpoint Detection and Response Engineer III to join our Cybersecurity Endpoint Protection team, focused on building and sustaining enterprise‑grade endpoint protection capabilities at global scale. This role emphasizes engineering rigor, platform reliability, and thoughtful implementation of endpoint security controls that reduce risk while enabling business operations. The Engineer III collaborates closely with Detection Engineering and other cybersecurity and technology teams to ensure endpoint controls generate high‑fidelity telemetry and integrate effectively into detection and response workflows. This role contributes hands‑on expertise, continuous improvement, and durable solutions across McDonald’s endpoint ecosystem.

DutiesEngineer, configure, and operate endpoint protection platforms and controls in alignment with established standards and architectures. Assist in the continuous improvement and operational stability of endpoint protection services. Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering to ensure endpoint telemetry supports high-quality detection use cases. Implement preventative and hardening controls that reduce endpoint risk while maintaining business usability. Contribute technical input into design discussions and improvement initiatives Develop and maintain automation, scripts, and tooling to improve consistency and operational efficiency. Troubleshoot complex endpoint protection issues and provide advanced technical support when escalated. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures related to endpoint protection controls. Stay informed of emerging endpoint threats, trends, and technologies and share insights with the team. Qualifications5+ years of experience in cybersecurity with a strong focus on endpoint protection engineering or operations. Hands-on experience with enterprise endpoint protection or EDR/XDR platforms.Strong knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux endpoint operating systems. Experience implementing and operating security controls at enterprise scale. Proficiency in scripting or automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. Solid understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and models such as NIST, CIS Controls, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience and ability to participate in a 24x7x365 team. Analyze sophisticated issues, detail their impact on the business, resolve their root causes, and identify corrective actions to prevent similar future events. Super interpersonal skills, able to correspond with collaborators promptly and with attention to detail, vitality, and thoroughness to all levels of the organization. Experience handling third-party vendors and service providers. Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise scale endpoint protection and app control products across diverse global environments and operating systems.Demonstrated experience securing nontraditional and emerging endpoint platforms, including IoT devices, cloud hosted workloads, virtual machines, and containerized environments across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI). Experience supporting or enabling blue, purple, or red team activities through endpoint control engineering, telemetry improvements, and detection enablement. Advanced proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to operationalize controls, improve reliability, and reduce manual effort through engineering led solutions. Strong experience integrating and extending security platforms via APIs, including REST and GraphQL, to enable automation, reporting, and ecosystem interoperability. Proven ability to integrate endpoint protection platforms with IT Service Management systems (e.g., ServiceNow) to support operational workflows and escalation paths. Experience leveraging data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) to analyze endpoint trends, surface risk signals, and communicate technical insights effectively. Working knowledge of the ITIL operating model, with an understanding of how endpoint protection engineering supports broader service operations. Experience operating within Agile delivery models, contributing engineering work through iterative planning and execution. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or equivalent advanced security or engineering credentials. Salary RangeThe expected salary range for this role is $138,207.00 - $172,758.00 USD per year

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors.

Additional Information:

Benefits eligible: This position offers health and welfare benefits, including but not limited to comprehensive health insurance, which includes medical, prescription drug, mental health, dental and vision coverage, as well as, life insurance.

Bonus eligible: This position is eligible for a bonus, calculated based on individual and company performance.

Long term Incentive eligible: This position is eligible for stock or other equity grants pursuant to McDonald’s long-term incentive plan.

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Position Summary

 Serve as the senior escalation point for complex desktop, endpoint, and mobile device support issues, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and service delivery. Administer and support enterprise endpoint management platforms, including Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Azure Active Directory, WSUS, and JAMF. Package, test, deploy, and maintain applications, operating systems, software updates, device policies, and endpoint configurations across Windows, Mac, and mobile environments. Manage corporate and BYOD devices, providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, compliance, and lifecycle management. Partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate user needs, recommend cost-effective technology solutions, create technical documentation, and follow established change management processes.

Desired Professional Skills And Experience

 3+ years of experience as System Administrator responsible for a system supporting 100 users or more, preferably in the healthcare environment JAMF and Mac experience is required for this position Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred; or equivalent combination of industry related professional experience and education Advanced expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy, Windows desktop/server administration, and enterprise endpoint support . Strong knowledge of networking and remote connectivity , including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, and troubleshooting distributed environments. Experience managing security technologies and IT operations , including firewalls, anti-virus, anti-spam solutions, help desk ticketing systems, and delivering exceptional customer service.

Why Radiology Partners

 Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from. Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities Flexible Remote Schedules Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years

For More Information

In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

jobs.description:
*Position Title:

Deskside Technician – End User Computing

*JOB DESCRIPTION

(CONTRACT JOB: Renewable once in every 3 months)

The position of Deskside Technician – End User Computing performs troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance of end user computing equipment and peripheral equipment at corporate locations.

The candidate works on assignments of a diverse scope where analysis of data and hardware requires evaluation of identifiable factors. The candidate exercises judgment with supervision within the generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions and acts as a liaison between customers, departments, and within the organization to lead problem resolution.

Any incumbent in this position is expected to perform all the duties of this job description at a minimum level of satisfaction as determined by this position's ADSL managers and/or the ADSL client(s) this position may be assigned to support. If the incumbent is given a separate job description or a different protocol/guideline or expectation by an ADSL client, the incumbent will immediately notify this position’s immediate manager at ADSL so that the ADSL manager can ensure the ADSL and client job descriptions are compatible and aligned. The incumbent in this position understands that the "at will" employment relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees also applies to the assignment of the incumbent to an ADSL client. Therefore, the incumbent understands that an ADSL client may end the incumbent's assignment with the client at any time and at the ADSL client's sole discretion. In such cases, ADSL's continued employment of the incumbent in this position will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis and be further subject to ADSL's business needs and the terms of the "at-will" relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees.

Required Skills and abilities (For any questions, please contact INF_Leadership.)

· Managing work queues in Service Now.

· Attend daily Team meetings.

· Assist in coverage support for PTO and sick days.

· Prioritize tickets accordingly (P1’s, P2s, Break/Fix, VIP, escalated and expedited incidents and tasks).

· Good working knowledge of MS Windows versions 10 and 11 and experience troubleshooting the same.

· Experience troubleshooting network printers.

· Resolving hardware issues for desktops and laptops including Break / Fix.

· Support of Desktops, Laptops and mobile devices including Windows, Apple, and Android.

· Troubleshooting and diagnosing various technical issues.

· Installing and maintaining the company’s software and equipment using tools such as SCCM.

· Re-imaging devices when necessary.

· Troubleshooting various technology issues.

· Helping new employees to set up their workstation.

· Preventative maintenance tasks on machines with low health scores in Systrack.

· Assisting other teams with gathering information such as rack space, cabling, or pictures as needed.

· Creating and updating Knowledge base articles (KB’s) and Standard operation processes (SOP’s).

· Excellent English and communication skills

· Assessing and understanding user needs and issues.

· Answering general questions presented by our customers.

· All other tasks as assigned.

· Daily duty details

CUSTOMER SERVICE

· One of the most important responsibilities that deskside support technicians have is providing personal support services. They must build rapport and obtain problem details from help desk customers. They politely take incoming requests for help from end users through the Service Now ticketing system.

PROBLEM-SOLVING

· Deskside support technicians take initiative and ownership of reported end-user problems. They use diagnostic tools to identify root problems. Once the issue is identified, deskside support technicians process these incidents through an incident management process.

DELIVER HARDWARE AND APPLICATION SUPPORT

· When end users need technical support with desktops, laptops, tablets, workstation devices, mobile devices, printers, and software, they turn to deskside support. These technicians then diagnose and solve unique one-time problems. To complete this, they reimage systems and engage in computer networking. Deskside support technicians also work with purchasing staff to buy replacement hardware and software as needed.

ASSIST OTHER TEAMS

· Deskside technicians are occasionally called up to lend support to other technical towers. This may require going into server rooms, network closets or other locations to assist.

INSTALL SOFTWARE UPGRADES

· Deskside support workers complete hands-on fixes for desktops and laptops that include software installations and upgrades. They perform file backups and configure new systems and applications. After completing installations, deskside support workers test new computers according to established guidelines.

CREATE AND MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION

· Documentation is a major requirement for deskside support. They record, track, and write notes for the help desk problem-solving process, including decision outcomes, actions taken, and final resolutions. Deskside support technicians are often required to submit accurate call logs itemizing customer interactions.

APPLICATION MIGRATION & REPACKAGING

· Inventory SCCM-deployed applications by exporting the list of applications, versions, and deployment types

· Identify Intune-compatible formats, flagging MSI, EXE, and script-based installers that need conversion to Intune

· Repackage applications using the Microsoft Win32 Content Prep Tool to create Intune files, and validate silent install/uninstall commands

· Test application deployments in pilot groups, validating install success, detection rules, and rollback

· Document application metadata, including publisher, version, install command, detection method, and related details

ENROLLMENT & POLICY TESTING

· Enroll test devices via Autopilot or manual enrollment, validating device join type (Azure AD joined vs. hybrid)

· Apply pilot configuration profiles and test compliance policies, device restrictions, and security settings

· Verify Conditional Access behavior to ensure policies trigger correctly based on device state

· Log and report enrollment errors, capturing screenshots and logs for troubleshooting

· Perform device imaging and OS updates for desktops and laptops following customer standard procedures

END USER COORDINATION

· Schedule pilot user testing sessions, coordinating with selected users to validate app access, device behavior, and policy enforcement

· Create user-friendly, step-by-step guides for enrollment, app access, and common issues

· Collect feedback from pilot users using forms or Teams surveys to gather usability and performance insights

· Provide Tier 1 onsite support to Authorized Users during migration, assisting with enrollment issues, app failures, and basic troubleshooting, and to meet specified SLAs

· Utilize existing customer Knowledge Base to resolve incidents and tasks associated with EUC equipment

· Remote support tooling including BeyondTrust; Bomgar; TeamViewer, etc

SECURITY & COMPLIANCE CHECKS

· Verify BitLocker and Defender status post-enrollment

· Ensure FIPS and TPM settings align with compliance policies

· Confirm device tagging and group membership in Intune

· Security responsibilities including Defender; MDM enrollment; BitLocker handling; Phishing response

REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION

· Update the migration tracker, logging completed repackaging, test results, and deployment status

· Maintain an issue/resolution log, tracking recurring problems and fixes for future reference

· Assist with the Power BI dashboard

· Utilize customer provided ITSM ticketing systems with regular updates and proper hygiene applied to all tickets

· Update CMDB with asset allocation and de-allocation details following customer standard procedures

· Provide regular, accurate, and timely feedback regarding customer requirements and maintain timely communication with operations and project personnel

· Excellent written communication and customer service skills with ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical team and customers

· Intune migration support and other duties as required

*JOB REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

· Requires 3+ years of related work experience

· Knowledge of imaging tools (SCCM, MDT)

· Knowledge of data backup and recovery tools

· Installing, upgrading, and migrating to Windows 10/11

· Deploying Windows 10/11 in large enterprises

· Configuring hardware and applications

· Configuring network connectivity

· Configuring access to resources

· Configuring mobile computing

· Monitoring and maintaining systems that run Windows 10/11

· Configuring backup and recovery options

Certifications:

· A+ Certification a plus

Pay: $26.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

 Desktop support: 4 years (Required)
 SCCM: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose
The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities
• Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.
• Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions.
• Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams.
• Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies.
• Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments.
• Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives.
• Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills
Minimum education:

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.Required Qualifications:
• At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience.
• 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms.
• 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations.
• 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other required technical skills:
• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
• Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management.
• Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices.
• Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements.
• Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
• Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

Highly desirables:
• Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.

Position Summary

Security Engineer responsible for Vanguard's endpoint security platforms and operational services. This role serves as an architect-like technical leader within the endpoint security space, partnering with security, engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to lead the technical direction, architecture, and strategy for our endpoint security products. jobs.description:
The Team
Jisc operates through several specialist directorates, each driving key areas of our work. This role sits within our Group CTO directorate, the hub for innovation, technology leadership, and the development of new digital products that support our members today and in the future. Most of our technical expertise lives here, giving us the capability to deliver Jisc’s digital vision with impact and ambition.

Within the Group CTO directorate, the Workplace IT department provides essential technology services to colleagues and visitors. You’ll be joining our Service Desk team, whose mission—guided by ITIL principles—is to maintain normal operations, respond to user requests, and resolve incidents and problems across a range of services and configuration items.

The role:
We’re looking for a motivated and customer focused individual to provide first line IT support through our shared Workplace IT service desk. As the first point of contact, you’ll play a key role in:

Delivering exceptional customer service to internal users and external visitors
Providing initial IT fault diagnosis and troubleshooting
Supporting installation, configuration, and maintenance of IT and video‑conferencing equipment
Contributing across the full ITIL lifecycle—from Service Design to Continuous Improvement

What you’ll be doing:
As an IT Service Desk Analyst, you’ll play a vital role in delivering high-quality first line support and keeping our technology services running smoothly. In this role, you will:

Manage and triage all incoming tickets through our IT Service Management (ITSM) platform
Accurately identify, categorise, prioritise, diagnose, and manage Incidents and Service Requests
Communicate clearly and professionally with users at every stage of their request or incident
Provide coordination support across technical and administrative tasks to ensure service delivery
Help diagnose and resolve first line IT incidents and service requests
Learn and develop toward becoming a first-class IT Engineer through training, documentation, and hands on experience
Build strong analytical skills to assess performance, understand user needs, and recommend solutions
Deliver excellent customer service, always putting the user experience first
Provide support in person, via email, and over the phone, including remote support tools
Escalate issues to team members or other departments when required
Maintain IT user accounts in line with access control and account management policies
Support and maintain video‑conference technologies
Install and configure software and hardware in compliance with technical standards
Contribute to the development and upkeep of our IT technical knowledge base

What we are looking for:
 We’re looking for someone who brings a strong customer focused approach and a genuine interest in developing their IT expertise. You’ll ideally have:
Level A – Essential

Experience working in a customer facing environment
An understanding of a range of end-user devices and operating systems

Level B – Desirable

Deeper experience across all Level A requirements
Proven delivery of 10+ tasks from the key deliverables for this role
Hands‑on experience installing and configuring IT software and hardware
Experience delivering high-quality, ITIL aligned services via a service desk
Practical experience using an ITSM (IT Service Management) system
Experience working with electronic record management systems, such as:

HR systems
Asset management systems
SaaS administration portals

Experience providing IT support both in person and remotely
Experience maintaining and operating video‑conferencing equipment
Ability to deliver the remaining tasks outlined in the key deliverables section
Understanding of core networking concepts, including firewalls, routers, and switches

Qualifications
Level A
None
Level B
Evidence of professional development
One or more of the following:

Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals AZ900
Microsoft Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate MD102
Industry recognised certification in one or more core technologies used by Jisc

Don’t meet every single requirement?
We know that sometimes people can be put off applying for a job if they think they can’t tick every box, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements, but if you feel this role is perfect for you. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

Why work for us?
At Jisc, every role is meaningful, and every individual is valued. We foster a culture of continuous learning and personal growth, offering opportunities to develop new skills and make a real impact in education and research. With a strong focus on work-life balance, we embrace flexible working that prioritises outcomes over hours, empowering you to create a rhythm that energises both your professional and personal life.

Our Guiding Principles:
Jisc’s culture is powered by our four guiding principles: putting customers first, driving innovation, creating impact, and championing inclusive collaboration to deliver sustainable outcomes and shape a better future.

Discover the amazing benefits we provide! Here’s what you can look forward to:

Flexible work pattern, which can adapt to suit your schedules and personal commitments
31 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) that includes three closure days over Christmas
Buy up to an additional 5 days leave during the flexible benefits window
Generous flexible pension schemes
A range of wellbeing lifestyle benefits including company paid health care cash plan, mental health first aiders and support
A company culture of continuous learning with access to thousands of LinkedIn Learning courses, and lots of resources and opportunities to support your development
Allocated allowance of up to £250 to equip your home office
Financial well-being support including access to preferential loan and savings plans, mortgage advice, will writing tools and support and resources to help you make the most of your money
A wide range of discounts and cashback from retailers and big-name high-street stores
Family friendly policies including enhanced parental, maternity and paternity and co-parental leave as well as opportunity for career breaks
Support your volunteering with up to 3 days volunteer leave

Equity, diversity and inclusion:
Jisc believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging.

We work hard to create an equitable experience for our candidates and workforce which embraces all aspects of their identity including race and ethnicity, religion and belief, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, trans identities, age, class, disability, neurodivergence, or veteran status.

Application process:
Please let us know how we can best accommodate you throughout the recruitment process. We’re committed to making our process accessible and comfortable for everyone - just tell us what works best for you.

Just so you know, we review CVs as soon as we can and aim to provide an update on your application within 4 weeks of receiving it. However, you may hear from us a lot sooner, so please keep an eye out for our emails or calls!

We’re really looking forward to getting to know the real you. While we encourage the use of AI tools to help you get started on your CV or cover letter, we encourage you to review your application before submitting. Make sure it truly reflects your own voice, experiences, and personality.

If you are currently a Jisc employee, please apply through your Dayforce Employee profile.

We have a thorough background screening process that verifies the details you share with us in your CV and your application. Any inaccurate information supplied during the application stages can lead to a job offer being withdrawn.

Sponsorship:
 Please note that this role is not eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. This decision is based on current Home Office eligibility criteria, which require specific conditions to be met in terms of job type, salary level, and other factors. As such, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this position.

Company Description

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for a**Specialist IT Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
* Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

**Software Deployment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
* Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
* Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* A high level of **English**is required (C1)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

* Actuar como punto técnico de referencia para los equipos de IT locales, resolviendo incidencias y afinando la configuración.
* Documentar procedimientos, best practices y sesiones de transferencia de conocimiento para la gestión sostenible del entorno.

* Experiencia con **SCCM/MECM** y migraciones a Intune en entornos híbridos.
* **PowerShell** para automatización, con experiencia en parques de **varios miles de dispositivos** y entornos **multipaís**.

* **Inglés fluido para un entorno internacional (mínimo C1): tendrás reuniones y despliegues en inglés de forma habitual. Español fluido.**
* Perfil **freelance/autónomo**, con disponibilidad para la presencialidad puntual en Madrid.

**Se valora**

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. As the team grows you will lead it technically, and there is a clear path into formal technical leadership of the software function for someone who wants it.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as technical lead for the classified software and platform team: own the architecture of the application portfolio, set the standards the team builds to, and make the tradeoff calls.

- Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

- Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

- Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

- Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

- Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

- Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

- Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

- Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

- Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

- Experience leading technical work: owning a system's architecture, reviewing the designs and code of others, setting direction for a small team, and communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.

- Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.

- Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

- Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.

- Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.

- Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.

- Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

- Experience as a tech lead or founding engineer on a product team, including establishing engineering practices from scratch, onboarding new engineers, and interviewing and hiring software engineers.

US Salary Range

 $167,000 - $222,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

### Responsibilities

- Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy
- Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team's config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
- Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from
- Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach
- Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program
- Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls
- Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends
- Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state
- Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions
- Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices
- Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium
- Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant
- Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment
- Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices
- Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting
- Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM
- Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams
- Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries
- Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
- Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners
- View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
- Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

### Strong candidates may also

- Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles
- Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets
- Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams
- Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

### Technical Skills

- Python and shell scripting
- ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise
- Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting
- Android Enterprise management (working knowledge)
- Querying live device state at fleet scale
- GitOps and CI for configuration management
- Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$325,000—$360,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive.

About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Reporting to the Enterprise Service Delivery Manager (SDM), the Enterprise Endpoint Specialist is a hands-on operational role within managed services, responsible for the day-to-day delivery of Microsoft endpoint managed services across multiple enterprise clients. The role owns investigation, recurring service execution, standard administration and remediation, ticket progression, reporting inputs, client follow-through, and evidence-based escalation across Microsoft Intune and related endpoint technologies. Endpoint and Intune remain the anchor of the role, with defined operational coverage across Azure, Azure Security, Entra, Microsoft 365, and transactional CSP. The specialist works alongside the Endpoint Solutions Architect, who provides architecture, standards, complex engineering, and advanced escalation. This role requires a working understanding of how endpoint management interacts with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, Azure dependencies, and Microsoft 365, so that issues are investigated accurately and routed to the correct technical owner. This position remains directly involved in day-to-day service delivery, including incident response, escalation handling, troubleshooting, reporting, and change execution within client-specific change controls. It is a hands-on managed-service execution role rather than an architecture, presales, or project delivery position.

Responsibilities:

Endpoint and Intune Operations

- Operate and support Microsoft Intune across multiple managed-service clients.

- Investigate enrollment, Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update policies, encryption, device security, and endpoint performance issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.

- Deploy, configure, and test mobile device management policies for iOS and Android, and support clients through rollout and ongoing policy changes.

- Review endpoint health, operating-system currency, patch compliance, Office update status, Defender status, BitLocker status, device compliance, startup performance, and application reliability where included in client scope.

- Perform approved standard platform changes, testing, and remediation in accordance with client-specific change controls and documented procedures.

- Coordinate investigation and remediation of endpoint vulnerabilities, failed patches, non-compliant devices, and configuration exceptions.

Azure, Azure Security, and Entra Operations

- Provide initial investigation and standard operational support for assigned Azure, Azure Security, and Entra requests.

- Review relevant monitoring, resource-health, alert, access, identity, and configuration information to establish the issue, impact, and correct technical path.

- Perform approved standard administration and remediation using documented procedures and client-specific change controls.

- Coordinate Microsoft support cases and escalate architecture, complex engineering, security design, and material risk decisions to the Azure and Security Architect.

Modern Workplace (M365) Support

- Investigate assigned Microsoft 365 operational requests within the team’s documented service scope.

- Resolve standard administrative and support issues within capability and access, and escalate advanced workload-specific matters through the established Modern Workplace path.

- Maintain ownership of ticket status, evidence, client communication, and follow-through until resolution or formal reassignment.

Transactional CSP Support

- Execute authorized standard license transactions after training and documented client approval.

- Initiate Microsoft support requests for eligible clients and maintain the required transaction and case records.

- Escalate licensing advisory, pricing exceptions, renewals, non-standard commercial requests, and broader CSP matters to the responsible CSP resource.

Managed Service Delivery, Reporting, and Escalation

- Own assigned incidents, service requests, recurring activities, and remediation actions through resolution or evidence-based escalation.

- Prepare and validate technical inputs for recurring client service reports and operational reviews.

- Interpret what the reporting data shows, and explain exceptions, risk, recommendations, owners, and next steps in clear business language.

- Escalate complex cases with a clear problem statement, business impact, investigation completed, logs and evidence, changes attempted, results, and a specific request for assistance.

- Identify when work requires architectural review, another team, or scope and commercial validation.

- Maintain accurate technical notes, evidence, test results, client updates, and handoff information in the ticketing system.

Requirements:

- Five or more years of relevant hands-on endpoint or Microsoft cloud operations experience, with demonstrated personal ownership of the environments you supported.

- Hands-on experience operating Microsoft Intune in a production environment, including PowerShell scripting for remediation and automation.

- Practical troubleshooting experience across enrollment, Autopilot, compliance, configuration profiles, application deployment and packaging, Windows updates and Autopatch, encryption, and endpoint security.

- Hands-on experience managing macOS and mobile devices (iOS and Android) through Intune, including enrollment, policy configuration, compliance, and application management.

- Working knowledge of Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, LAPS, and Windows Hello for Business.

- Hands-on operational experience with Azure, Azure Security, and Entra ID, including Conditional Access, monitoring, resource health, access, and standard administration or remediation.

- Experience owning technical tickets through investigation, remediation, stakeholder communication, escalation, and closure.

- Ability to support multiple client environments with different scopes, configurations, access models, and approval processes.

- Strong written documentation and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to client and internal stakeholders.

- Sound judgment about what sits inside a managed service, and the confidence to confirm scope before acting on requests that look like project, architecture, or out-of-scope work.

- Post-secondary education in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Ability to work during normal Canadian business hours and participate in occasional approved after-hours maintenance or incident activity where client scope requires it.

- Ability to obtain and maintain required client access and comply with company and client security, privacy, and change-management requirements.

Considered an Asset

Meets all mandatory organizational and departmental requirements.  Experience
