As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

End User Computing Engineer

CREATING ESSENTIAL CHEMISTRY THE WORLD NEEDS

At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and unmatched technical expertise to develop market-leading products with the highest levels of performance, sustainability, and safety in the industry.

Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes, and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.

Chemours is seeking an experienced End User Computing Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This position may be based at various Chemours US locations; candidates located within 50 miles of any Chemours US location will enable close collaboration with IT and business teams.

This role will manage and continuously improve Chemours’ enterprise endpoint capabilities. The engineer will deliver secure, reliable, and user-focused computing services across the device lifecycle.

The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

· Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune.

· Design and support co-management and cloud-native endpoint strategies for Windows, iOS, and Android devices, including Microsoft Intune integration with Apple Business Manager and Android zero-touch enrollment.

· Design and support Windows Autopilot provisioning to streamline device deployment and employee onboarding.

· Build, test, deploy, and maintain applications, packages, task sequences, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines.

· Plan and execute operating system feature updates, monthly patching, driver and firmware updates, and endpoint lifecycle activities.

· Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service delivery, and application teams to remediate vulnerabilities and meet endpoint security and compliance requirements.

· Monitor platform health, capacity, deployment success, and compliance; analyze data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.

· Troubleshoot complex endpoint, deployment, policy, application, and device-enrollment issues, and provide technical leadership during escalations.

· Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft endpoint-management roadmaps, recommended architectures, security guidance, and modern engineering practices, and incorporate them into enterprise standards and solutions.

· Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources for support teams; serve as an L2/L3 escalation point for complex issues and provide technical leadership through resolution.

The following is required for this role:

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

· 3+ years of experience engineering or administering enterprise end user computing and endpoint management services.

· Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Intune, including application and package deployment, software updates, collections, reporting, operating system deployment, and client health.

· Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, identity-based access controls, endpoint security, and vulnerability remediation.

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

The following is preferred for this role:

· Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Endpoint Analytics, Windows Update for Business, and certificate or configuration management.

· Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, Android zero-touch enrollment, and iOS and Android device enrollment, automated deployment, configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, security controls, and lifecycle management.

· Experience administering and managing enterprise endpoint privilege management and remote support tools, including policy configuration, access governance, operational support, and reporting.

· Experience using PowerShell to automate endpoint administration, reporting, and remediation.

· Experience integrating endpoint tooling with IT service management, asset management, or reporting platforms.

· Microsoft certification aligned to endpoint administration, security, or Azure technologies.

· Experience providing technical leadership for endpoint modernization, tenant migration, or large-scale device transformation initiatives.

jobs.description:
Desde la división de IT \& Cloud de Iwantic estamos buscando un/a M365 Specialist con experiencia avanzada en Microsoft Intune para incorporarse directamente a una importante compañía tecnológica ubicada en Madrid.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia sólida en la administración integral de una tenant de Microsoft 365 y conocimientos avanzados de Intune, especialmente en la gestión de dispositivos y despliegues masivos de Windows mediante Autopilot.

¿Qué harás?

* Administrar de forma integral una tenant de Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, usuarios, permisos y políticas corporativas.
* Gestionar Microsoft Intune para la administración avanzada de dispositivos, aplicaciones, configuraciones, políticas de cumplimiento y seguridad.
* Diseñar y ejecutar despliegues masivos de dispositivos Windows mediante Windows Autopilot, desde la configuración inicial hasta su puesta en marcha.
* Administrar Microsoft Entra ID y las políticas de identidad y acceso.
* Gestionar sistemas Windows e infraestructura cloud en Microsoft Azure.
* Resolver incidencias técnicas complejas y garantizar la continuidad y seguridad del entorno tecnológico.

¿Qué buscamos?

* Formación en Informática, Sistemas o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia sólida en la administración integral de entornos Microsoft 365.
* Experiencia avanzada y práctica con Microsoft Intune, más allá de la configuración básica de dispositivos.
* Experiencia demostrable en despliegues masivos de dispositivos Windows y Windows Autopilot.
* Certificación Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), imprescindible.
* Autonomía, capacidad de resolución de problemas y buenas habilidades de comunicación.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

* Contrato indefinido directamente con la compañía.
* Ubicación: Madrid.
* Modalidad presencial.
* Entorno tecnológico dinámico y colaborativo.
* Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

Si tienes experiencia administrando entornos Microsoft 365 de forma integral, dominas Intune y Windows Autopilot y cuentas con la certificación requerida, ¡inscríbete en la oferta y valoraremos tu candidatura!

jobs.description:
Somos más de 20 millones de yaperos y 3 millones de negocios que utilizan Yape a diario. Estamos disponibles para todos, lo que nos convierte en una plataforma única y clave del ecosistema digital del Perú.

Nos motiva construir un país conectado sin barreras, que fomente el crecimiento y desarrollo para todos los peruanos.

Para seguir brindando la mejor experiencia a nuestros yaperos, necesitamos el mejor talento.

Sé parte de esta emocionante misión y contribuye con nuestro propósito de hacer más simple el día a día de las personas para que sigan movilizando sus vidas.

¡Contágiate de la Vibra Yape y haz que la vida fluya!

**Responsabilidades:**

* Implementar y monitorear controles de seguridad en endpoints corporativos, asegurando cumplimiento de políticas, configuración segura, cifrado, protección de datos y reducción de superficie de ataque.
* Administrar soluciones MDM/UEM, EDR/XDR y DLP, incluyendo políticas, alertas, excepciones, remediaciones, inventario, evidencias y mejora continua de controles.
* Gestionar hardening y cumplimiento técnico en estaciones de trabajo, dispositivos móviles y entornos asociados, identificando brechas y coordinando planes de remediación.
* Evaluar nuevas herramientas, integraciones o iniciativas tecnológicas, incluyendo soluciones de IA, desde una perspectiva de seguridad, riesgo, trazabilidad, privacidad y controles mínimos requeridos.
* Automatizar procesos operativos de Endpoint Security mediante APIs, scripts, reportería, flujos de trabajo o capacidades nativas de las plataformas.
* Apoyar auditorías y requerimientos de cumplimiento mediante generación, validación y documentación de evidencias asociadas a controles de endpoint.
* Participar en pruebas controladas de soluciones de IA aplicadas a procesos de accesos, identificando riesgos, validando casos de uso, definiendo controles de seguridad, privacidad, trazabilidad, revisión humana y criterios para su adopción responsable.

**Requisitos:**

* Formación universitaria en ingeniería de sistemas, informática, telecomunicaciones, ciberseguridad, ciencias de la computación o carreras afines.
* Experiencia mínima sugerida de 3 a 5 años en ciberseguridad, seguridad de endpoints, MDM/UEM, EDR/XDR, DLP, hardening, monitoreo de cumplimiento, remediación técnica o auditorías en entornos corporativos, financieros, cloud o regulados.
* Conocimiento técnico en seguridad de endpoints, hardening, MDM/UEM, EDR/XDR, DLP, cifrado, cumplimiento de postura y remediación de desviaciones.
* Experiencia con sistemas operativos Windows, macOS, iOS y Android desde una perspectiva de administración centralizada, configuración segura y control de riesgos.
* Capacidad para analizar eventos, alertas, brechas de cumplimiento, excepciones y riesgos asociados a dispositivos finales.
* Conocimiento de marcos de seguridad y cumplimiento como PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls o similares.
* Experiencia en automatización, reportería, gestión de tickets y documentación operativa con herramientas como Jira o equivalentes.
* Capacidad de análisis técnico, atención al detalle y comunicación efectiva con equipos de tecnología, ciberseguridad, auditoría y cumplimiento.
* Conocimiento para evaluar iniciativas de IA desde una perspectiva de seguridad, identificando datos sensibles, permisos requeridos, riesgos de exposición, uso indebido, dependencia de resultados, trazabilidad, controles de acceso y mecanismos de validación humana.

OverviewEmpower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

ResponsibilitiesDescription

Empower AI is seeking an Endpoint Engineer - SME to engineer and sustain the Endpoint Systems; Windows (WIN11+, MCEM/SCCM, AD, AWS) and MAC (macOS / iOS/ Jamf) endpoint systems and infrastructure on the NIPRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS (as available) enclaves of a Department of War agency, where the same standards of automation, hardening, and RMF compliance apply but tooling, connectivity, and handling procedures differ. The engineer operates the classified-enclave endpoint management infrastructure (e.g., SCCM/MCEM, Jamf), engineers and validates hardened images and Group Policy baselines, executes CAT I/II/III patching within enclave constraints, supports classified VDI and cross-domain considerations, and produces RMF evidence for the classified endpoint systems. This TS/SCI privileged-user role is the Tier III escalation point for classified endpoint incidents. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

 Engineer, operate, and maintain the NIPIRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS endpoint systems and management infrastructure (WIN11+, MCEM/SCCM, AD, AWS, macOS / iOS/ Jamf, imaging, provisioning, Group Policy) in accordance with enclave-specific security, transfer, and handling procedures. Plan and execute CAT I/II/III patch and software deployments on the classified enclaves within PRS timeframes, managing media transfer and disconnected/air-gapped update workflows where required. Engineer and validate hardened images and configuration baselines for classified endpoints against DISA STIGs and enclave authority requirements, and provide RMF control evidence and POA&M inputs in eMASS for the classified endpoint systems. Serve as the Tier III escalation point for classified-enclave endpoint incidents and coordinate with the enclave network, cybersecurity, and communications teams. Lead the engineering design, implementation, and lifecycle of the enterprise endpoint infrastructure: hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, endpoint management platform architecture (Jamf), configuration baselines, and VDI integration across all enclaves. Lead the evaluation, cost-benefit analysis, and phased implementation of the Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling; author the Digital Twin Evaluation and Implementation Plan; and establish the practice that every significant change is tested in the digital replica before deployment. Lead engineering for AI, automation, and analytics initiatives approved by the Government, including predictive analytics on service data, intelligent automation across support tiers, and integrations with the ITSM platform, and deliver Proof of Concept Reports documenting feasibility, risks, and benefits. Conduct market research and produce Market Research Reports and Rough Orders of Magnitude (ROMs) for emerging technologies and proposed solutions to support Government planning and IT Capability Request analysis.QualificationsREQUIREMENTS:

 Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 8 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 years (education/experience) overall minimum required. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start. Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting. Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties. Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision. Minimum of 5 years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering for enterprise WIN (Windows (WIN10+, MCEM/SCCM, AD, AWS) and MAC OS (macOS / iOS/ Jamf and/or MAC architecture) environments. Demonstrated experience designing and leading implementation of lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments and formal test-before-deploy practices. Experience leading proof-of-concept evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit/ROM development for Government or enterprise decision-makers. Extensive experience with DISA STIGs, ACAS/Nessus, RMF control implementation, POA&Ms, and eMASS. Experience leading engineering teams, establishing standards, and executing changes through formal Change Management. Excellent technical writing, briefing, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to participate in after-hours emergency on-call response. Experience working on NIPRNet, SIPRNet and/or JWICS enclaves and with classified media handling procedures.

DESIRED SKILLS:

 CISSP, CASP+ CE, or GCED; AWS or Azure architect certification. Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. Experience applying AI/ML, RPA, or AIOps to IT service management and endpoint operations, including ServiceNow integrations. Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Strategy and Reference Architecture, DoDAF 2.02, DoD ICAM Strategy, and Technology Business Management (TBM). ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional; PMP. Experience supporting IT Capability Request (ITCR) analysis and governance briefings.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 and Intune Migration Specialist to support a large-scale tenant consolidation project involving approximately 186 Windows workstations and Cloud PCs.

The contractor will be responsible for remotely migrating workstations into a consolidated Microsoft 365 environment, ensuring devices are properly configured, secured, and fully operational.

Key Responsibilities

Verify OneDrive backups and user data synchronization.

Document existing applications, printers, and user configurations.

Remotely reset/reimage Windows workstations as required.

Re-enroll devices into Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

Deploy and validate applications, security policies, and endpoint configurations.

Configure and troubleshoot Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 access.

Validate Microsoft Defender policies and endpoint security.

Troubleshoot printers, scanners, and business applications.

Provide remote end-user migration assistance and post-migration support.

Document completed migrations and resolve outstanding issues.

Required Skills

Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations

Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager

Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)

Windows 10/11 deployment and troubleshooting

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Windows Autopilot and remote device provisioning

OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online

PowerShell scripting and automation

Remote desktop support and end-user troubleshooting

Project Details

Workstations: Approximately 186

Estimated Effort: 372–744 hours

Duration: Approximately 2–4 months for one full-time resource

Location: Remote

Experience: 5+ years preferred

Ideal Candidate: An experienced Microsoft 365 endpoint migration engineer who has independently performed large-scale, remote workstation migrations and can minimize user downtime.

• Expected technician activities include:

• Verify OneDrive backups and synchronization

• Document printers and installed applications

• Validate browser favorites and locally stored settings

• Wipe and factory reset devices

• Re-enroll devices into the new Intune environment

• Reinstall required applications

• Validate application deployments and policy enforcement

• Test Outlook and email functionality

• Validate printer and scanner connectivity

• Confirm SharePoint and business application access

• Resolve any post-migration issues

jobs.description:
Work Setup: Fully Remote Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time Salary: $3,300 - $3,700 Role OverviewThe person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms.

 Work Setup: Fully Remote

 Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time

 Salary: $3,300 - $3,700

Role Overview

The person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms. This role is also the senior technical authority that clients rely on, and they need to be someone a non-technical founder trusts as much as a technical CTO respects.

If you are the type who can diagnose a security incident, explain what happened to an operations manager in plain language, and leave that person feeling confident, not confused, then YOU belong here.

This Role IS:

- The face of our company to technologically sophisticated, security-conscious clients — you own relationships, not just tickets

- Equal parts technical problem-solving and warm, clear client communication

- A Mac-first, Google Workspace-first, SaaS-security environment

- Autonomy with accountability — startup clients expect fast, independent judgment

This Role IS NOT:

- A backend NOC or infrastructure role where you work silently behind the scenes

- A pure engineering role — if you prefer zero client contact, this is not the right fit

- A Windows Server / Active Directory / on-prem data center environment

- A role with heavy supervision and rigid escalation paths

Responsibilities:

Technical Delivery

- Own the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of our security tool stack (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cynomi, KnowBe4, etc.) across client environments.

- Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for escalated issues across Mac workstations, networks, Google Workspace, and SaaS platforms.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents independently with clear, client-readable documentation.

- Lead technical projects: migrations, security tool rollouts, network upgrades, compliance implementations.

- Develop process automation to reduce repetitive manual work (not infrastructure-as-code; think workflow efficiency).

- Own recurring technical issues and implement long-term root-cause fixes.

- Support monitoring, patching (including CVE remediation alerting), and incident response workflows.

- Evaluate new platforms to determine their suitability as part of our tool stack.

- Perform system updates, backups, and security audits.

Client Experience

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client accounts. You own the relationship, not just the ticket queue.

- Translate complex technical concepts into clear, confident language for non-technical stakeholders (startup founders, ops managers, office managers).

- Lead client-facing project presentations: scoping, status updates, and post-implementation reviews.

- Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 team members to share knowledge and elevate the team's client communication standards.

- Bridge the gap between subject matter experts and end-users – ensure that SOPs, documentation, and client-facing instructions are user-friendly and accessible.

- Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and proactively communicate them to clients and internal leadership.

- Contribute to and improve knowledge base documentation with a client-readability lens.

Required Qualifications

Technical Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, and security project implementation.

- Strong Mac/macOS support experience. Candidates without extensive Apple experience must obtain Apple Desktop Support certification within 90 days.

- Experience administering Google Workspace environments for distributed/remote teams.

- Strong cybersecurity literacy: hands-on experience with zero-trust SaaS security platforms (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cisco Umbrella, KnowBe4, or equivalent).

- Solid networking fundamentals (VPNs, firewalls, routing), ideally supporting Cisco Meraki environments.

- Experience with endpoint management / MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading SaaS security implementation projects end-to-end: from scoping and proposal through deployment and client sign-off.

 Client-Facing Skills (Equally Weighted)

- Demonstrated experience as the primary point of contact for client accounts – not just an escalation resource, but the person the client calls first.

- Proven ability to explain technical issues to non-technical audiences in plain language and leave them feeling confident, not overwhelmed.

- Experience leading or co-leading client meetings, project kickoffs, and status reviews.

- High customer satisfaction scores or equivalent evidence of strong client relationships (references, testimonials, NPS).

- Comfort with ambiguity: startup clients often don't know what they need, and you help them figure it out.

Soft Skills

- Ownership mindset – if it's your account, it's your problem until it's solved.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision across multiple time zones.

- Continuous improvement orientation: you don't just fix the ticket, you fix the system that created the ticket.

- Strong written communication – client-facing emails and documentation should be clear, professional, and warm.

jobs.description:
About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

 Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

 This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

 What You’ll Own 💼

 In this role, you will:

- Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience

- Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards

- Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale

- Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues

- Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth

- Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs

- Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups

- Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

 What Success Looks Like 📈

 In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

- Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on

- Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience

- Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume

- Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews

- Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards

- Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

 About You ✨

 You likely have:

- 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms

- Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access

- Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement

- Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration

- Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams

- A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority

- Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

 Nice to Have ⭐

 While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

- Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)

- Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration

- Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts

- Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models

- Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations

- Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

 Why This Role Matters 🧡

 Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

 As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

  Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

 Highlights include:

- A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

- A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

- Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

- Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

- Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

- A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

- The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 Compensation 💰

 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

- Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).

- Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

 Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

  Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

 A Note on AI

 At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

 For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

 Why Carrot?

 Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Senior Windows Endpoint Engineer

The Endpoint Engineering team is responsible for the technologies and capabilities that deliver the end user experience to our global crew through a mix of both devices and software. We are seeking a motivated and experienced senior engineer passionate about delivering a great experience to users through modern endpoint management tools and practices. As a Senior Windows Endpoint Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Intune solutions, for migration from MECM and AD joined devices to Azure AD joined and Intune Managed. You will develop Intune policies utilizing existing Active Directory group policies; work closely with cross-functional teams, to architect and deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions and participate in the development of user stories, sprint planning, and test case development / execution within an agile project environment.

Qualifications

**This is a hybrid role based in Wayne, Pennsylvania. Hybrid is defined as in-office Tues-Wed-Thurs. This position cannot be based remote and would require relocation for candidates currently living outside of PA**

In this Role you will:

Design and implement Microsoft Intune and MECM solutions that meet end user requirements. Create and manage Intune policies for application deployment, device compliance, and security configurations. Ensure seamless integration with other Microsoft 365 services.

Windows 10 and 11 Provisioning: Design and deploy Windows 10 and 11 provisioning processes using Intune Autopilot and MECM. Configure and manage Windows Update for Business policies. Develop and maintain standardized Windows 10 and 11 deployment images.

Active Directory Group Policy Management: Design and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) in Active Directory to enforce security and configuration policies.

Security and Compliance: Implement security best practices and compliance policies within Intune and MECM.

Documentation and Training: Create detailed documentation of Intune and MCEM configurations, Windows provisioning processes, and Group Policy settings.

Collaborate with the architecture team to ensure alignment with broader infrastructure goals. Following ITIL industry-standard processes and procedures.

Stay up to date with the latest technology trends and advancements in endpoint devices and support techniques.

Participate in special projects and performs other related duties as assigned.

What it Takes:

Undergraduate degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of training and experience

5 or more years of experience diagnosing and solving problems in a Windows environment. Expertise in MECM and Intune.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Specializations that'll have an impact:

Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified Intune Expert.

Advanced knowledge of the Windows OS, Intune, Azure, and endpoint architecture

Ability to identify and implement automation opportunities to increase productivity and maintain high quality deployments.

Experience leading and mentoring staff, technical support organizations.

Experience with production readiness review process.

Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple problems simultaneously.

Required Skills : Windows

 Additional Skills :

Background Check : No

Drug Screen : No

You will drive technical strategy, mentor fellow engineers, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, secure, and performant systems. Your expertise will directly influence how we scale our technology to meet evolving business demands. The Connectivity Implementation Engineer will be responsible for leading delivery of network and connectivity services, globally. This role partners with internal business stakeholders, service delivery teams and external telecom providers to ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective deployment of network solutions that meet business requirements and engineering standards. Coordinate install and cutover execution, including site/provider scheduling, internal handoffs, maintenance windows, and execution readiness. Plan and execute testing aligned to agreed acceptance criteria; capture and manage test evidence and implementation exceptions through to resolution or documented acceptance. Complete BAU handover with closure evidence and required metadata; ensure documentation quality supports operational readiness and auditability. Execute decommission/disconnect activities where in scope, with appropriate governance and closure evidence. jobs.description:
Job Description
BAE is seeking an experienced Desktop & Windows engineer to support technical development and testing of Desktop Operating System (OS) Images for the Executive Office for the U.S. Attorneys (EOUSA) for our customer, the U.S. Attorneys' Office (USAO).

Required Education, Experience, & Skills
 Bachelors in computer science, business, or other relevant disciplines. Ten (10) years of relevant work experience may be substituted for degree requirement. Anticipated Skill Set: Deep knowledge of Windows OS (Windows 11) internals, architecture, and configuration. Expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), OU structure, and domain services. Strong experience with imaging and deployment tools such as MDT, SCCM/MECM, MECM OSD, Autopilot, and Intune. Proficiency with device management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and Windows Update for Business. Skilled in PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and troubleshooting. Experience managing drivers, firmware, hardware standards, and lifecycle management Knowledge of enterprise networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, certificates). Endpoint security: BitLocker, Defender for Endpoint, application control, privilege management. Patch management and vulnerability remediation. Monitoring and logging using tools like Event Viewer, Log Analytics, SIEM platforms. Troubleshooting complex desktop, application, and hardware issues. Supporting virtualization technologies (VDI, Hyper-V). Experience in programming languages such as C#, Visual Basic with strong knowledge in .NET.
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills
 Deep PowerShell proficiency, including building advanced modules and automating enterprise-scale workflows. Strong experience with cloud-based endpoint management (Intune, Azure AD, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint). Expertise with modern provisioning methods (Autopilot, ESP customization, scripted deployments). Familiarity with Zero Trust endpoint principles and secure configuration baselines. Solid understanding of certificate services, PKI, and enterprise certificate management. Experience with Windows troubleshooting using symbols, process monitoring tools, and performance analyzers (ProcMon, WinDbg).
Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems, Inc.
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Leading the architectural design, deployment, administration, and performance optimization of enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solutions (e.g., VMware Horizon, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops).Managing virtual application delivery, golden image maintenance, user profile orchestration, and hypervisor baseline infrastructure.Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, system administrators, and leadership to define desktop virtualization strategies and integration baselines.Conducting root-cause analysis, advanced system diagnostics, and performance troubleshooting across virtualized desktop environments.Maintaining system baselines, configuration management records, patch update schedules, and engineering documentation for virtual infrastructure.Executing storage capacity planning, host hypervisor optimization, and security compliance verification across VDI cluster deployments.Recommending and implementing continuous engineering process improvements to streamline VDI provisioning and enhance user experience.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 7+ years of experience in systems engineering and enterprise VDI deployment.OR a master’s degree and 5+ or more years of relevant experienceOR an associate’s degree and 9+ or more years of relevant experienceOR a high school diploma and 11+ or more years of relevant experienceProven experience leading the design, administration, and technical support of enterprise-scale VDI environments (VMware Horizon, Omnissa, or Citrix).Strong background in hyperconverged infrastructure, virtual storage management (vSAN/SAN), Active Directory Group Policies (GPOs), and virtual desktop optimization.Experience maintaining system baselines, configuration management controls, and automated patching schedules.Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical engineering documentation and virtual infrastructure architecture diagrams.
Preferred Qualifications

Relevant professional certifications such as VMware Certified Professional - Desktop and Mobility (VCP-DTM), VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP), Citrix Certified Associate/Professional (CCA-V/CCP-V), or CompTIA Security+.Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations, Combatant Command environments, or Department of Defense enterprise technical environments.Familiarity with DoD STIG compliance, user profile management tools (App Volumes, DEM/UEM), and automated software deployment platforms.Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering teams in fast-paced operational environments.

Clearance Requirements

Must hold a current/active top secret security clearance.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE Mission Computing is a new organization that bridges the gap between Mission and Technology and helps enable MTIRE projects to focus on their work, without worrying about compliance and the underlying platform infrastructure. We apply new technologies that can address the Government's most challenging Systems Engineering problems. This is an opportunity for experienced platform engineers who are highly motivated, innovative, and proactive and interested in owning and maintaining their work to enable the rest of MITRE and sponsors.

Roles & Responsibilities:

We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join a secure, compliant enterprise platform team, delivering infrastructure for mission-critical workloads.

This role sits at the front of the platform lifecycle, combining technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities. The engineer will support customer onboarding, solution scoping, and delivery of compute environments aligned with security and compliance requirements.

This is a high-impact role requiring both technical depth and clear communication with customers and internal teams.

Customer Engagement, Solution Delivery & Onboarding

Participate in customer discussions to understand needs and requirements
Translate requirements into clear, build-ready specifications
Provide guidance on access, usage, and expectations
Identify risks, dependencies, and gaps early in the process
Manage multiple efforts with strong follow-through
Standardize documentation and communication where possible

Technical Coordination

Act as the bridge between customers and engineering teams
Ensure requirements are clearly communicated to build teams
Identify and resolve gaps between requested and delivered configurations
Coordinate with Security, Networking, and Infrastructure teams
Support troubleshooting across Windows, virtualization, networking, storage, and security.

Basic Qualifications:

 Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Strong experience with Windows systems engineering (primary requirement)
Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows Server/Windows client.
Working knowledge of infrastructure domains (networking, virtualization, storage, security)
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues independently
PowerShell/scripting or other automation experience.
Experience working across multiple teams
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple workstreams with attention to detail
Must be able to lift 50 lbs
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with FIPS-199, NIST SP800-53 rev.4, NIST SP800-171, or DISA STIGs

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne's Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

Windows agent's Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.

What will you do?

As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).You'll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.What skills & knowledge should you bring?

Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling toolsPrevious experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deploymentGreat communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinkingAttention to detail and high coding standardsAn advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysisWhy SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Competitive leave benefitsGender-neutral parental leaveInsurance & Financial Security

Medical and insurance benefitsDisability insuranceEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)Work Perks & Flexibility

Global home office allowanceMobile phone reimbursementWork-from-home allowanceSentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, C Programming Language, C++ Programming Language, Cellular Telephone, Cloud Computing, Coding Standards, Communication Skills, Debugging Skills, Debugging Tools, Detail Oriented, Ecosystems, Editing, Employee Assistance Plan, Endpoint Security, Government, Internet Security, Kernel Programming, Malware, Malware Analysis, Messaging Middleware, Microsoft Windows Device Drivers, Microsoft Windows Operating System, Microsoft Windows System Internals/Programming, Performance Tuning/Optimization, Problem Solving Skills, Product Lifecycle, Quality Management, Reimbursement, Research & Development (R&D), Security Infrastructure, Software Engineering, Stock Purchase Plans, User Interface/Experience (UI/UX), Work From Home

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you'll do at Jamf

The Senior Manager, IT Enterprise Applications, Digital Workplace is responsible for how technology works and feels for Jamf employees. This leader connects enterprise systems into a cohesive, scalable foundation that supports productivity and cross-team collaboration. You will own the roadmap, architecture, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operations of Jamf 's Service & Knowledge Management and Employee Experience platforms (currently ServiceNow and Atlassian), with the opportunity to take on additional digital workplace platforms over time. You will build and develop a team of platform administrators, developers, and technical architects, and partner with the Senior Director of Enterprise Applications on long-term platform strategy while holding decision-making authority over execution, vendor relationships, and cross-domain escalations.

What you can expect to do in this role:

- Owns the technical roadmap, governance model, and architecture for Service & Knowledge Management and Employee Experience platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian), reducing friction and modernizing how employees get work done

- Leads, coaches, and develops a team of platform administrators, developers, and technical architects, including performance management, staffing, and career growth, in alignment with Enterprise Applications goals

- Directs platform delivery, including planning, prioritizing, and releasing new functionality and enhancements across managed systems

- Leads platform governance and steering committees, aligning stakeholders across departments on priorities, changes, and roadmap decisions

- Serves as the technical escalation point for critical service disruptions, resolving cross-domain, vendor, and competing stakeholder issues, and escalating to the Senior Director when an issue carries significant business or budget impact

- Manages vendor relationships, licensing, contracts, and budget for managed domains, tracking utilization, forecasting spend, and communicating ROI to optimize cost and prevent SaaS sprawl

- Partners with IT, Security, and business stakeholders to architect and govern integrations and automated workflows across platforms and workplace systems (e.g., IDP, HRIS, collaboration tooling, AI tooling), and advises departments on platform capabilities for new systems and major process changes

- Leads evaluation and rollout of AI-powered platform capabilities (e.g., ServiceNow Now Assist, Atlassian Rovo, Microsoft Copilot), and uses AI tools to automate manual work and improve team efficiency

What we are looking for:

- 8+ years of experience delivering and managing enterprise applications and collaboration platforms in a complex, cross-functional IT environment (required)

- 5+ years of experience coordinating work across internal teams and external vendors, including managing SaaS budgets, contracts, and license negotiations with a focus on cost optimization and sprawl prevention (required)

- 3+ years in a formal people-management role, including hiring, performance management, and team development (required)

- Deep platform architecture experience, with hands-on configuration and administration background, in ServiceNow (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ESM) or Atlassian (e.g., Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence) (required)

- Effective executive communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences (required)

- Experience architecting and governing complex enterprise IT platforms across more than one vendor ecosystem, with the ability to anticipate how a change in one system affects others (preferred)

- Experience building integrations and automated workflows between enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs and identity providers (Okta/Azure AD) (preferred)

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve your own work and your team's efficiency, and evaluating AI-enabled platform features (preferred)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred); a combination of relevant education and experience will be considered

- Relevant ServiceNow or Atlassian certification, such as ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator (preferred)

jobs.description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best-in-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent-driven workflows, integrations, and self-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better.

As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long-term engineering. If you’re customer-obsessed, hard-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in-office culture.

YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices

 - Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack

 - Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle

 - Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support

 - Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security

 - Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience

 - Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network-related issues, as well as occasional in-person support within the San Francisco office

 - Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring

 - Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems

 - Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root-cause analysis, clear run books, employee-facing guidance, and self-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery

 - Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development

 - Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 3+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high-growth technology companies

 - You have hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least-privilege access

 - You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach

 - You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build

 - You have experience managing and supporting Mac-based environments

 - You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices

 - You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements

 - You have excellent problem-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - You're an effective communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications

 - You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers

 - You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed

NICE TO HAVE:

 - First-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges

 - Experience with zero-trust security frameworks

 - Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting

 - Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning

 - Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO)

 - Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco)

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. As the team grows you will lead it technically, and there is a clear path into formal technical leadership of the software function for someone who wants it.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as technical lead for the classified software and platform team: own the architecture of the application portfolio, set the standards the team builds to, and make the tradeoff calls.

- Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

- Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

- Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

- Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

- Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

- Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

- Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

- Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

- Experience leading technical work: owning a system's architecture, reviewing the designs and code of others, setting direction for a small team, and communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.
