Proudly certified as a Great Place to Work, we are dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment. At Sonic Healthcare USA, we emphasize teamwork and innovation. Check out our job openings and advance your career with a company that values its team members!

Sonic Healthcare USA is seeking a highly skilled Intune Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and continuous improvement of Microsoft Intune and the broader Microsoft Endpoint Management ecosystem. The Intune Engineer will ensure the secure, compliant, and efficient management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices while delivering an exceptional end-user experience.

The ideal candidate is passionate about endpoint management, automation, security, and modern workplace technologies. This individual will partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management, Service Desk, and Digital Workplace teams to support key initiatives including Zero Trust, Microsoft 365 optimization, endpoint lifecycle management, and device modernization..

Key Responsibilities
Endpoint Management & Engineering

Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune policies, device configurations, compliance policies, and endpoint security settings.
Administer and optimize Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM), Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft Defender integrations.
Develop and maintain device enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management processes.
Create, test, and deploy application packages across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.
Implement and support Windows Autopilot deployments for zero-touch provisioning.
Monitor and manage device compliance, remediation, and policy enforcement activities.
Evaluate and implement endpoint management best practices to improve security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement endpoint security controls and Zero Trust strategies.
Configure and support Conditional Access policies integrated with Intune and Entra ID.
Support compliance initiatives related to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC, and other regulatory requirements.
Monitor and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration drift, and security risks.
Collaborate with Security Operations teams to strengthen endpoint detection, response, and threat mitigation capabilities.

Automation & Innovation

Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Power Automate.
Build proactive monitoring and remediation scripts to improve endpoint health and supportability.
Streamline onboarding, offboarding, device refresh, and lifecycle management processes.
Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Management technologies and recommend adoption opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.

Operations & Support

Serve as an escalation point for complex endpoint management and device-related issues.
Support operating system deployments, software distribution, patch management, and endpoint updates.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge articles.
Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
Partner with Service Desk teams to improve support processes and reduce recurring issues.

Reporting & Analytics

Develop dashboards and reporting for endpoint compliance, patching, endpoint health, and user experience metrics.
Track and report key operational performance indicators and service-level objectives.
Provide recommendations to improve endpoint security, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
3-7+ years of experience supporting enterprise endpoint management environments.
3+ years of hands‑on experience administering Microsoft Intune.
Experience managing:
Experience packaging and deploying enterprise applications.
Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
Experience supporting Windows 10 and Windows 11 enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, device management, and identity management concepts.
Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Join our team and help shape the future of endpoint management, security, and digital workplace technology while enabling a secure, modern, and seamless employee experience.

40

Digital Workplace Engineer II
Transform the Employee Experience Through Technology

Who We Are
For more than 120 years, Ben E. Keith has served customers and communities as one of the nation’s leading distributors of foodservice products and premium beverages. Our success is built on exceptional people, strong relationships, and a commitment to service and innovation. Our Digital Workplace team uses Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and other modern technologies to create a connected, productive employee experience and help thousands of employees work smarter.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out
This highly visible role is for a relationship builder, storyteller, trainer, and technology advocate. You will combine technical expertise with energy, curiosity, creativity, and personality to make technology approachable, engaging, and useful. If you enjoy presenting, leading workshops, helping others learn, and bringing your authentic self to work, you will fit right in.

Help lead Microsoft Copilot and AI adoption across the enterprise
Shape how employees use technology, collaborate, and learn
Combine engineering, training, communications, and change leadership
Partner with business leaders on high-impact, enterprise-wide initiatives
Join a stable, growing company with meaningful career opportunities
Work with a collaborative team that values ideas, celebrates success, and enjoys having fun

Lead adoption initiatives for Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, and Power Platform solutions
Design and deliver instructor‑led, virtual, and on‑demand training for employees with varying technical skill levels
Create practical learning resources, including job aids, videos, tutorials, and knowledge articles
Develop communication and change strategies that support technology launches and enhancements
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities, gather feedback, and improve the employee technology experience
Analyze adoption, engagement, and training metrics to measure impact and recommend improvements
Support Microsoft 365 administration, implementations, escalated issues, documentation, governance, and operational initiatives
Collaborate with IT, HR, Corporate Communications, and business teams to advance digital

transformation

Explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to transform how training is designed, created, delivered, maintained, and personalized, with a focus on making learning more scalable, engaging, and effective.
Leverage AI to improve knowledge management and self‑service support, including identifying opportunities to make information easier for employees to find, understand, and apply.
Continuously evaluate how AI can improve employee adoption, reinforce learning, and help employees build confidence and proficiency with new technologies.

What You Bring
Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Communications, Education, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Five or more years of experience supporting enterprise workplace technologies
Hands‑on experience with Microsoft 365 technologies, including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Microsoft Copilot, Intune, and Power Platform
Experience delivering end‑user training and technology enablement programs
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills
Ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical audiences
Experience leading projects and collaborating across multiple teams

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Modern Work, Copilot, Teams, or SharePoint
Experience with instructional design, adult learning, or multimedia learning content
Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
Experience developing adoption metrics, reporting, and analytics
Experience supporting AI, automation, or digital transformation programs

Key Skills

Communication, facilitation, and executive presentation
Relationship‑building and stakeholder management
Customer focus and a passion for helping others succeed
Creativity in technology adoption and employee engagement
Analytical thinking, sound judgment, and problem‑solving
Collaboration, adaptability, and accountability

Our Company Culture
At Ben E. Keith, culture is more than a set of values. It is how we work together, support one another, and serve our customers every day.

People First: We foster respect, trust, inclusion, and collaboration.
One Team: We work toward shared goals, support one another, and celebrate success together.
Ownership: We take accountability for results and follow through on commitments.
Continuous Improvement: We embrace innovation, constructive feedback, and lifelong learning.
Growth: We invest in employee development and career advancement.
Personality: We value authentic human connections and encourage employees to bring their ideas, energy, and unique talents to work.

We are committed to creating an environment where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

What It's Like to Work Here
When you join Ben E. Keith, you can expect:

A collaborative, energetic team that genuinely enjoys working together
Opportunities to work with Microsoft Copilot, AI, and the Microsoft 365 platform
Leaders who encourage innovation, creativity, and professional growth
Meaningful work that directly affects employee productivity and engagement
Freedom to bring your personality, communication style, and unique talents to your work
A workplace where relationship‑building is as important as technical expertise

We work hard, support one another, and make time to have fun while delivering results together.

Grow With Us
We are committed to helping employees build rewarding careers. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, become a subject matter expert in AI and collaboration technologies, expand your leadership capabilities, or pursue a new career path, we provide the training, mentorship, and support to help you grow.

Join our team and help shape the future of work at Ben E. Keith.

Descripción de la empresa

Experian es una empresa global de datos y tecnología, que impulsa oportunidades para personas y empresas en todo el mundo. Operamos en una variedad de mercados, desde servicios financieros hasta atención médica, automoción, agronegocios, seguros y muchos más. Experian invierte en personas y nuevas tecnologías avanzadas para desbloquear el poder de los datos. Contamos con un equipo increíble de 25,200 personas en 32 países.

Descripción del puesto

Buscamos un Ingeniero de M365 competente con conocimientos especializados en Microsoft Intune Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM) y Mobile Application Management (MAM). El candidato ideal desempeñará un papel clave en la implementación y el perfeccionamiento de Autopilot, incluida la creación de perfiles de implementación, el despliegue de aplicaciones clave y la migración de GPOs a políticas de cumplimiento. Además, este puesto implica la provisión de soporte avanzado para los servicios de M365 en lo que respecta a nuestros usuarios finales y dispositivos.

Este es un puesto híbrido, con base en nuestra oficina de Allen, TX. Reportará al jefe de Gestión de Endpoints.

Tendrás la oportunidad de:

Implementar y mejorar soluciones de Microsoft Intune y Autopilot para la gestión de endpoints y el aprovisionamiento de dispositivos.

Configurar políticas de cumplimiento de dispositivos y migrar configuraciones de Group Policy heredadas a controles de gestión modernos.

Desplegar, gestionar y mantener aplicaciones, actualizaciones y configuraciones de endpoints en los dispositivos gestionados.

Dar soporte a iniciativas de seguridad de endpoints, incluyendo Microsoft Cloud PKI, políticas de control de aplicaciones y estándares de cumplimiento de dispositivos.

Monitorizar el estado de los dispositivos, el inventario y el rendimiento del servicio 365 de Microsoft para garantizar experiencias de usuario fiables.

Crear informes y obtener información utilizando Microsoft Graph y otras herramientas de gestión de 365 de Microsoft.

Desarrollar y mantener soluciones de automatización utilizando Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions y herramientas de scripting.

Solucionar problemas de gestión de endpoints, seguridad y problemas de 365 de Microsoft, al tiempo que se da soporte a las evaluaciones de seguridad y los esfuerzos de remediación.

Cualificaciones

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team. This role is primarily focused on Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing endpoint engineering solutions in large-scale environments while ensuring seamless integration with organizational goals and user productivity. This position requires a proactive, self-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands across various time zones with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune Policy Engineering

Design, implement, and manage Active Directory and Group Policies to support endpoint and user requirements across a global organization.Develop, implement, and optimize Intune policies tailored to endpoint and user management, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and compliance standards.Lead the transition of on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, including Microsoft Intune, preparing for future migration to Microsoft Entra.Harmonize business requirements from application owners with endpoint policies to balance usability and security while maintaining operational excellence.Ensure endpoint policies are scalable and adaptable to meet the needs of a large, global organization with tens of thousands of users and endpoints.
Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

Manage and optimize management platforms, including but not limited to:Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM)Microsoft IntuneJamf (macOS management)NinjaOne (remote monitoring and management)Leverage Microsoft cloud-native technologies, including Microsoft Graph API, to streamline and automate endpoint management tasks.Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint engineering issues across multiple platforms and operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in endpoint engineering to continuously improve the organization’s endpoint strategy.
Collaboration and Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to implement endpoint solutions that meet organizational needs.Represent the user experience in cross-domain discussions, advocating for end-user productivity and minimizing disruption during policy changes.Work closely with security teams to address ad-hoc requests, ensuring endpoint solutions align with security goals while prioritizing usability.Act as a liaison between infrastructure and security teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on endpoint-related initiatives.
Security and Hardening Support

Field security-related requests and collaborate with security teams to ensure endpoint policies adhere to CIS (Center for Internet Security) Levels 1 & 2 benchmarks.Provide guidance on endpoint hardening practices, ensuring systems are secure, resilient, and compliant while prioritizing the user experience.Participate in security meetings as needed, offering technical expertise and insights into endpoint engineering strategies.
Leadership and Communication

Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in Active Directory, Group Policy, and Intune policies, providing mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.Translate technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment across various levels of the organization.Drive strategic initiatives related to endpoint management, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and priorities.

Required Qualifications

20+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, with a primary focus on Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users.Proven expertise in managing endpoint platforms such as MECM, Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, and other similar tools.Demonstrated ability to transition on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, particularly Intune, and prepare for Microsoft Entra migrations.Experience with Microsoft cloud-native technologies, including Microsoft Graph API, Azure Active Directory, and related tools for endpoint management and automation.Exceptional troubleshooting skills across endpoint engineering platforms, operating systems, and user domains.Experience navigating large global organizations with tens of thousands of users and endpoints, including integrated and non-integrated entities.Self-starter with a proactive mindset, capable of managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands in a highly dynamic global environment across multiple time zones.Ability to work independently with minimal oversight, driving initiatives forward while maintaining accountability and focus.Strong collaboration skills to engage effectively across domains and organizational levels, ensuring alignment between infrastructure, security, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments with complex endpoint requirements.Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar.Strong familiarity with Microsoft Entra and its integration into endpoint and identity management strategies.

Key Competencies

Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of Active Directory, Group Policy, Intune policies, and endpoint engineering platforms.Self-Motivation and Independence: Ability to work autonomously, managing competing priorities and navigating complex global environments with confidence and efficiency.User-Centric Approach: Ability to prioritize user experience and productivity in policy design and implementation.Problem-Solving: Proficiency in identifying and resolving complex endpoint engineering issues.Collaboration: Strong ability to work across teams and domains, fostering partnerships between infrastructure, security, and business units.Communication: Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and advocate for user experience in cross-functional discussions.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit https://www.virtualfairhub.com/cencora

Full time

Equal Employment OpportunityCencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.

The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.

Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email hrsc@cencora.com. We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned

Job Summary
Job Description
At K&L Gates, we are looking for smart, imaginative and hard-working people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas to join us. Perhaps our search for talented visionaries and your search for important and impactful work lead to the same place.
We are seeking a Team Lead: Digital Workplace Engineer to join the firm.

The Team Lead: Digital Workplace Engineer oversees user experience, performance, and reliability of all digital workplace services firmwide. This position provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for endpoint engineering, ensuring improved productivity, service quality, and user experience outcomes. The role sets direction, governance, and standards for workplace technologies, driving excellence and alignment across Engineering, Service Desk, and Infrastructure teams.

Responsibilities include eliminating user experience friction, reducing recurring issues, and delivering scalable, consistent global services. This is achieved through automation, standardization, and disciplined execution to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS
Cloud Platform Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Security, Global Support Services, Deskside Support, Network & Collaboration, Business Stakeholders
Essential Duties
 Owning the entire digital workplace user experience while driving continuous improvement Establishing metrics for DEX and monitoring user sentiment to ensure alignment with objectives and enhance overall experience. Defining standard operating procedures and RACI models while ensuring accountability is upheld consistently across all relevant areas. Conducting root cause analysis and removing recurring issues. Partnering with the Service Desk to minimize incidents while enhancing resolution efficiency and effectiveness. Leading change initiatives and driving strategies to enhance user adoption effectively. Standardizing endpoint configurations while reducing complexity Defining key performance indicators and delivering reports tailored for senior-level audiences, ensuring clarity and actionable insights. Owning escalation frameworks and incident responses Leading vendor performance aligned with experience service level agreements. Driving the adoption of practical artificial intelligence solutions aligned with enhancing productivity. Leading and developing the team while focusing on achieving results-oriented expectations.

jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

 About 1Password
 At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today.

As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

 If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Solutions Engineer supporting Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB), you’ll be a trusted technical advisor who helps customers understand how 1Password can address their security and access challenges. You’ll partner with Account Executives across fast-paced sales cycles, lead technical discovery and proof-of-value (POV) engagements, and connect customer needs to solutions across identity, applications, endpoints, and secrets automation. Your work will help make it easier for businesses and individuals to stay safer online, supporting 1Password’s vision of a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

Reporting to the Manager, Sales Engineering - SMB, this role is based remotely in the United States or Canada.

 How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement.

If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

 What we're looking for:
Required
Bring at least two years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role, ideally in business-to-business (B2B) software as a service (SaaS) or a similar environment.Communicate technical concepts clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.Use strong presentation, storytelling, and discovery skills to make complex information relevant and actionable.Prioritize effectively, manage competing responsibilities, and maintain quality in a fast-paced, high-volume sales environment.Demonstrate curiosity, sound problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote-first team.
Preferred
Bring experience with security and identity concepts, such as credential management, privileged access, secrets management, Single Sign-On (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or OAuth/OpenID Connect (OAuth/OIDC).Understand developer and DevSecOps workflows, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), containers, cloud infrastructure, service accounts, and application programming interface (API) credentials. Familiarity with platforms such as HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure is helpful.
 What you can expect:
Serve as the primary technical advisor for SMB sales opportunities, partnering with Account Executives to provide practical guidance throughout the sales cycle.Lead technical discovery with stakeholders including IT administrators, security leaders, developers, DevOps teams, and Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs).Demonstrate and position Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, and Device Trust as an integrated solution that helps reduce risk across users, applications, and devices.Run POV engagements that validate customer success criteria, including use cases involving developer environments, cloud-native workloads, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) workflows.Help customers evaluate solutions in competitive situations involving Privileged Access Management (PAM) vendors, secrets management tools, and SaaS security platforms.Respond to security questionnaires, compliance requests, Requests for Proposal/Requests for Information (RFPs/RFIs), and other technical documentation needs.Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Marketing, Support, and Customer Experience to improve demos, playbooks, enablement resources, and customer-facing education. Some travel may be required for select industry events and team offsites.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 USD and $105,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $71,000 CAD and $99,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone .

Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you.

We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work.

Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required.

This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing

Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

Competitive health benefits
Generous PTO policy Growth and future

RSU program for most employees

Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account Community
Paid volunteer days
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

Remote-first work environment

*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

 You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status.

Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

#### Job Description

We are seeking a proficient M365 Engineer with specialized knowledge in Microsoft Intune Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Mobile Application Management (MAM), The ideal candidate will play a key role in Implementing and refining autopilot including creation of deployment profiles, deployment of key applications and the migration of GPOs to compliance policies. Additionally, this role involves providing advanced support for M365 services as they pertain to our end users and devices

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Allen, TX office. You will report to the head of Endpoint Management.

You will have opportunity to:

- Implement and enhance Microsoft Intune and Autopilot solutions for endpoint management and device provisioning.
- Configure device compliance policies and migrate legacy Group Policy settings to modern management controls.
- Deploy, manage, and maintain applications, updates, and endpoint configurations across managed devices.
- Support endpoint security initiatives, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, application control policies, and device compliance standards.
- Monitor device health, inventory, and Microsoft 365 service performance to ensure reliable user experiences.
- Create reports and insights using Microsoft Graph and other Microsoft 365 management tools.
- Develop and maintain automation solutions using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, and scripting tools.
- Troubleshoot endpoint management, security, and Microsoft 365 issues while supporting security assessments and remediation efforts.

#### Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in endpoint management and endpoint security.
- Experience administering Microsoft Intune for device management, application deployment, compliance, and security policies.
- Experience implementing and managing Windows Autopilot, including end-to-end zero-touch deployment configurations.
- Experience creating and maintaining automation solutions using Azure Automation Runbooks and Azure Logic Apps.
- Experience using PowerShell or similar scripting languages for automation, configuration, and administration.
- Knowledge of Windows operating systems, endpoint security controls, and security best practices.
- Experience creating technical documentation and operational procedures.
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert certifications preferred.

#### Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

**Benefits/Perks:**

- Great compensation package and bonus plan
- Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
- Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
- Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays
- Explore all our exciting benefits here: [https://myexperianbenefits.com/](https://myexperianbenefits.com/)

jobs.description:
Gracia101 is looking for an **MDM Consultant**on behalf of a global organization based in Barcelona.

This role is responsible for designing and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) processes within their area, ensuring these processes meet business needs while promoting consistency across the organization. The role holder will ensure MDM processes remain aligned with company policies and the broader operating model, and will act as the key point of contact with IT and MDM Technical Solutions teams to implement and support MDM solutions.

**This opportunity may also be a good fit for professionals interested in working on a freelance basis.**

Key accountabilities:

* Design Master Data Management processes in own area. Ensure processes are compliant to group Policies and DoAs. Ensure MDM processes fulfil the needs of --and are validated by --process stakeholders,
* Ensure all owned processes are documented according to standards. Support audits (ISO certifications, customer audits..),
* Support M\&A and IT projects (such as ERP implementation) by defining adequate Master Data setup and processes,
* May lead work packages for solution implementation projects (including running design workshops)
* Interface with MDM Technical Solutions to implement technical solutions in Informatica,
* Interface with IT to implement technical solutions in backend SAP systems.
* Engage with MDM Services for implementation of process or solution changes.
* Define cleansing rules with data owners for ensuring owned data readiness for transformation projects
* Provide third level support to MDM Services teams (what to do if not in the books)
* Follow-up on MDM continuous improvement initiatives in own area.
* Ensure continuous dialogue with process stakeholders and MDM Services teams to nourish continuous improvement process.
* Keep documentation and data assets (data catalog) up-to-date for own area

Education \& Experience:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering or Business administration or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Master Data Management
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Experience in a multinational company / exposure to diverse cultures

Critical competencies:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor
* Strong SAP expertise, in particular regardingmaster data objects in own area
* Proficient in process modeling and design
* Good communication and presentation skills.

**If you are ready to help shape the future of global master data and bring together business processes, SAP and MDM technology, we would love to hear from you.**

* Expert in patch management including bios and firmware updates, service pack upgrades, and application-based updates.

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

#### Job Description

We are looking for an Endpoint Security Engineer to own the security of Nexthink’s corporate endpoint estate: roughly 1,200 devices (550 macOS, 650 Windows) managed through Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will turn endpoint security from a set of point controls into a measurable, continuously improving program covering what runs on our devices, how quickly we patch them, and how we prove it to auditors.

This is a hands-on role at a pivotal moment, as we build out a dedicated security function. Your first priorities include application baselines and allowlisting, a formal application lifecycle from approval to removal, and stronger vulnerability and compliance posture across both platforms. As a company that sells digital employee experience, we expect security that protects people without getting in their way.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Hardening**

- Define and maintain security baselines for macOS and Windows (CIS or equivalent), delivered through Intune and Jamf.
- Own hardening standards: disk encryption, firewall, local admin removal and privilege management.
- Evaluate endpoint security tooling and steer vendors while keeping internal ownership of design.

**Application Control & Software Governance**

- Design and roll out application allowlisting using MDM-native capabilities and/or tools such as Santa, with developer-friendly exception models for Engineering and Product.
- Build and maintain the software and binary inventory: discover, classify and risk-rate applications, and define baselines from the results.
- Run remediation campaigns for unauthorized or high-risk software, from communication to uninstallation and verification.
- Operate the application lifecycle process end to end: request, security review, deployment, monitoring and retirement.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**

- Own endpoint vulnerability management: scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking against SLAs.
- Define patching and update rings for OS and third-party applications with EUC across macOS and Windows.
- Drive remediation of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities and report on exposure and performance to Security leadership.

**Zero Trust & Data Protection**

- Partner with IAM and Security to enforce device compliance and device trust in Conditional Access.
- Support endpoint data protection controls (e.g. Microsoft Purview DLP, USB and removable media controls) and hardware-backed authentication such as passkeys and security keys.

**Compliance & Reporting**

- Document endpoint controls and maintain automated evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and ITGC audits.
- Turn security posture into clear metrics for IT leadership, Security and Finance.

**Automation & Digital Employee Experience**

- Automate security operations with PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, Microsoft Graph and the Jamf and Intune APIs.
- Use Nexthink’s own DEX platform to measure endpoint health and the employee impact of security changes, and build self-service remediation to reduce tickets.

**Primary Metrics**

- Device compliance and security baseline adherence (macOS and Windows)
- Mean time to remediate critical and high vulnerabilities, against SLA
- Patch and OS currency against SLAs
- Application control coverage and share of unclassified binaries
- Unauthorized or high-risk application count, and time to remediate
- Standing local admin count
- Endpoint-related audit findings and evidence automation coverage
- Employee experience impact of security controls (Nexthink DEX score)

#### Qualifications

- 5+ years in endpoint security, security engineering, or end-user computing with a strong security focus.
- Hands-on experience securing macOS and Windows at scale with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (or equivalent).
- Practical experience with vulnerability management tooling, prioritization and remediation workflows.
- Experience with application control and allowlisting (MDM-native controls, Santa, AppLocker, WDAC or similar).
- Strong knowledge of OS security and hardening frameworks (CIS, NIST, Apple platform security).
- Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust applied to devices.
- Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash; familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.
- Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or ITGC controls and audit evidence.
- Ability to work with Engineering and Product teams and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
- Nice to have: DEX tools experience, Microsoft Purview, or certifications (e.g. MD-102, SC-300, Jamf Certified, GIAC, CISSP, Security+).

**_Please apply with a copy of your CV in English._**

#### Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
- 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR .
- 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work.
- 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
- 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
- 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
- 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
- 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and soft drinks in the office.
- 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
- 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

Anthropic's Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

You'll own the IT side of Anthropic's acquisitions: due diligence, integration planning, and integration. Before close, you'll assess a company's IT environment and give the deal team a clear read on risk and effort. You'll define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, what has to be ready on day one, and how each security gap gets closed. After close, you'll carry out that plan and bring the company's people, devices, and systems onto our stack. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll hold admin, write code, build automation, run the cutovers yourself and bring in other teams when the work calls for their expertise or support. You'll lead this work for IT Engineering and partner with Security, Corporate Development, Legal, People, and Finance at every stage.

M&A will be your primary focus and responsibility, but you'll be a full member of the Corporate Systems team; taking part in planning and reviews, using and contributing to the team’s tooling, and contributing to the roadmap. Early on, M&A will be most of your work, including using Claude to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration. As that automation matures, and when M&A load is light, you'll contribute to other parts of the team’s roadmap.

### Responsibilities

- Lead technical IT due diligence: assess a company's identity, applications, endpoints, and infrastructure, and brief the deal team on risk and effort before close
- Find the gaps between an acquired environment and Anthropic's security model, rate them, and build the mitigations into the integration plan
- Define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, and what has to be ready on day one
- Run the integration: take over administration, migrate people, devices, and data, and retire what's no longer needed, with support from other IT Engineering teams as required.
- Work with Business Technology, Client Platform, Corporate Network, IT Operations, and Security on their parts of each integration
- Keep Corporate Development, Legal, People, Finance, and the acquired company's team clear on where IT stands

Chemours is seeking an experienced End User Computing Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This position may be based at various Chemours US locations; candidates located within 50 miles of any Chemours US location will enable close collaboration with IT and business teams.

This role will manage and continuously improve Chemours' enterprise endpoint capabilities. The engineer will deliver secure, reliable, and user-focused computing services across the device lifecycle.

The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

 Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune.

 Design and support co-management and cloud-native endpoint strategies for Windows, iOS, and Android devices, including Microsoft Intune integration with Apple Business Manager and Android zero-touch enrollment.

 Design and support Windows Autopilot provisioning to streamline device deployment and employee onboarding.

 Build, test, deploy, and maintain applications, packages, task sequences, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines.

 Plan and execute operating system feature updates, monthly patching, driver and firmware updates, and endpoint lifecycle activities.

 Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service delivery, and application teams to remediate vulnerabilities and meet endpoint security and compliance requirements.

 Monitor platform health, capacity, deployment success, and compliance; analyze data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.

 Troubleshoot complex endpoint, deployment, policy, application, and device-enrollment issues, and provide technical leadership during escalations.

 Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft endpoint-management roadmaps, recommended architectures, security guidance, and modern engineering practices, and incorporate them into enterprise standards and solutions.

 Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources for support teams; serve as an L2/L3 escalation point for complex issues and provide technical leadership through resolution.

The following is required for this role:

 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

 3+ years of experience engineering or administering enterprise end user computing and endpoint management services.

 Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Intune, including application and package deployment, software updates, collections, reporting, operating system deployment, and client health.

 Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, identity-based access controls, endpoint security, and vulnerability remediation.

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

The following is preferred for this role:

 Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Endpoint Analytics, Windows Update for Business, and certificate or configuration management.

 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, Android zero-touch enrollment, and iOS and Android device enrollment, automated deployment, configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, security controls, and lifecycle management.

 Experience administering and managing enterprise endpoint privilege management and remote support tools, including policy configuration, access governance, operational support, and reporting.

 Experience using PowerShell to automate endpoint administration, reporting, and remediation.

 Experience integrating endpoint tooling with IT service management, asset management, or reporting platforms.

 Microsoft certification aligned to endpoint administration, security, or Azure technologies.

 Experience providing technical leadership for endpoint modernization, tenant migration, or large-scale device transformation initiatives.

jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an Endpoint Security Engineer to own the security of Nexthink's corporate endpoint estate: roughly 1,200 devices (550 macOS, 650 Windows) managed through Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will turn endpoint security from a set of point controls into a measurable, continuously improving program covering what runs on our devices, how quickly we patch them, and how we prove it to auditors.

This is a hands-on role at a pivotal moment, as we build out a dedicated security function. Your first priorities include application baselines and allowlisting, a formal application lifecycle from approval to removal, and stronger vulnerability and compliance posture across both platforms. As a company that sells digital employee experience, we expect security that protects people without getting in their way.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Hardening**

* Define and maintain security baselines for macOS and Windows (CIS or equivalent), delivered through Intune and Jamf.
* Own hardening standards: disk encryption, firewall, local admin removal and privilege management.
* Evaluate endpoint security tooling and steer vendors while keeping internal ownership of design.

**Application Control \& Software Governance**

* Design and roll out application allowlisting using MDM-native capabilities and/or tools such as Santa, with developer-friendly exception models for Engineering and Product.
* Build and maintain the software and binary inventory: discover, classify and risk-rate applications, and define baselines from the results.
* Run remediation campaigns for unauthorized or high-risk software, from communication to uninstallation and verification.
* Operate the application lifecycle process end to end: request, security review, deployment, monitoring and retirement.

**Vulnerability \& Patch Management**

* Own endpoint vulnerability management: scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking against SLAs.
* Define patching and update rings for OS and third-party applications with EUC across macOS and Windows.
* Drive remediation of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities and report on exposure and performance to Security leadership.

**Zero Trust \& Data Protection**

* Partner with IAM and Security to enforce device compliance and device trust in Conditional Access.
* Support endpoint data protection controls (e.g. Microsoft Purview DLP, USB and removable media controls) and hardware-backed authentication such as passkeys and security keys.

**Compliance \& Reporting**

* Document endpoint controls and maintain automated evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and ITGC audits.
* Turn security posture into clear metrics for IT leadership, Security and Finance.

**Automation \& Digital Employee Experience**

* Automate security operations with PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, Microsoft Graph and the Jamf and Intune APIs.
* Use Nexthink's own DEX platform to measure endpoint health and the employee impact of security changes, and build self-service remediation to reduce tickets.

**Primary Metrics**

* Device compliance and security baseline adherence (macOS and Windows)
* Mean time to remediate critical and high vulnerabilities, against SLA
* Patch and OS currency against SLAs
* Application control coverage and share of unclassified binaries
* Unauthorized or high-risk application count, and time to remediate
* Standing local admin count
* Endpoint-related audit findings and evidence automation coverage
* Employee experience impact of security controls (Nexthink DEX score)

Qualifications
- -------------

* 5+ years in endpoint security, security engineering, or end-user computing with a strong security focus.
* Hands-on experience securing macOS and Windows at scale with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (or equivalent).
* Practical experience with vulnerability management tooling, prioritization and remediation workflows.
* Experience with application control and allowlisting (MDM-native controls, Santa, AppLocker, WDAC or similar).
* Strong knowledge of OS security and hardening frameworks (CIS, NIST, Apple platform security).
* Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust applied to devices.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash; familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or ITGC controls and audit evidence.
* Ability to work with Engineering and Product teams and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
* Nice to have: DEX tools experience, Microsoft Purview, or certifications (e.g. MD-102, SC-300, Jamf Certified, GIAC, CISSP, Security+).

***Please apply with a copy of your CV in English.***

Additional Information
- ---------------------

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
* 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR .
* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work.
* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
* 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
* 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare \& public transportation.

jobs.description:
Description

 The Senior Windows Engineer - Managed Services provides senior-level operational support for Microsoft Windows environments across Managed Services customers. The role is primarily focused on Windows engineering, ticket queue management, daily service monitoring, incident resolution, and break-fix support rather than solution design or architecture. This engineer serves as an escalation point for complex Windows issues, participates in an on-call rotation, and works across technologies and teams to understand the broader impact of changes and incidents. Success requires strong communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to solve immediate problems while considering downstream effects across the customer environment.

What You Will Do

Own and manage Windows engineering tickets and service requests through resolution, providing timely and accurate status updates.Monitor Windows services and infrastructure, respond to alerts, identify emerging issues, and take appropriate corrective action.Troubleshoot and resolve complex break-fix issues involving Windows Server and related enterprise services.Serve as a senior escalation point for incidents that require advanced Windows troubleshooting and problem-solving.Administer and support Windows Server environments, including physical, virtual, and cloud-hosted systems.Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, authentication, and related Windows services.Use PowerShell and other tools to automate routine support, reporting, health-check, and remediation activities.Support patching, upgrades, configuration changes, lifecycle activities, and maintenance in accordance with change-management requirements.Assess the broader impact of incidents and technical changes across connected systems, customer teams, and other technology towers.Communicate clearly with customers and internal teams regarding issues, risks, dependencies, progress, and resolution.Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, support procedures, knowledge articles, and operational standards.Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, networking, application, and service delivery teams in a multi-technology Managed Services environment.Mentor other engineers and share technical knowledge and operational best practices.Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation to support service availability outside standard business hours.What We Expect of You

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and at least 7 years of relevant infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent professional experience.At least 5 years of experience administering and supporting Windows Server in enterprise environments.Strong experience troubleshooting Windows infrastructure incidents and resolving complex operational issues.Strong experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Windows security, certificates, and identity services.Experience creating PowerShell automation for operational support, reporting, health checks, and remediation.Experience with Windows virtualization, clustering, patching, configuration management, monitoring, backup, and recovery technologies.Experience working with ticketing systems, managing an engineering queue, and meeting service-level commitments.Experience supporting business-critical services within Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.Strong communication and customer-service skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences.Ability to evaluate problems from multiple perspectives, anticipate downstream impacts, identify affected stakeholders, and communicate proactively.Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, document solutions clearly, and collaborate across technical teams.Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.Experience supporting Windows environments in a Managed Services, multi-customer, or enterprise operations setting, is a plus.Experience with Microsoft Azure or hybrid Windows environments, is a plus.Experience with Hyper-V, Windows Server Failover Clustering, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Server Update Services, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Intune, or comparable tools, is a plus.Experience with Azure Arc, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, or System Center Operations Manager, is a plus.Experience supporting Remote Desktop Services, Internet Information Services, file services, print services, or Windows-based application platforms, is a plus.Experience with enterprise backup, replication, disaster recovery, and business-continuity technologies, is a plus.Microsoft certification in Windows Server, Azure administration, security, or a related technology, is a plus.ITIL Foundation certification is a plus.Pay range: $106,000 - $150,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

CDW is an equal opportunity employer. Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Position Summary

The IT Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, supporting, and continuously improving endpoint technologies that enable a secure, productive, and modern digital workplace. This role supports the enterprise endpoint ecosystem across Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android platforms, leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro, endpoint security, automation, and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) solutions.

Develop automation and proactive remediation solutions using scripting and modern management capabilities. Monitor device compliance, patching, endpoint security, and lifecycle processes. jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled IT Operations Engineer to join our US IT support team. Reporting directly to the Global IT Head, you will serve as the frontline technical support for our US sites and global operations, handling L1/L2 incidents across networks, computer systems, servers, peripherals, and Microsoft 365. You will be responsible for ensuring a stable and efficient IT environment for our end users, delivering high-quality helpdesk services with a service-oriented mindset. You will also participate in the development of IT operational policies, guidelines, and end-user documentation. This role offers the opportunity to participate in global projects and collaborate with international IT teams.

Key Responsibilities

1）End-User Support & Troubleshooting

Provide first-level (L1) and second-level (L2) technical support to end users, resolving issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and mobile devices.Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system (Windows/macOS), and common office software (Microsoft Office, email clients, collaboration tools) issues.Manage user accounts, permissions, and access control in Active Directory, Azure AD, and other identity management platforms.Provide VIP support to key executives, ensuring timely and high-quality service delivery.Document issue resolution steps and contribute to the knowledge base for future reference.2）Microsoft 365 Administration & Support

Provide L1/L2 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online (email issues), SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Teams (meeting, chat, file sharing).Troubleshoot and resolve common M365 issues such as mailbox access, calendar sharing, permissions, and sync problems.Assist in user onboarding/offboarding processes related to M365 account provisioning and license management.Support end users with M365 collaboration tools usage, providing guidance and best practice recommendations.3）Network & Infrastructure Support

Assist in the maintenance and troubleshooting of local area networks (LAN), wireless networks (Wi-Fi), and basic network devices (switches, routers, access points).Perform basic network cabling, patching, and device configuration tasks.Support server room operations, including environmental monitoring, hardware maintenance coordination, and basic server administration (Windows Server).Troubleshoot server-related issues at L2 level, including file sharing, print services, and application server access.4）Data Backup & Recovery

Assist in the execution and monitoring of routine data backup operations for servers, critical systems, and user data.Support data recovery efforts in case of accidental deletion, hardware failure, or system corruption.Regularly verify the integrity and validity of backup data in coordination with senior team members.Maintain backup logs and documentation, ensuring compliance with global data protection policies.5）Asset Management & Standardization

Manage the full IT asset lifecycle, including procurement coordination, receiving, deployment, inventory tracking, and retirement/disposal.Maintain and update IT asset inventory and CMDB, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with global standards.Track asset usage and warranty status, proactively plan for equipment refresh cycles.Ensure user equipment complies with global IT standards and information security policies.6）Video Conferencing & Collaboration Support

Provide L1/L2 support for video conferencing systems (Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Cisco Webex, or equivalent) in meeting rooms and executive spaces.Troubleshoot meeting connectivity issues, audio/video quality problems, and peripheral device (camera, microphone, display) failures.Assist with the setup and testing of virtual meeting configurations for hybrid and remote collaboration.Maintain meeting room equipment inventory and perform routine health checks.7）Policy Development & Documentation

Draft, maintain, and update IT operational management policies, including end-user computing standards, IT asset management guidelines, and helpdesk service procedures.Develop and maintain user-friendly IT tool usage documentation (e.g., M365 user guides, VPN setup instructions, printer configuration guides, video conferencing quick-start guides) for end users.Create and update technical knowledge base articles for internal IT team reference.Ensure all documentation is clear, accurate, and aligned with global IT standards.8）Global Project Collaboration & Support

Collaborate with global IT teams on project deployments, providing on-site IT support for new site setups, office relocations, or system migrations.Participate in the rollout of global IT initiatives and standards to US locations.Provide feedback and local insights to global IT teams to improve service delivery.

Qualifications

Required

College degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT helpdesk or IT operations support in an enterprise environment.Solid knowledge of computer hardware, Windows/macOS operating systems, and common office software.Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and end-user support (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams).Basic understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN) and hands-on experience troubleshooting LAN/WAN and Wi-Fi issues.Familiar with Windows Server administration (Active Directory, file sharing, print services).Knowledge of data backup operations and basic understanding of data recovery concepts.Experience with IT asset management and inventory tracking processes.Experience supporting video conferencing systems (Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, or equivalent).Strong written communication skills — able to draft clear and structured operational policies, user guides, and technical documentation.Excellent customer service and verbal communication skills, with a strong sense of responsibility and a proactive work attitude.Fluent English is required (spoken and written) for daily communication with US-based end users and direct reporting to the Global IT Head. Chinese language capability is a plus.Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under pressure.Preferred
