jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

 Data governance or quality credentials such as Collibra Ranger, or the DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional). A recognized cloud security or privacy certification is a plus given the regulated setting.

The salary range for this position is: $125,000-$175,000+k/annually. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. This range is exclusive of any bonuses or commissions. HIKE2 offers a wide range of benefits for full time employees which may include medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more.

 Don’t meet every requirement? As an innovation consultancy, we recognize that talent is not always related to job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. If you are excited to make a positive impact, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for our organization, whether it be this role or another.

If you require an accommodation to complete the application or participate in the interview process, please let us know.

At HIKE2, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is looking for an experienced and motivated solutions engineer with a passion for endpoint security controls that protect the workforce from attacks. This engineer will work closely with our sales team and ultimately be responsible for the technical “win” during the sales cycle. The Domain Consultant – Endpoint must demonstrate value during presentations, articulate technical challenges, pair with Palo Alto Networks solutions, and provide technical knowledge and experience to earn customer trust.

Palo Alto Networks Endpoint Privilege Manager (part of the Idira platform), a critical and foundational endpoint control addresses the underlying weaknesses of endpoint defenses against a privileged attacker and helps enterprises defend against these attacks.

Palo Alto Networks Domain Consultants work with the sales organization and are responsible for establishing the value of Palo Alto Networks products to prospective and current customers through demos, presentations, meetings, and proofs of concepts (POCs). Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

Responsibilities

Build and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations to create excitement around Palo Alto Networks technology. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.Plan and execute POC evaluations of Palo Alto Networks products with prospective customers. Use your sales experience to position Palo Alto Networks value and differentiators to acquire the technical win.Document customer interactions in Salesforce.Collect and deliver constant feedback to Palo Alto Networks product management team to influence product direction and champion the voice of your customers.Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).

jobs.description:
IT SECURITY ENGINEER

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com http://Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we're building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Why this role is different

We treat internal IT as a product and our employees as its users, not as tickets. If your answer to a repeated problem is to do it faster by hand, this isn't the seat — and it isn't a back-room coding role either.

You'll be the engineer who builds the platform that provisions, supports and secures every Wordsmith employee, end to end. The goal is for the function to get more automated as we grow, not need more people.

The Role

You'll own onboarding, access, devices and offboarding as one connected system, and build the tooling — including coding agent workflows — that removes the manual steps at every stage. You'll be hands-on with the physical side of the job too, in the Edinburgh office.

What you'll do

 - Build a joiner pipeline that reads a new hire from Humaans, creates their identity in Okta, assigns app access by group rule, and triggers zero-touch laptop enrolment in Jamf — no manual steps

 - Build a Slack assistant, backed by a coding agent, that handles requests like “I need access to X” or “my laptop is slow” and either fixes them or routes them, resolving most without a human

 - Build a hardware vending machine for the Edinburgh office that dispenses chargers, dongles, headsets and loan laptops against an employee's identity, with stock reordered automatically

 - Write scripts and infrastructure as code that configure devices, enforce security baselines, and produce compliance evidence on their own

 - Build an offboarding flow that revokes access everywhere, wipes and reclaims the device, and files the record the moment someone is marked as a leaver

What good looks like in the first year

 - Zero-touch onboarding: within six months, a new hire's accounts, apps and access provision automatically from Humaans through Okta, and their laptop self-enrols — day one setup takes minutes, not hours

 - Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

 - Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

 - Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

 - Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

Who you might be

We're not hiring a traditional IT person — we're hiring someone who builds. That might mean you're:

 - a software engineer who likes owning systems end to end and wants a broad, high-ownership remit

 - a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

 - a strong IT or systems person who already codes and automates rather than clicking through consoles

 - someone from a smaller company or an MSP who has wired up tools, identity and devices and scripted the boring parts away

What matters is the instinct to automate anything you have to do twice, and to build the tool rather than do the task. We'll teach the IT domain to a strong builder — we won't teach someone to be a builder.

What we're looking for

 - You write real code and automate with APIs and scripts — Python, Bash or TypeScript. This isn't optional.

 - You think in systems: identity, access, data flows and lifecycle

 - You're comfortable using AI coding agents to build and ship tooling fast

 - You care about security and doing things properly, not just quickly

 - You're happy working on-site in Edinburgh and hands-on with real hardware

Bonus:

 - Exposure to identity and device tooling such as Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf

 - Experience with SOC 2 or security compliance

 - Having run or automated onboarding, end

jobs.description:
### About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

### **About the role:**

We are looking for an IT Systems Engineer to build and secure the identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM) systems for employees who build agents and internal tools every day. You will design access and device policies that let them ship quickly without exposing company data, and automate the work with scripts, API integrations, and AI tooling alongside our IT and Security engineers. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, New York City, or Austin, with three days a week in the office.

### **What you’ll do:**

- Configure Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning
- Build onboarding, role-change, and offboarding automation that keeps employee access current
- Configure and maintain MDM for device enrollment, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls
- Build scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems, using AI to write and troubleshoot code and reviewing its output before it ships
- Partner with Security on least-privilege access that lets employees connect agents and internal tools to company systems safely, along with device security standards and access reviews, and serve as the escalation point for complex identity and device issues

### **What you need:**

- 7+ years of hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and working knowledge of the other
- Administered Okta and integrated applications using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)
- Configured and operated an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, or Intune
- Wrote automation in Python or Bash against APIs, and used AI to build and troubleshoot it, reviewing generated code before deploying

### **Bonus if you:**

- Managed Okta or other IT systems as code with Terraform, including version-controlled configurations, code review, and configuration drift management
- Supported AWS identity and access configurations
- Built or hosted a project on Vercel

### **Benefits:**

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- Generous paid time off and parental leave
- Professional development stipend
- Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

### Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.
- Inclusive Healthcare Package.
- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
- Flexible Time Off.
- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

### **Disclosures:**

- **Privacy:** Please review our [Job Applicant Privacy Policy](https://vercel.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice) for more information on how we handle your data.
- **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, VIRTUALIZATION & STORAGE

 As an IT Infrastructure Engineer on the infrastructure team, you will collaborate with internal teams to deliver innovative solutions for SpaceX’s growing infrastructure demands. You will ensure quality and reliability of systems across the software lifecycle while scaling and supporting data center infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes, and storage environments. You should have strong opinions on designing, testing, and operating virtualization platforms and multi-tier storage (enterprise + HPC) and be ready to build the next generation of SpaceX data center platforms.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement and maintain a scalable, robust VMware environment and identify efficiencies supporting critical applications

- Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery tiers

- Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads

- Administer enterprise storage platforms (NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Cohesity, Scality) and manage access controls, permissions, and protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI)

- Perform data center deployments, monitor performance, and troubleshoot production issues across virtualization, storage, transport (RDMA), and protocol layers

- Develop automation/tooling for monitoring, capacity planning, configuration management, and alerting; define standards for deployment and performance tuning

- Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align virtualization and storage strategies with workload requirements

- Participate in on-call rotation, scheduled maintenance, and occasional physical installation support

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or related technical field and 3+ years of engineering experience in an enterprise environment; OR 5+ years of engineering experience in lieu of a degree

- 1+ years of professional experience managing virtualized server environments

- 5+ years of experience in IT storage engineering with enterprise platforms (NetApp, Pure Storage, Scality, Vast or similar)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with full lifecycle management of large-scale VMware environments and supporting container infrastructure with Kubernetes

- Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools

- Deep knowledge of RDMA, congestion control, lossless Ethernet, RoCEv2, and/or InfiniBand storage fabrics in HPC or latency-sensitive environments

- Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible

- Familiarity with HPC schedulers (Slurm, LFS) and how storage tiers interact with job scheduling

- Linux and Windows OS system administration experience

- Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills; strong written and verbal communication

- Willingness to respond to after-hours triage and operational support

- Strong understanding of storage protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI) and experience with client/server systems, monitoring tools, enterprise networking, and virtualization

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
IT Infrastructure Engineer: $130,000.00-$175,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

### Responsibilities

- Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
- Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
- Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
- Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
- Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
- Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
- Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
- Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
- Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
- Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
- Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
- Write Python and shell scripts
- Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

### Strong candidates may also have

- Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
- Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
- Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
- Have used LLMs to automate ops work

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

Job Description

IT Professional who has built and operated large-scale enterprise EUC environments—not simply administered them. Successful candidates will have experience designing secure, highly available EUC platforms, leading infrastructure modernization efforts, implementing enterprise authentication solutions, and automating operations across Citrix, Azure, and virtualization technologies.

Lead the architecture, engineering, and operational support of a global end-user computing (EUC) platform supporting thousands of users.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, modernizing, and supporting a hybrid client virtualization environment, (Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktops (CVAD), Azure Virtual, DAAS, etc).

The ideal candidate has deep experience building secure, highly available Virtual Desktop platforms, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and can collaborate comfortably across virtualization, identity, networking, automation, and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

Design, engineer, and support a global enterprise end-user computing (EUC) environment

Lead virtualization modernization initiatives, including migrating workloads while ensuring high availability and minimal business disruption.

Design and support secure remote access, authentication, and certificate services

Deploy, administer, and optimize Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), including host pools, session hosts, FSLogix, image management, and Azure integrations.

Develop automation and operational tooling using PowerShell, Python, or other scripting technologies to improve provisioning, monitoring, and platform management.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex virtual desktop issues issues while serving as a senior technical escalation point.

Partner with infrastructure, cloud, networking, identity, and security teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable client virtualization services.

Maintain architecture documentation, operational runbooks, and engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

Designing and supporting enterprise Virtual Desktop (CVAD, AVD, VDI)) environments.

Strong understanding of enterprise authentication like: AD, Entra ID (Azure AD), SAML, LDAP, MFA.

Well versed in M365 environments

Networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, proxies, and load balancing.

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Manager experience.

Experience with monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or similar observability tools.

Experience supporting large enterprise environments

Management Consulting experience

jobs.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we're just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About The Role

At Thatch, technology is how our teams get their work done, securely and without friction. As our IT Ops/Systems Engineer, you'll own the systems and access infrastructure that keeps the company running: endpoint compliance, identity and access management, and the operational backbone behind our security initiatives. This role goes beyond day-to-day support. You'll be the owner of company-wide compliance, conditional access and privileged access workflows in a Mac-first environment, with the autonomy to build the systems and automation that let us scale securely. If you want real ownership over how a fast-growing technology company manages access and identity, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Own our technology stack including Okta, Iru, Mac, iOS, Android, Rippling MDM/SSO, 1Password, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Zoom, Linear, and NotionDrive endpoint fleet compliance to 100% coverage across MDM, EDR, and DLP, and own remediation when devices fall out of complianceAdminister conditional access policies (device trust, managed browser enforcement) and own the exception and escalation process when legitimate access gets blockedOwn the Privileged Access Management (PAM) workflow, including replacing manual quarterly access reviews with automated request, approval, and time-bound removalRun trusted device and MFA enrollment, and lead remediation campaigns for weak or breached passwordsOwn the complete employee lifecycle experience from onboarding through offboarding, managing access control, hardware provisioning, and audit-ready documentationVet and administer new SaaS tooling for SSO/IdP compliance as part of vendor onboarding, expose and remediate shadow ITBuild and maintain a knowledge base that empowers employees to solve common issues independentlyIdentify and build automation for repetitive IT and access-management tasksPartner with the Head of IT and Security to support company-wide initiatives and maintain our security posture

Background we're looking for

4-6 years of hands-on IT support or systems engineering experience in a corporate environment, ideally including some ownership of identity/access infrastructureCertification in Network+, Security+, JAMF, Bettercloud, Okta, or comparable credentialsDeep understanding of SSO, 2FA, passkeys, conditional access, and password management systemsExperience administering or implementing a PAM tool, or a clear grasp of the concepts and willingness to build one from scratchStrong knowledge of security principles and best practices with proven ability to implement them at scaleExcellent follow-through and organizational skills. You never let tasks fall through the cracks

Experience We'd Be Particularly Excited About

Experience driving a fleet from partial to full MDM/EDR/DLP compliance, and building the exception workflow that kept support ticket volume manageableSelf-motivated individuals who can work independently with minimal supervision and take ownership of projects from start to finishQuick learners who can master new technologies with minimal guidancePatient communicators with flexible, inclusive interpersonal skills who genuinely enjoy helping othersProblem-solvers who are resilient in learning from mistakes and view technical challenges as opportunitiesPeople who thrive in fast-paced environments and can adapt quickly to changing priorities

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you'll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

30 minute video meeting to talk through your background and interest in Thatch30 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience and the role30 minute video meeting to meet 4-5 members of the team30 minute video meeting with department leadership to discuss alignment to our company values and career goals20-30 minute video meeting with our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principles

Estimated Compensation Range

$145,000—$158,000 USD

jobs.description:
BUILD A CAREER THAT BUILDS WHAT'S NEXT

 For more than 65 years, The State Group's 3,500+ professionals have built and maintained the infrastructure that keeps businesses and industries moving across North America. Today, the company is a multi-trade industrial contractor powering industry solutions and sustaining critical operations across electrical, mechanical, civil, communications, maintenance, and emerging technology—from major construction projects to the ongoing work that keeps critical operations running as a trusted service partner of choice.

 We invest in our people, technology, and innovation to strengthen how we work today and prepare for what's ahead. At The State Group, there are tremendous opportunities to build your skills, grow your career, and be part of something bigger.

 The State Group is seeking a Senior Systems & Endpoint Administrator based in Franklin, Tennessee.

 BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

   This position is integral to our success and offers opportunities for career advancement.

   100% PAID medical, dental, and vision insurance.

   Paid time off, including vacation, sick days, and holidays.

   401(k) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting.

   Competitive compensation, annual pay increases, and bonuses.

   State embraces and encourages workplace diversity.

   Forge partnerships that last through teamwork, integrity, and respect.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO

   Manage and optimize ManageEngine for patching, endpoint management, asset tracking, compliance monitoring, and reporting.

   Oversee patch deployment and maintenance for Windows servers, workstations, and mobile devices.

   Support and maintain secure, reliable Windows Server and endpoint environments.

   Administer BitLocker encryption, recovery keys, CIS Benchmark security baselines, and endpoint security controls.

   Manage the full IT asset lifecycle, from deployment through retirement and secure disposal.

   Troubleshoot and resolve vulnerabilities, patch failures, system conflicts, performance issues, and endpoint incidents.

   Develop automation, standards, procedures, reporting, and remediation strategies to improve operational efficiency and security.

   Partner with technical and business teams to support compliance, security, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 WHAT YOU NEED TO JOIN OUR TEAM

   5+ years of systems administration experience supporting enterprise Windows environments and a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

   Strong hands-on expertise with Windows Server administration, endpoint management, enterprise patching, and vulnerability remediation.

   Experience with ManageEngine or a similar endpoint management platform, including patch scheduling, testing, deployment, and compliance reporting.

   Working knowledge of BitLocker, CIS Benchmarks, security hardening, configuration management, and IT asset lifecycle management.

   Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

   Experience with Microsoft Intune, modern endpoint management, workstation imaging, security audits, vulnerability management programs, or regulatory compliance initiatives is preferred.

   Microsoft, security, or infrastructure certifications are preferred.

   A strong commitment to our team, our customers, and the environments we serve.

   Embrace challenges, commit to continuous improvement, and deliver exceptional work.

   To learn more about our organization, visit www.stategroup.com.

 The State Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for applicants with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please email M.Harris@stategroup.com.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the roleThe Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

ResponsibilitiesOwn endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built inOperate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident responseBuild patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experienceDesign zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day oneSupport a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleetTurn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops workPartner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controlsTake shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolveYou may be a good fit if youHave 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teamsHave managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDMTreat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consolesGo deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensionsWrite Python and shell scriptsWrite design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you buildStrong candidates may also haveHave operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaSHave worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetryHave experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloudHave working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)Have used LLMs to automate ops workDeadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're differentWe believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.description:
#### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

#### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We're looking for an Endpoint Engineer to own how every laptop, phone, and piece of office technology at Panthalassa is deployed, secured, and kept healthy. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role sitting alongside our IT Support function. You'll lead the initiatives that let us scale device management without scaling headcount: zero touch deployment for Windows and macOS, BYOD support for mobile devices, endpoint security baselines, and the device compliance posture our access policies depend on. You'll also serve as an escalation point and mentor for our IT Support Specialists, and act as our subject matter expert in physical office technology, from access control to printers to patch panels.

Our IT Support team runs the day to day of the physical office: badge issuance, printer break/fix, conference room checks, and desk moves. You own the design, standards, and escalations behind all of it, and you get your hands dirty on build-outs and the hard problems. One day you're writing configuration profiles to automate workstation security, the next you're installing A/V equipment and running patch cables.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

#### **Responsibilities**

##### **Endpoint Management and Zero Touch Deployment**

- Administer our MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud) for Windows and macOS devices, including enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.
- Architect and execute our zero touch provisioning rollout (Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager / Automatic Device Enrollment), eliminating manual imaging for new device deployments.
- Drive device enrollment to full coverage and keep it there through regular audit.
- Design and implement BYOD policies and enrollment workflows that enable secure access from personal devices.
- Own the device lifecycle: procurement standards, refresh cadence, repair, and secure decommissioning.

##### **Endpoint Security and Compliance**

- Build and enforce endpoint security baselines, patch management cadences, and device health policies.
- Deliver the device compliance signals our Conditional Access policies rely on, working with our IAM Engineer to keep policy and posture in sync.
- Monitor and respond to endpoint telemetry and security alerts, driving remediation with the relevant owners.
- Translate compliance framework requirements (NIST or equivalent) into concrete endpoint controls and documentation.

##### **Escalation and Mentorship**

- Serve as the primary escalation point for our IT Support Specialists on complex hardware, OS, and device issues.
- Mentor the support team and transfer knowledge deliberately so fixes land at tier 1 the next time.
- Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base content in Confluence.

#### **Required Qualifications**

- Experience administering endpoint management including MDM, device compliance, and application deployment.
- Experience building or running zero touch deployment at scale (Autopilot, Apple Business Manager / ADE, or equivalent).
- Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls.
- Comfort working across abstraction layers, designing systems one day and swapping hardware the next.

#### **Desired Qualifications**

- Experience administering a modern MDM solution such as Intune, Jamf, JumpCloud, or Kandji.
- Comfort with scripting for endpoint automation (PowerShell, bash, Python).
- Familiarity with zero trust concepts and how device posture feeds access decisions.
- Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent).
- Experience with endpoint telemetry and security alert response, including triage, remediation, and root cause.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

#### **Additional Requirements**

- Available for occasional evening and weekend work to support deployments, maintenance windows, and office moves.
- Travel to vendor sites and other company locations as needed.
- Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

#### **Compensation and Benefits**

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

- Cash compensation of $120,000 - $180,000.
- Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
- A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
  - Flexible paid time off
  - Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

You will lead Client Platform — the team responsible for the software that lives in customer environments and makes NodeZero's autonomous pentests possible. Client Platform owns two sub-teams: Image Build & Release (the factory that produces and signs the NodeZero runner container image) and OTA Services (the system that keeps runners current across thousands of customer environments). Every pentest NodeZero runs depends on this team's work being reliable, secure, and fast.

 - Team Building & Culture: Build, mentor, and grow Client Platform to ~10 engineers across Image Build & Release and OTA Services. You will directly manage the Engineering Managers of both sub-teams and set the technical and cultural direction for the full org. Establish engineering norms and a culture of ownership for a team whose software runs in environments you cannot control.

 - Image Build & Release: Lead end-to-end CI/CD workflows to create, sign, and reliably publish the NodeZero runner container image. Own software supply chain security: reproducible builds, image signing, SBOM generation, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - OTA Services: Architect and operate the over-the-air update delivery system that keeps NodeZero runners current across thousands of customer environments — reliably, securely, and without requiring manual customer IT intervention.

 - Security Research Partnership: Collaborate closely with Security Research to ensure the runner seamlessly executes new autonomous pentest capabilities as they ship.

 - Act as a Product Owner: Partner with product managers, security researchers, and customer success to manage the client-side roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Platform Leadership & Architecture

 - Demonstrated expertise leading teams that design, build, and operate containerized software (Docker, VM images) deployed into on-premise or customer-managed environments.

 - Experience implementing robust software supply chain practices — secure builds, image signing (cosign, Notary), reproducible builds, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - Experience designing and operating OTA update mechanisms for distributed agents or edge software at scale — including staged rollouts, rollback, and delivery verification.

 - Ability to reason about correctness in opaque, customer-controlled environments where you cannot observe failure modes directly.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

 - Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for shipped software.

 - Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous code review standards, robust testing across diverse customer environments, and a strong culture of ownership.

 - Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus, and ensures decisions account for customer environment variables.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficient in Go (preferred), Python, or C++.

 - Strong Linux OS-level operations: container runtimes, networking in corporate environments, systemd, process isolation.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines for building and signing container images (cosign, Notary v2, or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with OTA update protocols and frameworks: TUF (The Update Framework), Omaha, or custom mechanisms.

 - Understanding of TLS, certificate pinning, and secure software delivery in hostile network environments.

Nice to Haves

 - Exposure to cybersecurity, pentesting tools, or vulnerability remediation.

 - Experience with cross-platform agents (Windows/Linux) and endpoint

jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Ecosystem Integration team that drives core product integration with Nutanix Partners. You will be closely working with Partners, product management team and solution architect. The role requires deep technical acumen plus an ability to collaborate with various groups inside and outside of the company. The team fosters collaboration, innovation, and excellence, where every team member's contribution is valued and acknowledged. Working within this dynamic team, you will have the chance to learn from some of the best minds in the industry and work on cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of technology.

About the Team

You will report to the Sr Director, Engineering and work in an onsite setup, where you will be required to be present in the office at least three days a week. This arrangement fosters a sense of camaraderie and allows for more seamless collaboration among team members, leading to increased productivity and creativity. Additionally, being in the office most of the week offers the chance to engage face-to-face with colleagues, enabling better communication and relationship building within the team

**Your Role**

- Contribute to the overall architecture, design and implementation of various integration.

- Ability to coordinate and influence internal and external groups (Solution, External partners, Cross functional engineering, product management) spread across geography.

- Develop a deep understanding of complex distributed systems, and design innovative solutions for customer requirements.

- Work closely with development, test, documentation and product management teams to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.

- Engage with customers and partners when needed to solve production issues.

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 5-8 years of industry experience

- Experience with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and large-scale distributed systems preferred.

- Love of programming and rock-solid in one or more languages: C#, Python, Golang. Ideally for enterprise-quality software.

- Deep understanding of APIs and extensive experience of APIs development.

- Familiarity with MS technology and its stack including Azure Cloud

- Knowledge of AI tools and its usage in SDLC process.

**Visa sponsorship is not available for this role at this time.**

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 147,000 and USD $ 294,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

Job Title: Senior Endpoint Engineer

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Type of Travel: None

* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team on a contract supporting the Department of Homeland Security. As a Senior Endpoint Engineer, you will be part of a dynamic team of windows cloud engineers and security specialists with expert experience in Windows, Intune, Autopilot, Enterprise Patching, PKI/Certificates, Azure Active Directory, Virtualization, Cloud, and scripting experience. In this role, you will work across endpoint management and server operations teams driving automation through scripting and testing of new/emerging technologies to deliver faster deployments and decreased workload.

Responsibilities:

\- Support Intune administration and engineering, to include compliance policies for conditional access, application deployment and patching, management and troubleshooting

\- Use Windows Update for Business to keep Windows workstations patched to correct levels

\- Create and deploy Intune configurations, policies, and settings

\- Manage and maintain Windows 11 workstation baseline configurations

\- Support and troubleshooting for Windows Autopilot

\- Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term solutions

\- Package software and updates for deployment in the test and production environments.

\- Develop security baselines based on the recommendations from the Engineering and Security teams.

\- Create reports on device compliance, application deployment, patch management, and software inventory

\- Write PowerShell scripts to automate systems administration tasks

\- Respond to escalated service desk/team requests

\- Provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced systems engineers

\- Communicate effectively (in oral and written form) with a variety of individuals; work well within small and large team environments

\- Serves as liaison with clients, participating in meetings to ensure client needs are met

\- Participates in special projects as required

Qualifications:

Required:

\- Ability to attain DHS EOD

\- BA + 10 years’ applicable experience, AA + 12 years’ applicable experience or 16 years’ experience

\- Intune experience, supporting software packaging and patching

\- Windows Autopilot experience

\- EntraID (AzureAD) experience

\- Expert knowledge of packaging, testing, deployment, and issue remediation

\- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting

Desired:

\- ITIL v3 or v4 certification

\- MCSE Certified

\- Endpoint Administrator Associate certification (Microsoft 365)

\- STIG Policy experience

\- Vulnerability Management experience

\- Cloud Management experience

\- AVD Management

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:
