jobs.title: L1 / L2 IT Systems Engineer
jobs.summary: AllSector Technology is growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated IT professionals to join our team as Level 1 or Level 2 MSP Engineers. This is not a role where you will spend every day doing the same repetitive tasks. As an L1/L2 Engineer,...
jobs.description:
AllSector Technology is growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated IT professionals to join our team as Level 1 or Level 2 MSP Engineers.

This is not a role where you will spend every day doing the same repetitive tasks. As an L1/L2 Engineer, you will be at the heart of our client operations, providing comprehensive support that blends remote help desk calls with scheduled on-site client assistance. Beyond daily support, you will have the opportunity to directly assist senior engineers with complex client project implementations, gaining valuable real-world experience across a wide range of industries.

We provide an environment designed for growth. You will gain hands-on exposure to the latest IT platforms and technologies, including modern Microsoft Cloud solutions, advanced cybersecurity tools, and emerging automation/AI platforms (like Rewst.io and Copilot).

We are seeking individuals who are passionate about technology, genuinely enjoy problem-solving, and are committed to learning new things every day. While you will be part of a collaborative team, the ideal candidate must also possess the judgment and accountability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

Responsibilities

While supporting our customers is the core of the position, our engineers are encouraged to become involved in much more than ticket resolution.

Core Technical Support:

Provide friendly, timely, and expert remote and onsite technical support to AllSector managed services clients.Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Windows desktop/server environments, hardware, applications, and peripherals.Support Microsoft 365 applications, Exchange Online, and core Azure/Intune services.Manage user accounts, permissions, and access issues within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.Resolve networking, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and connectivity issues.Utilize RMM and monitoring platforms to proactively respond to alerts and investigate potential client issues before they escalate.Communicate clearly and professionally with customers regarding ticket status, updates, and resolutions.Maintain accurate and detailed documentation in IT Glue and create/update ConnectWise service tickets.

Projects & Advanced Initiatives:

Assist senior engineers with client technology projects, such as Microsoft 365 migrations and infrastructure upgrades.Participate in internal technology, automation, and AI initiatives.Help test new scripts, workflows, software integrations, and plugins in real-world environments.Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks using platforms like Rewst.io.

Qualifications

We do not expect candidates to be experts in every technology listed below, but you must demonstrate a strong technical aptitude and a genuine desire to learn and research unfamiliar technologies.

Company-Wide Requirements:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with both technical and non-technical users.Strong troubleshooting skills with a proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving.The ability to prioritize effectively and work well both independently and within a collaborative team environment.High standards for accountability, professional judgment, and quality documentation.Travel to clients

Travel Requirements:

This position may require occasional travel to client locations for on-site technical support, project implementations, installations, troubleshooting, and other client-related activities as needed. Most work will be performed remotely or from the AllSector Technology office; however, candidates must be comfortable providing on-site support when circumstances require it.Travel is primarily expected within the local/regional service area, with advance notice provided whenever practical. Candidates must possess a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation for travel to client locations.

Education & Professional Development:

College degrees and industry certifications are a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience, home labs, and technical projects are valued equally.We invest in you: AllSector Technology promotes continuous learning. We provide study materials, access to training platforms, and full financial support for relevant certification exams and courses for our staff.

Position-Specific Experience Levels:

Level 1 Engineer

Experience: 0–2+ years in professional IT.Technical Foundation: Solid understanding of desktop and end-user support, Windows 10/11 troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 fundamentals, basic Active Directory/Entra ID knowledge, and core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs).

Level 2 Engineer

Experience: 2–5+ years in professional IT (previous MSP or multi-client support experience preferred).Advanced Skills: Advanced Windows desktop troubleshooting and Windows Server administration; proficiency in Microsoft 365/Azure administration, Intune, and Group Policy; comprehensive understanding of networking (VLANs, firewalls, complex troubleshooting) and experience with RMM, Backup, and Endpoint Security platforms.

Why Join AllSector? Beyond Standard IT Support.

AllSector Technology is building something different. We believe an MSP should not only provide exceptional technology services to its customers — it should also create an environment where its employees can learn, experiment, contribute ideas, and build meaningful, long-term careers.

We are looking for ambitious candidates who want to grow with us as we expand. We aren't just maintaining legacy systems; we are actively innovating and operating at the intersection of modern IT services and software development.

When you join AllSector, you become part of an organization that is pushing boundaries:

We are Innovators & Developers: We don't just use other people's tools; we build our own. We have already developed and launched two proprietary software applications listed on The Tech Tribe and the ConnectWise Marketplace, with several more exciting apps currently in development. You will have a front-row seat to our internal software development and QA processes.

We are Impact-Driven (FCC, E-Rate, & Center4.com): We believe in helping those who help our communities. We are proud to hold a 498SPIN ID in the FCC Rural Healthcare program, helping eligible nonprofits secure subsidies upward of 65% off eligible technology costs. We are also registered providers in the E-Rate program, supporting schools and libraries. Furthermore, our Center4.com initiative acts as a technology entitlement think tank, providing nonprofits with vital information and free resources (templates, guides, E-books) to save them time and money.

We are Security-First: As a CISSP-Led IT Solutions Provider, we prioritize security in everything we do. You will gain exposure to enterprise-grade security frameworks and CISSP-backed offerings that set us apart from competitors.

Our Culture of Growth: We foster a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, and teamwork. We celebrate new ideas, promote from within, and provide the training, mentorship, and financial backing you need to achieve your career goals—whether that's becoming a Senior Engineer, a Cybersecurity Specialist, an Automation Architect, or a Product Lead.

If you are looking for an IT position where you can do more than simply answer support calls and close tickets, we want to hear from you. If you want exposure to the absolute cutting edge of managed services, automation, AI, and proprietary software development, AllSector Technology offers an environment where you can build a remarkable future.

Ready to help us build the next generation of managed IT services?

Apply Today: Please submit your resume and a brief introduction to JoinUs@AllSector.com.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an MDM Operations Lead to support the day-to-day operations and delivery of Master Data Management across domains and global regions for Alexion. This is a delivery-oversight and stakeholder-facing role, not a pure development role. You will connect business and technical teams, keep an eye on the strategic picture, and make sure MDM deployments land on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support day-to-day MDM operations and delivery across multiple data domains and global regions
* Monitor delivery progress and the performance of the delivery team (developers, testers, and support staff)
* Help ensure deployments and releases are delivered on schedule
* Translate business requirements into clear technical work for the delivery team
* Explain technical issues, developments, and outcomes to business stakeholders and the MDM Lead in plain language
* Manage detailed delivery items without losing sight of the broader MDM strategy and major programs
* Partner with the MDM Lead on strategy and programme-level planning

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **Communication:** strong written and verbal communication across business and technical audiences (essential)
* **MDM expertise:** hands-on experience delivering or operating an MDM platform
* **Delivery oversight:** experience monitoring teams, tracking progress, and driving on-time delivery
* **Strategic perspective:** able to balance operational detail with long-term direction

**Technology Preferences (in order of preference)**

**Veeva Network** (ideal) /**Reltio** or another enterprise MDM platform/ **Informatica MDM** or a comparable tool

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Data Management, Master Data Management (MDM), or related enterprise data domains.
* Experience leading or coordinating MDM operations, delivery, or support teams.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders across business and technical functions.
* Experience working in global or multi-regional environments.

About The Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the State, Local, and Education (SLED) market. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with Account Executives to influence deal strategy and deliver measurable impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve helped grow a SLED-focused B2B SaaS business, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location: We are flexible on remote work from home if you reside in one of the following U.S. states: CO, *IL, KS, or TX.

5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise level SLED customers.Evolved from a technical background (e.g., TAM, support, systems engineer) with practical insight into IT operations at scale across government or education environmentsStrong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for administrators, technical staff, and agency leadershipBrings deep domain knowledge in IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms within the public sectorUnderstands how IT teams in SLED environments evaluate, procure, and scale solutions—along with insight into procurement processes and compliance considerationsKnown for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindsetOperates with adaptability and urgency, excelling in fast-paced, high-growth environments

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.**

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent **English**(C1 or C2)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.description:
**++RESPONSIBILITIES++**

1. Determine and define inventory levels of specified items
2. Provide clear item coverage, communicating when current inventory will be utilized
3. Use item lead times as an input to define items that are "at risk"
4. Identify any open purchase orders at risk due to revision changeover
5. Coordinate with local Purchasing team on target dates for revision changeover
6. Ensure updates are provided to cross-functional teams timely in order to meet a strict SLA
7. Maintain an organized and well-defined item tracking system that is easily accessible to cross-functional teams
8. Proactively communicate the need to manage open purchase orders and revision integrity with local Purchasing team
9. Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to understand material dispositions and collaborate to minimize impacts on Operations (minimize scrap, rework, and inventory costs)
10. Support material availability and ensure no disruptions due to revision changeover
11. Serve as primary point of contact between local Purchasing team and MDM Operations team
12. Gather, scrub, manipulate data to generate average to complex reports and analysis related to Part and Supplier requirement
13. Ensure predefined process is followed to ensure accuracy of information
14. Maintain task tracking sheet for CCO revision updates, input new items, monitor stakeholders' approval and aging and for closure items
15. Maintain knowledge of products and parts

* **Intermediate MS Excel knowledge**
* **Intermediate MS PowerPoint knowledge**
* **Strong written and communication skills**
* **Experience in using ERP system**

jobs.description:
What Makes a Honda, Is Who Makes a Honda

Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.

Key Accountabilities

 Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration. Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions. Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams. Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies. Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments. Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives. Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Minimum Education

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.

Required Qualifications

 At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience. 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms. 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations. 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other Required Technical Skills

 Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management. Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management. Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices. Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements. Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

Highly Desirables

 Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.

This is an onsite job. One remote workday per week may be possible with prior departmental approval.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, End User Services & IT Automation
jobs.summary: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks...
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

At Smartsheet, we're scaling our India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services in a Mac-first environment.

You'll sit at the center of our AI and automation strategy for the service desk, leading two teams: Security & Desktop Systems, who pair Service Desk support with first-line security triage, and IT Automation, who build the AI agents and workflows that make that work faster. You'll decide where agents, deterministic automation, and people each belong, and own your teams' performance against SLAs and quality targets.

You'll partner daily with our US IT leadership, aligning on standards and sharing what works. For the right candidate, there is a clear path to Director within 12-18 months as we continue to scale the India GCC.

**A note on the role:** This is a hands-on leadership role, though not a hands-on-every-day one. You'll stay close enough to the technology to prototype, review, and debug alongside your engineers, and to step in when the team is stretched or something breaks. If you want to lead from a distance, this isn't the right fit. If you want to lead from credibility, it is.

#### You Will

**AI & Automation Strategy**

- Own the AI and automation strategy for the service desk, lead the IT Automation Engineers in delivering it, and decide which workflows suit AI agents, deterministic automation, or people
- Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
- Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting), and design and review agent-based workflows end to end, including the tools they call and where a human approves
- Set guardrails for automated actions, including identity verification, least-privilege access, permissions-aware data retrieval, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive requests
- Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help build, debug, and fix automations when they fail or stall

**Security & Desktop Systems**

- Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts and peer service desk managers in other regions to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
- Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
- Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
- Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
- Step in hands-on when volumes spike or critical issues arise, and coach people through the fix
- Keep knowledge base articles and process documentation current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

- Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
- Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
- Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
- Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
- Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**People Leadership**

- Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
- Partner with peer managers across regions to align service standards, share automation and best practices, and keep the global service desk experience consistent
- Design and lead onboarding for new team members
- Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

#### You Have

**Experience**

- 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
- 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations, including influencing peers and stakeholders across regions without direct authority
- Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to IT workflows, such as function/tool calling, MCP, or API-based orchestration, and the judgment to know when to use agents, deterministic automation, or humans
- Experience overseeing Tier 1 security operations, such as alert triage, escalation, and incident response, ideally including endpoint (EDR) alerts
- Experience leading engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical depth to review their work, set direction, and contribute when needed
- A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity, and of stepping into technical problems credibly when the team needs it

**Technical skills**

- Strong hands-on expertise in macOS endpoint management through Jamf (or a comparable Apple MDM such as Kandji or Mosyle), including zero-touch enrollment, policy and patch management, and Apple Business Manager. Our fleet is roughly 80% macOS.
- Working knowledge of Windows endpoint management through Intune, covering the remaining 20% of our fleet
- Solid understanding of identity and productivity platforms (Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory; M365)
- Working knowledge of an ITSM platform such as Freshservice, including workflow design, API integrations, and governance
- Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, PowerShell, or shell) sufficient to review and contribute to automation work
- Familiarity with EDR platforms (including macOS coverage), firewalls, and ITIL or equivalent frameworks

**Preferred**

- Experience building agents with LLM APIs/SDKs or agent frameworks, including retrieval (RAG) over IT knowledge
- Experience building and scaling a service desk or IT automation function

**Work Style**

- Excellent English communication, strong self-motivation, and reliable follow-through
- Comfortable moving between leading the team and rolling up your sleeves
- Willing to join a short early-morning call for US handover, and the occasional evening global meeting
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

If you meet most of this but not every bullet, we'd still like to hear from you.

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:
Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).Must be a U.S. Citizen.Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

DESIRED SKILLS:
CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Overview:

We don't simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you - offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:

 Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.

 Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.

 Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm.

 Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions.

 Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID.

 Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm's core collaboration tools.

 Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools.

 Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your impact:

 Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions

 Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity

 Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement

 Be a key contributor to developing IT's vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors to your success:

 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.

 Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.

 Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.

 Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus.

 Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities.

 Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape.

 Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

About Chatham Financial:

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.

It's clear ahead.

Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.

We help guide the way-giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.description:
Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

This position will support our newly awarded DCSA contract.

Description

Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:
Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).Must be a U.S. Citizen.Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

DESIRED SKILLS:
CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions:

Sitting for long periodsStanding for long periodsAmbulate throughout an officeAmbulate between several buildings

jobs.description:
We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.

We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.
At JUSTROCKET , we're assembling the brightest minds to create exceptional teams and an ecosystem of like-minded and execution-oriented experts. Since 2016, we have been the heartbeat of the tech community in Cluj-Napoca.

About the project:

The partner we are hiring for is an IT service company based in Germany. Our partner builds and runs complex IT landscapes for clients in automotive, finance, and other regulated industries. Now they are strengthening their own corporate IT team and looking for someone who keeps identity, devices and tools running smoothly from the inside.

Some more interesting project facts

💡 You own identity and access for the whole company, not just a ticket queue

💡 Real production responsibility across Okta, Workspace ONE, Atlassian and more

💡 Automation is part of the job, not a side project

💡 International / cross-border team working closely together

💡 Security and compliance thinking from day one, ISO 27001 and TISAX are close by

💡 and many more – let's talk!

Aufgaben

We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer who is ready to run and shape the corporate IT of our partner, a fast-growing IT service company with projects in automotive, finance and other regulated industries.

As part of the Corporate IT team, you will keep identity, devices and tools running smoothly for the whole company.

Your activities will include:

⏩ Own identity and access management with Okta, covering SSO, MFA and the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding

⏩ Manage device fleets across MacBook, Windows and Android through Workspace ONE UEM, including enrollment, compliance and security policies
⏩ Keep the tool landscape in shape, Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro and the Atlassian suite, so colleagues actually enjoy using it
⏩ Build request types, workflows, SLAs and approval processes in Jira Service Management
⏩ Automate recurring work with Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows and n8n, so tasks run without manual clicking
⏩ Track CVEs across the fleet, review audit logs and set up automated security reporting, in line with GDPR and BDSG
⏩ Apply ISO 27001 and TISAX thinking to daily work, without owning the certifications themselves
⏩ Communicate clearly across the company, from technical detail for admins to the bigger picture for management

Qualifikation

You shall bring:

✅ Several years of hands on experience in corporate IT, IT operations or IT administration, ideally in a remote first environment
✅ Solid foundation across IAM (Okta or similar), collaboration suites (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), MDM/UEM (Workspace ONE or similar) and Atlassian
✅ Scripting as everyday work, for example JavaScript, Apps Script, Python or low code workflows
✅ Security and compliance mindset from the outset, experience with ISO 27001 or TISAX is a big plus
✅ Strong communication skills in German (C1, native) and English (B2+), for documentation and vendor tickets
✅ Analytical and structured approach, you solve causes, not symptoms
✅ Ownership mentality, you drive your topics forward independently

 Nice to have
⏩ AWS integrations (API Gateway, Lambda), Looker Studio, ITIL knowledge or relevant certifications

 In case you are interested in the tech part, the general tool stack is

🖥 Okta (IAM)

🖥 Workspace ONE UEM

🖥 Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro
🖥 Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence)
🖥 Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows, n8n

🖥 AWS (API Gateway, Lambda)

Benefits

We provide

💪 Assistance in setting up the project/integrating with the team

💪 Guidance while onboarding

💪 Support in any aspect of your activities

💪 Free choice of hardware

💪 Perks like private health insurance and 7card

💪 Regular team events like a week in a mountain hut

💪 Hybrid work mode (we will empower a flexible hybrid mode forever)

💪 anything you are missing – let's talk!

Some final words

You will be joining a dynamic and cross-border project team in Cluj, working closely together with the partner in Germany.

If you have any further questions, feel free to contact us at any time!

Looking forward to meeting you for a (virtual) coffee or tea ☕️

jobs.description:
¡En**Ayesa Digital** crecemos contigo!

En Ayesa Digital no esperamos al futuro, lo lideramos. A través de la tecnología y la ingeniería lo hacemos posible, convirtiendo retos en oportunidades, conceptos en soluciones y visión en impacto real. Paso a paso nos acercamos a un futuro mejor. Con tu pasión, talento y determinación, seguiremos transformando el presente y construyendo el futuro. Ayesa Digital, Making It Happen.

Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!

***Buscamos incorporar a un/a ++Ingeniero/a Senior de Sistemas Microsoft (Azure \| M365 \| Intune)++ para unirse a uno de nuestros proyectos en Gipuzkoa.***

¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!

***¿Qué vas a hacer?***

* Diseñar, evolucionar y administrar arquitecturas basadas en tecnologías Microsoft, garantizando la disponibilidad, rendimiento y seguridad de las infraestructuras de nuestros clientes.
* Participar en proyectos de modernización tecnológica, migración y transformación de entornos tradicionales hacia arquitecturas híbridas y cloud.
* Actuar como referente técnico tanto para clientes como para equipos internos, aportando visión técnica y participando en la toma de decisiones estratégicas.
* Diseñar y administrar entornos Windows Server (2016, 2019 y 2022), asegurando su correcta evolución y mantenimiento.
* Gestionar y optimizar servicios de infraestructura Microsoft como Active Directory, GPOs, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365, Intune y Azure.
* Participar en reuniones técnicas con cliente, workshops de definición y sesiones de diseño de soluciones.
* Elaborar documentación técnica, procedimientos operativos y diagramas de arquitectura.
* Resolver incidencias complejas y proporcionar soporte avanzado N2/N3 sobre plataformas críticas de infraestructura.
* Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de operaciones, cloud y ciberseguridad para garantizar la continuidad y evolución de los servicios.
* Participar en labores de preventa, diseño técnico y elaboración de propuestas para nuevos proyectos y servicios.
* Contribuir a la definición e implantación de soluciones de alta disponibilidad, recuperación ante desastres y planes de contingencia.
* Participar en servicios de guardia cuando sea necesario para garantizar la continuidad operativa de los entornos gestionados.

***¿Qué buscamos?***

* Experiencia mínima de 5 años en administración, diseño y arquitectura de entornos Wintel.
* Experiencia demostrable en la gestión y evolución de infraestructuras Microsoft en entornos empresariales.
* Conocimientos sólidos de Windows Server 2016, 2019 y 2022.
* Experiencia en administración de Active Directory, GPOs, DNS y DHCP.
* Experiencia en entornos cloud o híbridos basados en Microsoft Azure.
* Conocimientos de Microsoft 365 e Intune para la gestión de entornos modernos de puesto de trabajo y colaboración.
* Experiencia en plataformas de virtualización Hyper-V.
* Capacidad para participar en proyectos de arquitectura, modernización tecnológica y definición de soluciones.
* Experiencia en soporte avanzado N2/N3 y resolución de incidencias críticas.
* Capacidad de interlocución con clientes, liderazgo técnico y orientación a la mejora continua de los servicios.
* Nivel alto de inglés, tanto hablado como escrito, para trabajar en entornos internacionales y participar en reuniones técnicas.
* Valoraremos especialmente:
* Certificaciones Microsoft, Azure o tecnologías relacionadas.
* Experiencia en proyectos de migración, consolidación o modernización de infraestructuras.
* Conocimientos de soluciones corporativas de backup, especialmente Veeam o tecnologías equivalentes.
* Experiencia en diseño de arquitecturas de alta disponibilidad y planes de contingencia.
* Conocimientos de automatización, gestión de configuraciones o administración de entornos híbridos complejos.
* Experiencia en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares de infraestructura, cloud y seguridad.

***¿Cuándo trabajarás?***

Lunes a Viernes- 8hs a 17hs

Formato trabajo: Híbrido, 1 día presencial en nuestras oficinas de Guipúzcoa.

***Te ofrecemos un camino lleno de aventuras:***

* ¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.
* Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.
* Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.
* Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más!
* Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.
* ¡Actualízate! apostamos por un aprendizaje continuo, contamos con formación especializada, certificaciones e idiomas
* ¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.

***¡Únete a la multinacional española tecnológica referente en el mundo!***

***Atendiendo a la Ley Orgánica 3/2007, de 22 de marzo, Ayesa Digital se ha marcado como objetivo promover la defensa y aplicación efectiva del principio de igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, evitando cualquier tipo de discriminación laboral por razón de sexo, garantizando así las mismas oportunidades de ingreso. Asimismo, fomentamos la diversidad, rechazando cualquier tipo de discriminación por razones de raza, sexo, diversidad funcional, religión, orientación sexual, identidad sexual, o cualquier otra condición personal o social, apostando por construir un entorno inclusivo y enriquecedor.***

jobs.description:
****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

****Lo que harás:****

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.
* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.
* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.
* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.
* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).
* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.
* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.
* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.
* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.
* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.
* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.
* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).
* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.
* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.
* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

**Lo que buscamos**

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).
* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.
* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.
* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.
* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.
* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.
* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.
* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

**Será un plus**

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint
* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

****Las condiciones de trabajo:****

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).
* Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio.

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* **Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global:**establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación.
* **Haz crecer tu carrera:**nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido.
* **Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial:**nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología.
* **Eleva tu bienestar personal:**aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés).
* **Diversidad, equidad e inclusión:** no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo.

¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos:

En TD SYNNEX, estamos orgullosos de ser reconocidos como un excelente lugar para trabajar y líder en la promoción y práctica de la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

Si está entusiasmado por trabajar para nuestra empresa y cree que es un buen candidato para este puesto, lo alentamos a que presente su solicitud.

¡Puedes ser exactamente la persona que estamos buscando!

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

**What's In It For You?**

* **Elective Benefits:** Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* **Grow Your Career:**Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* **Elevate Your Personal Well-Being:** Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* **Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion:**It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* **Make the Most of our Global Organization**: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* **Connect with Your Community:** Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

jobs.description:
Our Loews Hotels \& Co Home Office teams provide support to all our properties throughout the United States. Our talented teams provide guidance over strategic planning, operations, revenue management, communications, marketing, finance, human resources, and information technology. This position is based at the Loews Hotels \& Co Business Services Center in Franklin, TN.

**Who We Are**: Founded in 1960, Loews Hotels \& Co operates iconic hotels and resorts across the U.S. Together, our diverse and welcoming teams craft exceptional experiences in iconic destinations.

**Growth and belonging start here**; you'll be valued for who you are and the goals you have. Whether your next career chapter involves making memories for guests or supporting our properties in our Corporate Office, every role---from Guest Services to Finance, Culinary to IT---offers opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact.

Creating a Team Member experience where you belong no matter what age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status that makes you, you is a daily focus for us.

**What We Offer**:

* Competitive health \& wellness benefits, 401(k) \& company match

* Paid Sick Days, Vacation, and Holidays, Paid Bereavement, Paid Pet Bereavement

* Training \& Development opportunities, career growth

* Tuition Reimbursement

* Pet Insurance

* Team Member Hotel Rates, other discounts, perks and more

**What We're Looking For**:

A motivated security professional eager to contribute to the improvement of Loews Hotels' security posture. An individual with a strong security background, committed to continuous learning and the implementation of innovative solutions. An Engineer who is ready to collaborate closely with other members of the Security Operations and IT Service teams to deploy robust security measures across the enterprise. Reporting to the Manager, Endpoint Security Operations, this role serves as a significant contributor to the development, implementation, and maintenance of endpoint security solutions that safeguard against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

**Who You Are**:

* A highly motivated and results driven self-starter

* An IT security enthusiast who is passionate about technology and problem solving

* A service-oriented team player who works well in a dynamic, fast paced environment

* An excellent communicator with an ability to adapt to the communication style of others

* A continuous learner that stays abreast of industry knowledge and technology

* Veterans and military spouses encouraged to apply

**What You'll Do**:

* Provide subject matter expertise on endpoint security technologies including the design, configuration, integration and deployment of enterprise security software and infrastructure

* Enhance and maintain endpoint security platforms and processes including Anti-Virus, Anti Malware, Encryption, System Hardening, EDR, MDM, Web Content Management, DNS Security, Identity Solutions SIEM and Patch Management

* Perform threat analysis, monitor security events for signs of security breaches and triage any suspicious behavior

* Assist with the health, performance, stabilization and tuning of all endpoint infrastructure

* Work with senior leadership on the research and analysis of emerging technologies that enhance security capabilities and support current and future business objectives; participate in and contribute to enterprise technology evaluations and roadmap discussions with third party vendors

* Evaluate existing endpoint security solutions and participate in the design of strategies to enhance protection against emerging threats

* Assess existing security technologies to establish opportunities for improved endpoint protection controls

* Ensure security solutions, policies and procedures are sufficient to meet and respond to threats to our data and endpoint infrastructure. Recommend and provide technical support processes, metrics, and SLAs

* Maintain and enforce endpoint security policies and standards in alignment with corporate Governance, Security-Risk and Audit policies, procedures, industry regulation, best practices, and security frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, CIS)

* Create and Deliver reports pertaining to endpoint security and compliance

* Support and document the implementation of approved endpoint security software and infrastructure components

* Oversee projects from inception to closure ensuring completion according to business requirements and stakeholder standards

* Ensure compliance with corporate Governance, Security-Risk and Audit policies, procedures, and best practices

* Perform continuous mentorship and development of junior staff members; serve as a point of contact for escalation and engagement

* Develop technical documentation, policies, and procedures for endpoint security application use and support; communicate technical standards to Information Technology teams and junior team members

* Regular attendance in conformance with standards

* May be required to work varying schedules to reflect business needs

* Required to attend all mandatory training sessions and meetings

* Demonstrate a proactive approach towards work activities

* Manage multiple projects to timely, successful completion

* Perform other duties as assigned

**Your Qualifications Include**:

* 4 Year college/university degree or technical degree required or applicable industry certifications (CISSP preferred) and relevant experience required

* 5+ years of experience in Information Security in an enterprise environment

* 2+ years of experience as a technical project lead and primary support role

* Extensive hands-on experience and expertise in endpoint security technologies and solutions to include:

* Privileged Access Management

* Endpoint Privilege Management

* Threat hunting and remediation

* Exploit mitigation

* Vulnerability assessment, management, and monitoring tools

* Anti-virus/malware telemetry

* Configuration and operation of Windows/MAC/Linux operating systems

* Triaging security events from SIEM and other security appliances

* Identity and cyber security software-based tools, audits and compliance

* Incident response, documentation, and reporting

* Mobile device management, Cloud, security, and investigations

* Network protocols -- IP, DHCP, DNS

* Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory and associated components

* Web Content Management

* Patch Management and RMM
* Strong knowledge of host and networked based attack methodologies

* Solid understanding of various governance frameworks such as ITIL and NIST

* Expertise in endpoint security best practices

* Knowledge of network and firewall infrastructure

* Preferred experience and certifications:

*

* Knowledge of Security Technologies from Ivanti, Sentinel One, Palo Alto Networks, Sophos, Cisco Umbrella and Idira (formerly CyberArk)

*

* Experience in retail, travel, restaurants, or hospitality

*

* Experience in compliance with PCI and SOX

*

* Microsoft Security Certifications

* Must be able to safely lift and carry computer equipment (computers, monitors, servers, switches, firewalls, etc.)

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex security issues

* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams

* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule to include weekends and holidays

* Must be willing to travel domestically or abroad up to 20% of the time

Total Cyber sec es una empresa Mexicana de Grupo Salinas especializada en la prestación de Servicio Profesionales de Seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad, con un equipo de profesionales con más de 15 años, comprometida con la igualdad laboral y no discriminación, con declaración explícita de la prohibición de solicitudes de certificados médicos de no embarazo y Virus de Inmunodeficiencia Humana (VIH) como requisitos para el ingreso, permanencia o ascenso en el empleo.

Comprometidos con la igualdad laboral y no discriminación, nos encontramos en la búsqueda de talento como:

**Especialista ENDPOINT**

**Escolaridad:**

Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones/Sistemas/Computación/Afín.

**Experiencia y conocimientos en:**

* Experiencia trabajando en un rol de Ciberseguridad en Endpoint.
* **Gestión de Plataformas**: Administrar y optimizar la plataforma Tanium y Jamf Pro.
* **Ciclo de Vida de Parcheo**: Diseñar, ejecutar y supervisar el despliegue mensual de parches de seguridad en sistemas operativos y aplicaciones de terceros.
* **Remediación de Vulnerabilidades**: Analizar reportes de vulnerabilidades y ejecutar planes de acción masivos para mitigar riesgos críticos.
* Experiencia en el uso de herramientas SIEM y conocimiento de detección y respuesta de endpoints (EDR).
* Una comprensión profunda del panorama de las ciberamenazas, las vulnerabilidades y los riesgos.
* Experiencia en el uso de herramientas forenses
* Respuesta de Incidentes.
* Threat Hunting
* Análisis de Malware

**Responsabilidades del puesto**

* Realice análisis de malware
* Caza de amenazas
* Trabaje en estrecha colaboración con otros departamentos para mitigar los incidentes de seguridad.
* Infórmese sobre los ciberataques existentes y emergentes.

**Ofrecemos:**

· Sueldo competitivo

· Prestaciones de Ley.

· Seguro de vida.

· Oportunidades de desarrollo.

· Excelente ambiente de trabajo.

Zona de trabajo: Tlalpan

Interesados postularse por este medio.

jobs.description:
¡Buscamos Administrador de Endpoint MDM (Microsoft Intune)!

Ubicación: Santa Fe, Alcaldía Álvaro Obregón, CDMX (Modo Híbrido)

Inglés: Técnico conversacional

¿Cuál será tu reto principal?

Llevar a cabo la administración integral del ciclo de vida de los dispositivos de la compañía, garantizando la seguridad, el cumplimiento de políticas y la entrega eficiente de software a través de Microsoft Intune.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

**Habilidades Técnicas Clave** Gestión de Intune \& Identidades: Administración de identidades híbridas, licencias, grupos y perfiles de configuración/cumplimiento (Compliance).

Control de Acceso \& Seguridad: Configuración de Acceso Condicional y MFA.

Sistemas Operativos: Experiencia multiplataforma en Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS/iPadOS y Android.

Empaquetado y Despliegue: Manejo de software en formatos .msi, .exe, .intunewin, Apple VPP, Google Play Corporativo y Windows Store.

Automatización: Uso de PowerShell y Microsoft Graph API para optimizar procesos y generación de reportes.

**Competencias y Habilidades Blandas** Diagnóstico y Troubleshooting: Capacidad para análisis e interpretación de logs de fallos en políticas y despliegues.

Comunicación Eficiente: Soporte a usuarios finales y transferencia de conocimiento a Mesa de Ayuda (Niveles 1 y 2).

Actitud y Compromiso: Organización, honestidad, alto sentido de urgencia, resolución de problemas bajo presión y disponibilidad para atender incidencias fuera de horario comercial.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Excelente ambiente de trabajo y proyectos de alto impacto tecnológico.

Contratación e incorporación inmediata.

¿Interesado/a o conoces a alguien ideal?

Envía tu CV actualizado a \[rh@dti.com.mx\] con el subject subject INTUNE o postúlate directamente por este medio.
